job.title: Account Executive, KSL Homes
job.description: Our company is committed to being trusted voices of light and truth reaching hundreds of millions of people worldwide. Who We Are KSL is Utah’s leading local news source across digital and broadcast platforms, delivering trusted, award‑winning journalism through KSL.com and KSL‑TV. We provide in‑depth local reporting, investigative journalism, and up‑to‑the‑minute coverage that serves communities across the state. Committed to being a trusted voice of light and knowledge, KSL helps Utahns stay informed, connected, and engaged with the issues that matter most. Position Overview As an entry level to intermediate level Sales Account Executive, you will contribute to the sales team’s revenue growth and new business development. We are seeking someone who will employ a consultative, data-driven approach to cultivate relationships with property managers, home builders, real estate agents, and brokers. You will manage the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to client retention, and contribute to businesses' growth through effective online advertising. Our Account Executives’ ideas and solutions have the potential to reach millions as we work together to write the next chapter in our history. Join our winning team as an Account Executive and start empowering local businesses while getting top-notch support and unlimited earning potential. Note: Work configurations are subject to change based on business needs and at company discretion. This position is an hybrid role that requires the employee to sometimes work at our Salt Lake City site. Specific hybrid schedules will be determined based on business needs and evaluated by managers and senior management. Employee may need to be on-site during the training period. What You Will Do: Primary job duties will include, but are not limited to: Hunt and develop new business and grow existing business Generate new business through persistent focus on new client development and strategic sourcing Prospect and identify marketing revenue opportunities, create sales packages, present to clients, and close the sale. Create holistic digital marketing solutions with the ability to manipulate and calculate pricing structures utilizing CPM (cost per thousand) and CPC (cost per click) Meet and exceed individual quarterly budgets Fully participate in company CRM (Client Relationship Management) system Participate in training to enhance professional skills and overall understanding of new and evolving media Skills and Experience We Are Looking For: 1-4 years of inside sales/outside sales Proven track record of success in a sales role Passion for professional excellence and integrity with a positive attitude and contagious enthusiasm Demonstrated ability to strategically prospect new business, overcome objections, and have courage to ask again Ability to organize, analyze, and interpret statistical data and draw conclusions from finding and follow-through Ability and willingness to resolve unexpected problems and be flexible to perform unscheduled assignments A high level of proficiency with computers, software, and new technologies A valid driver’s license Work effectively in a team environment. Proven ability to handle stress. Ability to consistently work hours required. Works more when required to meet deadlines including weekends, evenings, etc. Project an appropriate professional appearance and demeanor Maintain positive and cooperative rapport with staff, management and clients Computer literate with working knowledge of Excel, Word and Adobe acrobat. Ability to understand and follow instructions and work with minimum supervision. Strong self-motivation, well organized, and dependable. Project pleasant, friendly, professional, business-like demeanor in person, over the telephone and through e-mail. Proven ability to work autonomously as well as establish effective communications and working relationships with co-workers and others while performing job responsibilities. Ability to exercise good judgment and make a positive impact on department’s productivity. Physical Demands Receive, process, and maintain information through oral and/or written communication effectively. Manual dexterity and fine motor skills to operate computer keys and general office equipment. Ability to work on a computer for prolonged periods of time. Sit and/or stand for extended periods of time. Lift, move, and carry up to 45 pounds on occasion Compensation The compensation for this role is commission-focused. Base salary range for this role is $48,000-$51,500, excluding commission payments. Base salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to evaluation of the experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant along with internal equity and alignment with market data. What We Offer You: Check Out Our KSL Benefits! Employees at KSL can enjoy a broad offering of benefits, including: Robust, affordable medical, dental and vision coverage with no wait period for enrollment Paid leave for new parents under our Medical Maternity and Parental Leave policies Opportunities to apply for tuition reimbursement Paid time off for vacation and sick leave in addition to paid company holidays 401(k) with Company match, fully vested from day one Paid time off for volunteering Employer-funded retirement account, fully vested from day one Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services Access to an entire team of free financial planners Matches on contributions to charitable organizations after one year of service Continuous growth and development opportunities Dynamic team culture that values teamwork, having fun, and collaboration KSL is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law. Role In this role, you will develop standards, methods and procedures to optimize the use and simplify the maintenance of our production and broadcasting systems/equipment. You will also lead the response to power outages or major technical incidents that fall outside the scope of routine maintenance, troubleshooting and restoration of production and broadcasting systems/equipment. This position operates in a cross-functional environment spanning networking, optics, electronics, computer systems, mechanics, machining, welding, hydraulics and pneumatics. Additionally, you will design, author, organize and deliver technical training courses and seminars. Key Tasks: Develop and recommend work procedures, methods and standards to meet or exceed operational requirements for the optimal use and maintenance of production and broadcasting systems/equipment as well as the fabrication and machining of parts and tools; coordinate implementation with maintenance technicians. Advise team members on installing, commissioning and operating production and broadcasting systems/equipment. Plan, coordinate, assign, review and monitor project work performed by technicians reporting to you, providing guidance as needed. Respond to power outages or major technical incidents that fall outside the scope of routine maintenance, troubleshooting and restoration of production and broadcasting systems/equipment. Identify operational needs, draft quality control procedures, determine testing frequencies and assess performance results. Evaluate system and equipment performance to ensure serviceability before purchase, after installation or during commissioning, and report your findings. Design, author, organize and deliver technical training courses or seminars and guide workers in performing their duties. Coordinate, review and assess the work of trainees and report on their progress. Design, administer and grade technical competency tests for staff and job applicants, providing clear assessments of their skills. Design, draft, catalogue and update technical documentation, reference manuals and training materials, ensuring they are readily available to the team. Evaluate existing equipment and produce detailed reports regarding its maintenance or short- and long-term replacement cycles. Stay abreast of emerging technologies to proactively resolve technical challenges. Develop and document new technical modules and subsystems to modify or adapt existing equipment, address production gaps and meet specific routine production/broadcasting requirements. Ensure all necessary maintenance components (including documentation and toolsets) are available when commissioning new systems/equipment, making proactive recommendations to support long-term maintenance. Complete the appropriate forms and documents; share information verbally or in writing to ensure proper followup and to keep others informed. Familiarize other employees with their duties and work environment. Carry out, as needed, all or part of the duties of another job classification within an equivalent or lower salary group, as well as other related duties. Unposting Date: 2026-09-07 11:59 PM Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization. Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between. A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen. This is a hybrid position with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines. Your Role The Software and Platform Architecture Team is looking for a creative, highly skilled and talented AI Lead Architect with deep Subject Matter Expertise in AI governance and implementation for our downtown Toronto, Ottawa or Montreal Office location. Reporting to the Director of Software Architecture and Contract Management, you will be responsible for establishing, leading and contributing to the AI Architecture evolution and governance. This role will join an existing team of architects who have a focus on software and cloud platforms architecture best practice and governance. As part of the Architecture department you will leave your mark by bridging the gap between advanced AI technologies and practical business needs. You will help design, build, and oversee the integration of scalable artificial intelligence systems, including machine learning pipelines and agentic AI workloads, ensuring security, compliance and alignment with overall enterprise objectives. You will enjoy innovative work in a creative and dynamic work environment, working with leading technologies, and opportunities for continued professional development. How will you make an impact? As the AI Lead Architect, you will: Evaluate AI frameworks, platforms and tools (e.g., AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud) to recommend optimal build-versus-buy decisions. Guide foundation model selection aligned with CBC's use cases and infrastructure capabilities. Lead the architecture of AI applications using large language models (LLMs), machine learning, deep learning, and natural language processing (NLP). Develop architectural roadmaps for deploying AI initiatives, including generative AI (GenAI), LLMs, and agentic business processes. Lead the integration of scalable artificial intelligence systems, including machine learning pipelines and agentic AI workloads, ensuring security, compliance and alignment with overall enterprise objectives. Monitor emerging AI technologies and assess their business value. Establish architectural standards for model performance, traceability, data lineage, and privacy compliance. Understand business requirements and identify AI use cases. Integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications. Craft prompts, evaluate outputs, and design automated end-to-end agentic workflows. Continuously test and refine models to ensure reliability, scalability, and optimal performance in production. Support continuous monitoring and governance of AI solutions post-deployment. Lead technical discussions with stakeholders and development teams. Work with business leaders to define desired outcomes, success metrics and value drivers for AI initiatives. Collaborate with ethics and compliance teams to ensure AI initiatives adhere to regulatory requirements and CBC's governance standards. Work with business leaders to define desired outcomes, success metrics and value drivers for AI initiatives. Mentor technical teams on AI architecture best practices. Perks you can look forward to: Four weeks of vacation per year. Work from home opportunities. Competitive total rewards package. Opportunities to work with cutting edge technology. Opportunities for continued learning and professional development - including access to e-learning services, customized courses and certification opportunities. Opportunities to become a member of our Employee Resource Groups. A creative and dynamic work environment, where your ideas and contributions can be heard, valued and respected. A supportive management team committed to upholding the highest standards of diversity and inclusivity. What you bring to our team Minimum Requirements A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field. 3-5 years experience in software architecture, cloud architecture, data engineering, or AI solutions. 1-2 years of experience designing enterprise AI or machine learning solutions. Experience delivering cloud-native AI solutions. Vendor-specific certifications such as the Microsoft Certified: Agentic AI Business Solutions Architect or equivalent AWS/GCP architecture credentials are highly valued. Deep understanding of Machine Learning (ML), Natural Language Processing (NLP), and AI application deployment using languages like Python or R. Knowledge of AI governance frameworks and responsible AI practices. Experience with data management systems and MLOps tools (e.g., Kubernetes, Git, model registries). Exceptional stakeholder management, technical leadership, and ability to evangelize AI adoption internally. Desired Skills Experience in media, broadcasting, or content distribution technology. Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF, Zachman, etc.). Executive communication and product management experience. Prior work in regulated industries with compliance expertise. Ability to multitask and deal with concurrent and/or conflicting priorities. Analytical mind and open-minded approach to problem solving. Self starter with strong ability to lead through influence. Strong communication and coaching skills. Creative and Innovative. Excellent team player. Ability to work with remote teams. Bilingualism (English and French) is a strong asset. Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between. A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen. This is a hybrid position with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines. Your role As a Program/Project Delivery Finance Advisor, you will play a critical role in supporting a large-scale and transformative agile/hybrid program. You will act as a vital financial bridge between delivery squads, program leadership, and Governance. Working closely with a Program Director and the Program Office, Product Owners, and Corporate Finance, you will be responsible for stewardship of complex project/program financials. You will navigate multiple funding models to ensure accurate tracking and reporting. The opportunity CBC/Radio-Canada is running a large-scale agile program with rigorous financial, tracking, and reporting requirements. This role offers the opportunity to synthesize complex financial data into actionable insights for various stakeholder groups, ultimately supporting critical reporting within the corporation and, via Finance, to external institutions involved in financing of the program. Primary Duties and Responsibilities Oversee and aggregate program-level financials, applying strong Capital and non-Capital accounting knowledge while supporting empowered agile squads and Product Owners in managing their individual financial accountability. Working with the Program Director and Finance, establish appropriate financial guardrails and provide program-level monitoring across categories of spend (e.g., vendors, resourcing, licensing), supporting the Product Owners who maintain ownership/accountability for their initiative/project financials. Align financial tracking with the program's resource sheet for labour and travel burn rates, including squad membership and percentage allocations to projects. Develop "what-if" scenarios and financial plans to support program agility and decision-making. Fluently translate progress, risk, and financial metrics between technical teams and corporate partners, ensuring information is fit-for-purpose for high-level stewardship and control. Collaborate with Program Director in preparing financial reporting for Governance. Communicate financial statuses and requirements effectively to diverse groups, including Corporate Finance, the Program Director, and Product Owners/Squad Leads. We are looking for a candidate with the following: 7 years relevant experience with 3 or more years managing project financials including agile/hybrid environments. Strong financial acumen, a deep understanding of financial mechanisms on projects and programs in the context of transformational and innovation projects. Able to understand actuals, and build short and long term forecasts in agile, traditional, and hybrid environments. Comfortable navigating ambiguity within an evolving program environment, bringing flexibility to financial forecasting as requirements and delivery details become more clearly defined over time. Understanding of different expenditure types in large transformative projects. Understanding of multiple funding models, from standard corporate budgets to loans paid via leases. Strong proficiency in utilizing data tools to track and report on financial performance metrics and turn complex information into tailored summaries. Experience building and using tools and reporting on financials in transformational/innovative initiatives. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, capable of interacting seamlessly with both highly technical and director-level governance. University degree in a relevant field or equivalent combination of training and experience. Functional bilingualism is an asset. Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing. job.description: Position Title: Journalist, assigned to digital (Montreal) (English Services) Status of Employment: Permanent Position Language Requirement: English, French Language Skills: English (First Official Language), English (Reading), English (Speaking), English (Writing), French (Reading), French (Speaking), French (Writing) Work at CBC/Radio-Canada At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance. Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians. Unposting Date: 2026-09-10 11:59 PM CBC News is looking for an experienced journalist to join our digital team in Montreal. At CBC in Quebec, we focus on finding the angles that matter to our audience and telling stories that are rooted in our English-speaking communities across Quebec. We are guided by the principles of excellence, collaboration and creativity. CBC Montreal is a multiplatform newsroom where our original and breaking news coverage is driven by the digital desk on mobile, social and video streaming platforms. In this role, you will play an integral role in the accurate and timely delivery of live and on-demand news through text, live pages, video and audio. We are looking for a journalist who demonstrates exceptional skill in going beyond the headlines to bring more depth and context to CBC’s digital platforms. This position requires someone who can turn around timely or breaking stories on a wide variety of topics, and also craft longer, complex reports. You would be primarily assigned to report, write and edit for digital publishing and therefore must be an excellent writer and editor. You should be excited about video storytelling on our owned-and-operated and social platforms and be on top of the audience needs in those spaces. A strong candidate for this position would be someone who is innovative, open to trying new things and inspires others to do the same. We are looking for a journalist who is tapped into local communities to listen and bring their voices forward. We deliver trusted journalism that is inclusive, innovative, helpful and bold. You understand the diverse and changing population in Quebec and the importance of reflecting all our communities in our content. You live and promote the values of diversity and an inclusive and respectful work culture. In this role, you will have an uncompromising attention to detail and accuracy, and ensure that all CBC journalistic standards are met and that our stories are fair, balanced, accurate, thoughtful and immediate, and resonate with the communities we serve. For reference purposes, you will be assigned to the Quebec digital news team based in Montreal. The schedule is rotation-based shift work. Tasks: Pitch and produce original and engaging stories with digital and social audiences top of mind. Respond quickly to breaking and developing news including live events. Write stories based on your own reporting but also collaborate with other CBC journalists and current affairs teams. Package stories with strong headlines, photos, video, audio, graphics and links to deepen engagement. Prepare original stories for broadcast platforms and collaborate with other journalists for multi-platform rollouts. Assist in curating the cbc.ca/quebec website and news app lineup. Copy editing stories written by team members as needed. Prepare and post content on social media channels. Gather and edit photos and videos. Job requirements Qualifications Bachelor's degree or the equivalent Minimum (3) three years of journalism experience or equivalent Skills In-depth knowledge of Quebec news and current events, with a strong level of general knowledge. Strong communication and interpersonal skills; strong collaborative team player. Excellent writing and editing skills. Ability to generate original, enterprise journalism. Comfortable and willing to experiment with new and innovative storytelling approaches on digital and social platforms. Strong visual storytelling skills, including photos, graphics and video. Clear and creative ability to write headlines and package stories. Fluent in English. Good comprehension of written and spoken French. Knowledge of CBC/Radio-Canada's Journalistic Standards and Practices. Knowledge of radio and video communications, an asset. Proven ability to work in a high-stress, tight-deadline environment. Willing to work on a rotation basis, must be flexible to work all shifts and irregular hours, depending on the assignment. Please include a letter of interest detailing how your experience would be an asset to us. Selected candidates will be subject to the following: Complete an assignment Interview. job.description: Position Title: Junior Specialist, Organizational Development & Engagement (Hybrid/Telework) Status of Employment: Permanent Position Language Requirement: English, French Language Skills: English (Reading - C - Advanced), English (Speaking - B - Intermediate), English (Writing - C - Advanced), French (Reading - C - Advanced), French (Speaking - B - Intermediate), French (Writing - C - Advanced) Work at CBC/Radio-Canada At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance. Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians. Unposting Date: 2026-09-08 11:59 PM Reporting to the Director, Organizational Development & Engagement as the Bilingual Junior Specialist, Organizational Development & Engagement, you will support the successful implementation, deployment, and rollout of employee listening and engagement initiatives (including local, department/function-level surveys, exit surveys, and onboarding surveys). Combining administrative rigor, data accuracy, and communication agility, you will act as a key liaison between employees, managers, and HR Business Partners (HRBPs) to foster a culture of continuous listening, feedback, and engagement across the organization. You will thrive in a dynamic, creative environment, balancing operational, analytical, and relational tasks while maintaining regular contact with internal partners. This is a hybrid position combining remote work and office presence, based on two (flexible) days per week in the office. Working conditions will be discussed with the hiring manager according to departmental guidelines. A full-time permanent position is currently available and can be based in one of our stations in Ottawa or Montreal. Main Responsibilities and Impact: 1. Engagement Program Coordination & Deployment Plan and coordinate the logistical and operational activities related to the deployment and rollout of local, department, and function-level surveys. Support the rollout of the broader enterprise employee listening program (e.g., Your Voice / Peakon in Workday) across targeted units. Coordinate feedback loop schedules, campaign launch dates, and administration workflows with HRBPs and department leaders. Manage registration, access privileges, and demographic mapping for survey participants across various organizational functions. 2. Data Reporting & Communications Support Assist in assembling, formatting, and summarizing survey participation rate data and core sentiment metrics (e.g., eNPS, engagement scores). Support the development and deployment of communication plans and user guides designed for managers and HRBPs to socialize survey results and drive action planning. Create visual presentations and infographics to support executive and engagement committee meetings. 3. Operational Support & Continuous Improvement Act as the primary point of contact for the dedicated engagement and employee listening inbox, answering inquiries from managers and staff in a timely manner. Maintain and update the internal digital library of engagement tools, action-planning toolkits, and survey resources. Document operational processes and participate in post-campaign retrospectives to identify process improvement opportunities and keep documentation up to date. 4. Unposting Date: 2026-09-15 11:59 PM News Editor/Presenter (English Services) (On-Site) Your role: CBC Edmonton is looking for an experienced news editor/presenter to lead our weekday morning newscasts for audiences listening live on the radio, and on digital platforms. As a key member of CBC Edmonton’s morning on-air team, you thrive on setting the news agenda for listeners starting their day. You are passionate about providing breaking news to audiences, and injecting their mornings with some joy. Present news on other platforms (streaming, podcasts, digital, video) as required. Your profile: Demonstrated experience working in live and breaking news in a fast-paced, multiplatform news environment. Ability to generate, pitch and pursue strong, original story ideas. The Engineering Services group, part of "T&I", consolidates all the expertise that supports the delivery of CBC/Radio-Canada's engineering initiatives. Acting as a strategic center of expertise and a performance facilitator, our role is to simplify and optimize engineering initiatives for the benefit of our Operations, Production, and Maintenance partners. Among these key partners is the Transmission Engineering group, which is responsible for planning and implementing technical solutions to support the CBC/Radio-Canada broadcasting network (including, among others, traditional analog AM & FM radio, digital radio (HD Radio), digital television (ATSC) as well as C-Band and Ku-Band satellite distribution, and point-to-point links (STL)). Spectrum Engineering is a key area of expertise within Engineering Services . Perform engineering analyses to optimize the coverage of broadcasting stations and radiocommunication systems. Establish the official technical parameters of broadcasting stations (technical briefs). Ensure compliance with RF exposure limits at transmission sites located across the country (500+ sites) (Safety Code 6 - Health Canada). job.description: Job Title Campaign Manager, Conversion Job Description About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements People Inc. is seeking a Campaign Manager to support and execute the conversion marketing strategy across PEOPLE onsite and in-app marketing. job.description: Job Title Commercial Counsel Job Description About The Position: The Commercial Counsel is a key member of People Inc's Legal team, serving as a trusted legal advisor to the business and leading the review, negotiation, and implementation of the company's commercial contracting processes. job.title: Director, Data Science
job.description: Job Title Director, Data Science Job Description About The Position | Major Goals and Objectives and Location Requirements: People Inc. is America’s largest print and digital publisher, reaching tens of millions of readers every day. We’re hiring a Director of Data Science to lead customer intelligence and personalization for our entertainment brands, helping shape products and experiences that inform, engage, and inspire our audiences. In this role, you’ll build a deeper understanding of our customers across product engagement, marketing response, and lifecycle behavior. You’ll partner closely with Product, Marketing, and Editorial teams to turn data into actionable insights that drive growth, while working with Data Operations and Engineering to ensure our models, measurement systems, and insights can scale effectively. You’ll apply statistical modeling and machine learning to product and marketing challenges across customer segmentation, acquisition, engagement, retention, and lifetime value, with a particular focus on mobile app experiences. You’ll own models and analyses that support personalization, automated marketing, attribution, experimentation, and lifecycle optimization across apps, newsletters, and other customer touchpoints, translating complex audience behavior into clear recommendations and measurable business impact. Schedule Requirements: In-office Expectations: This position is fully remote with no in-office requirements, (might require coming into an office periodically for team meetings, etc.) About The Team | The Team and/or Brand: People Inc. is the largest premium publisher in the world. Every day, tens of millions of people come to us for help and inspiration. Our library of hundreds of thousands of articles helps our users understand how to deal with day-to-day challenges. You will work with a team of data scientists, collaborating with cross-functional groups to leverage this incredible dataset to understand both our content and our users' needs. This knowledge will be used to identify and build out new products that leverage the behavioral information within our extensive data. About The Position’s Contributions: Weight % Accountabilities, Actions, and Expected Measurable Results Lead and grow a data science team to develop predictive models that estimate customer lifetime value using advanced statistical and machine learning techniques. Analyze and understand customer interactions across app, web, social media, and email touchpoints to identify and optimize engagement opportunities. Own product funnel and engagement analysis, including onboarding completion, feature adoption, feature stickiness, and session behavior, as distinct from marketing-funnel metrics such as acquisition and retention. Leverage data-driven insights to build customer segmentation models, identifying high-value users and informing content and product recommendations. Partner with Product and Editorial teams to translate user understanding into differentiated experiences across the app, newsletters, and other customer interactions, feeding insights directly into the product development cycle. This includes the sizing of opportunities and assessment of product success. Design online A/B testing experiments to measure the impact of product changes, personalization, and full-funnel marketing interventions. Ensure effective collaboration between data science teams and other departments. Advocate for resources and tools to advance data capabilities. Align data initiatives with company objectives. The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements: Education: PhD or advanced degree in Data Science, Economics, Business Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, or similar quantitative field, or equivalent experience. Experience: 7+ years of experience in data science and machine learning with a strong focus in the area of customer behavior, product analytics, and marketing-focused problems. 5+ years of experience leading a team of data scientists. Ability to lead product and funnel analytics on web and mobile platforms with a focus on providing actionable insights, not just data outputs. Solid foundation in causal inference, survival analysis, and time series analysis, especially as applied to marketing and customer behavior. Strong proficiency in Python and SQL for data analysis and model development. Familiarity with Claude Code/Codex and how they can be used reliably (and where they fail) in a data science workflow. Strong strategic and operational capabilities. Excellent leadership and communication skills. Ability to communicate complex analyses clearly to non-technical marketing and business stakeholders. Drives adoption of new data science methods and technologies to continually expand what the product can do. Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities: Experience with large-scale search and recommendation systems in media, e-commerce, or advertising space. Experience working with large-scale analytics platforms (e.g., BigQuery). Exposure to reinforcement learning or bandit approaches for personalization or offer optimization. Advanced experimentation techniques, including multivariate testing, factorial designs, and CUPED. Experience with Bayesian statistical methods for inference and decision-making under uncertainty. Experience with forecasting models and advanced lifecycle or retention modeling. Applied NLP experience for content classification, semantic search, or audience understanding. Track record of leading end-to-end data science projects from problem framing through deployment and impact measurement. Confidence and pride in representing Data Science as a strategic partner to Marketing and other business teams. % Travel Required ( Approximate ): ~5%, ability to travel periodically/quarterly for team meetings/events preferred but flexible based on candidate needs It is the policy of People Inc. to provide equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. job.description: Job Title Director, Executive Compensation Job Description The Director, Executive Compensation serves as the leader and subject matter expert for the company’s equity and executive compensation programs. This hands-on role is responsible for administering and optimizing the equity compensation program at People Incorporated and ensuring a seamless experience for all participants. Reporting to the VP of Total Rewards, this role interacts with Finance, Legal, and HR. The ideal candidate will balance technical excellence in equity governance with the executive presence required to design, communicate, and execute competitive reward strategies across the company. The position is based in the New York City corporate headquarters and is hybrid in-office with the ability to work remotely up to 2 days per week. Equity Program Administration Manage and process the full lifecycle of global equity awards: grant setup, vesting, releases, cancellations, terminations/retirement, and quarterly dividends across multiple jurisdictions and equity structures. Manage and optimize the employee equity database. Maintain flawless data integrity, update employee records, and generate routine and ad-hoc reports. Act as a trusted, accessible stock plan expert to all levels of the organization, including executives and board members, providing support and addressing inquiries with clarity, accuracy, and timeliness. Coordinate with Payroll and Finance regarding equity vests and reporting. Provide guidance to HRBPs and Subsidiary companies as needed. Review, interpret, and optimize stock plan data. Track and report on critical equity metrics including share utilization, burn rate, overhang, and dilution to inform long-term budgeting and forecasting. Prepare projections and provide recommendations on budgets. Exercise sound judgment to resolve complex stock plan participant matters and address evolving stock plan provisions, balancing business needs and employee experience considerations. Proactively educate employees on their equity plans and grants. Prepare and review stock plan participant communications, statements, and educational materials, ensuring clarity and comprehension across diverse participant groups. Own the strategic relationship and service level agreements (SLAs) with external stock plan administrators (e.g., Morgan Stanley), ensuring seamless platform optimization and flawless database data integrity. Act as the technical advisor on the equity and compensation implications of corporate restructurings, subsidiary management, and Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A). Oversee equity plan compliance, monitoring insider trading policies, managing pre-clearance lists, and enforcing corporate blackout periods in partnership with Legal. Executive Compensation, Proxy & Governance Partner directly with the VP of Total Rewards to strategize, draft, and deliver high-impact, Board-level materials and data visualizations for the quarterly Compensation Committee meetings. Contribute to executive compensation-related regulatory filings and disclosures, including the Compensation Discussion & Analysis (CD&A) and related proxy statement content. Monitor and interpret evolving investor expectations and proxy advisor perspectives, regulatory developments, firm strategy and market practices and translate these into practical implications for Total Rewards program design and disclosure. Lead executive benchmarking, peer group selection, and competitive pay analysis for senior leadership. Ensure regulatory compliance for Section 16 executive and Board members and assist in the preparation of SEC Form filings . General Compensation & Projects Serve as a trusted advisor to senior management by providing strategic guidance and execution support for Total Rewards programs, especially compensation programs impacting senior leadership. Serve as a trusted partner to HR and Finance with Compensation initiatives throughout the year. Support the Compensation team by collaborating on Compensation philosophy and with the year-end compensation cycle. The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements: Education: Bachelor’s degree in HR, Finance, or Business. CCP certification is a plus. Experience: 8+ years of progressive experience in compensation in a publicly traded, mid-to-large-sized company with specific experience in hands-on equity administration including stock options, restricted stock, and performance-based stock awards. Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities: Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and quantitative skills with a focus on detail and data accuracy. Advanced Sheets/Excel Capabilities: Mastery of advanced spreadsheet functions (lookups, index/match, pivot tables, complex data modeling) to manipulate and interpret large datasets. Discretion & Judgment: A proven problem-solving mindset with the ability to think critically, exercise good judgment, and handle highly confidential executive data with total discretion. Agility & Time Management: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, managing multiple competing priorities and tight deadlines seamlessly. Communication: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate complex equity and compensation topics clearly to both entry-level employees and executives. Autonomy: A proactive, self-starter mentality who takes initiative and works independently while remaining a highly collaborative team player. The Editorial Director will be responsible for expanding Hot Luck beyond its annual festival footprint and building a best-in-class content operation across digital, video, audio, social, newsletters, live events, and branded content. This includes launching and scaling a Hot Luck YouTube channel, developing recurring social video franchises, producing editorially-driven sponsorship programs, growing a robust newsletter portfolio, and helping establish a Hot Luck radio and audio presence that extends the brand's reach and influence throughout the year. As the central liaison for the Board of Directors, this role ensures seamless communication and meticulous preparation of materials for executive meetings. The ideal candidate is a proactive, highly organized professional who handles competing demands with exceptional judgment, strict confidentiality, and high integrity. Hybrid 3x a week- NYC In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week. About The Team: The People Inc. legal team operates as a trusted strategic partner across the enterprise, safeguarding the company’s assets, reputation, and compliance standards. We are a collaborative, detail-oriented, and high-performing team that values integrity, proactive problem-solving, and continuous improvement. This role interacts closely with executive leadership, the Board of Directors, and external stakeholders, representing the legal department with professionalism and poise. About The Position’s Contributions: 75% Board of Directors & Corporate Governance Support: Manage logistics for Board and Committee meetings, including scheduling, facilities, and virtual arrangements. Prepare and distribute confidential Board materials, agendas, and presentations per established timelines. Maintain the Board portal to ensure secure and timely document updates. Coordinate the collection of reports and presentations from executive leadership for Board books. Track Board action items, resolutions, and follow-up requests to ensure timely completion. Maintain official corporate records, including minutes, resolutions, and governance documentation. Assist with governance initiatives, such as calendars, director onboarding, and shareholder meetings. Oversee the execution and retention of resolutions, written consents, and executive certifications. 10% Operational Excellence: Identify opportunities to improve administrative and operational processes that increase efficiency within the Legal department. Build collaborative relationships across Legal, Human Resources, Finance, Executive Leadership, and other business functions. Anticipate business needs and proactively recommend solutions that enhance executive effectiveness and department operations. 10% Executive Admin Support to Deputy General Counsel , Head of Corporate Legal Affairs & Litigation : Provide comprehensive executive support to the Deputy General Counsel (calendar, travel, expenses, and communications) Facilitate legal operations (meeting coordination, document management, contract administration, budgeting, and vendor support). 5% Executive and Legal Team Support Back-Up: Serve as back-up coverage during the Executive Legal Assistant's absence to provide comprehensive executive support to the SVP and General Counsel as needed including: calendar, travel, expenses, and communications, meeting coordination, document management, contract administration, budgeting, and vendor support. The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Legal Studies, or a related field preferred; or equivalent combination of education and professional experience. Experience: 5+ years of executive administrative or paralegal experience supporting C-suite executives, preferably within a Legal department. Experience supporting a Chief Legal Officer, General Counsel, Corporate Secretary, or Board of Directors strongly preferred. Experience handling highly confidential legal, employment, corporate governance, or executive information. Experience coordinating Board of Directors meetings and preparing Board materials preferred. Experience working in a publicly traded company or highly regulated environment is a plus. Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Zoom, and Google Workspace ( Gmail, Google Drive, Google Sheets, Google Docs, Google Slides. Demonstrated ability to handle highly confidential, proprietary, and sensitive information with absolute discretion. Demonstrated ability to exercise sound j udgment, professionalism, and discretion. Exceptional written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to interface confidently with C-suite executives and board members. job.title: GSOC Coordinator
job.description: Job Title GSOC Coordinator Job Description About The Position | Major Goals and Objectives and Location Requirements: People Inc. is seeking an experienced GSOC Coordinator to serve as a trusted operational resource within the Global Security Operations Center. This position performs the full range of GSOC operator duties while also supporting advanced enterprise security work involving intelligence, investigations, travel security, executive protection, and crisis management. Reporting to the Manager, GSOC & Intelligence, the Coordinator operates security systems, manages incidents and communications, conducts research and assessments, and supports sensitive security matters requiring sound judgment, discretion, strong writing, and independent decision-making. Schedule Requirements: Full In-Office In-office Expectations: This position is a fully in-office role due to the nature of the work being done. About The Team | The Team and/or Brand: The Security team at People Inc. is responsible for ensuring the safety and security of employees, facilities, and assets across all office site locations. The team partners closely with contracted security staff, reception, facilities, event teams, and law enforcement agencies to deliver a consistent and resilient security program. About The Position’s Contributions: GSOC and Site Security Operations Operate the GSOC and continuously monitor alarms, CCTV, access control, life-safety systems, and other enterprise security technologies. Receive, assess, document, and coordinate the response to security incidents, emergencies, system alerts, and requests for assistance. Dispatch security personnel, maintain communications with field operations, and ensure timely escalation to Security Management and appropriate business partners. Prepare and distribute mass notifications, emergency communications, incident updates, and other enterprise security messages when authorized. Support access-control administration, video review, incident documentation, daily logs, shift turnover, and security-system troubleshooting. Intelligence and Investigative Support Conduct open-source intelligence research, social media monitoring, threat-actor research, and other authorized intelligence collection in support of active security matters. Assist with threat assessments, workplace violence concerns, criminal and administrative investigations, background research, and investigative case support. Support executive and brand threat monitoring by identifying, documenting, and escalating information that may indicate risk to employees, executives, offices, events, or company operations. Produce clear, accurate, and timely incident reports, intelligence summaries, investigative memoranda, and executive-ready briefing materials. Travel, Executive, and Crisis Support Monitor employee and executive travel, assess destination and geopolitical risk, and support traveler accountability during incidents or emergencies. Provide operational and intelligence support for executive travel, protective operations, corporate events, and other elevated-risk activities. Monitor global incidents, severe weather, civil unrest, geopolitical developments, and other events that could affect company personnel or operations. Support crisis activations through situational awareness, communications, incident tracking, escalation, and preparation of situation reports. Program and Operational Support Work closely with Security Operations personnel to coordinate field response, information sharing, and operational support during incidents and special events. Support the Manager, GSOC & Intelligence with program documentation, procedures, audits, metrics, training materials, and special projects. Handle sensitive company, employee, investigative, and executive information with discretion and in accordance with established protocols. Maintain a professional, service-oriented approach when assisting employees, executives, visitors, law enforcement, vendors, and business partners. The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements: Education: Bachelor's degree in criminal justice, intelligence studies, security management, emergency management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Required Qualifications Minimum of five years of progressively responsible experience in law enforcement, intelligence, investigations, corporate security, military service, emergency management, or a related public safety field. Demonstrated experience with investigations, intelligence research, threat assessments, analytical research, or other complex security work beyond routine monitoring and dispatch. Ability to independently operate a command center environment, manage competing priorities, assess incomplete information, and make timely, defensible decisions. Excellent written communication and report-writing skills, including the ability to organize complex information into concise operational or executive summaries. Strong judgment, discretion, attention to detail, and ability to handle sensitive or confidential information. Working knowledge of CCTV, access control, alarm monitoring, incident management, mass notification, and common GSOC or physical security technologies. Strong computer proficiency, including Microsoft Office and the ability to learn investigative, intelligence, travel-monitoring, and security-system platforms. Ability to successfully complete required pre-employment screening and obtain required certifications after hire. Preferred Qualifications Prior law enforcement experience, particularly in investigations, intelligence, detective operations, emergency response, or command-center functions. Experience in a GSOC, Security Operations Center, Emergency Operations Center, Fusion Center, intelligence unit, investigative unit, or comparable environment. Experience with OSINT, social media research, threat management, travel security, executive protection support, or crisis monitoring. Relevant certifications such as APP, CPP, PSP, PCI, First Aid, CPR, AED, or similar credentials. job.description: Job Title GTM Manager, Ad Product Commercialization Job Description About The Position : The GTM Manager, Ad Product Commercialization is a mid-to-senior execution leader responsible for the day-to-day coordination, commercial readiness, and field adoption of our enterprise ad product portfolio. Based in our New York City office, this role serves as the critical, high-touch bridge between our product capabilities and sales execution. As the ultimate "keeper of the Ad Product Catalog," you will ensure that our New York-based revenue teams—including Sellers, Account Strategists, and Brand Marketers—fully understand our ad products, their operational nuances, and how to position them for maximum yield. Additionally, you will act as the on-the-ground project manager ushering new products through the formal GTM process, ensuring cross-functional alignment and gathering real-time field feedback to optimize our commercial engine. Hybrid 3x a week- NYC In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week. About The Team: The Ad Product Commercialization team partners across Product, Sales, Brand Marketing, Revenue Operations, Ad Operations, and Commercial organizations to successfully bring advertising products to market. The team enables revenue growth by ensuring product launches are well coordinated, sales teams are equipped for success, and customer feedback continuously informs product evolution. About The Position’s Contributions: 35% Ad Product Catalog Governance & Advisory Single Source of Truth: Own and maintain the comprehensive Ad Product Catalog. Ensure all product specifications, packaging rules, pricing guidelines, and operational constraints are meticulously updated, accurate, and accessible. Technical & Operational Advisory: Act as the primary, local "help desk" and subject matter expert for NYC-based Sellers and Account Strategists. Provide rapid, clear answers to complex, nuanced questions regarding ad product capabilities and custom configuration rules. Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with the Brand Marketing team to ensure that their client-facing narratives match the exact technical and operational realities housed in the product catalog. 35% GTM Program Management & Training Launch Traffic Control: Act as the dedicated project manager ushering individual products and packages through the formal GTM pipeline. Coordinate timelines, keep cross-functional stakeholders on schedule, and prevent rollout bottlenecks. Operational Readiness & Briefings: Translate dense, technical ad product mechanics into clear, digestible operational instructions. Lead internal briefings and training sessions for revenue teams detailing what a product is, who it is for, and how to book it. 30% Field Adoption & Commercial Yield Analysis Data-Driven Optimization: Regularly analyze internal sales data and product adoption metrics. Identify which packages are driving the highest yield and surface trends regarding what is selling well versus what isn't. On-the-Ground Feedback Loops: Leverage your physical presence in the NYC office to build deep trust with sellers and CROs. Proactively capture field feedback, understand seller pain points, and investigate the "why" behind product adoption data to inform future iterations. Experience partnering with Product, Sales, Marketing, and Operations teams in a fast-paced organization. job.description: Job Title Manager, Growth Marketing Platforms Job Description About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements The Platform Operations Manager plays an important role within the Growth team, ensuring excellence across our email and SMS programs. job.title: Senior Data Scientist
job.description: Job Title Senior Data Scientist Job Description About The Position | As a Senior Data Scientist for personalization, you will own the science behind the recommendation engine that powers each user’s personalized product feed. Starting from our user-saved product signals and a live catalog ingested from thousands of retailer feeds, you will design, build, evaluate, and continuously improve the models that learn each user’s taste across brand, category, color, price point, and fit. This is a hands-on, full-cycle role. You will take a recommendation problem from raw data all the way to a production model running on our existing MLOps stack — you own the model layer, not the infrastructure. Our platform team already operates the feature store, serving, and autoscaling; your job is to decide what to model, prove it works through rigorous offline and online experimentation, ship it, and iterate as behavioral signals accumulate. A defining challenge of this role is cold-start. We are launching with a small behavioral dataset and a catalog scaling from hundreds of thousands of products toward tens of millions. You will need strong commerce and product-data intuition to produce high-quality recommendations before rich click data exists — and the experimental discipline to keep improving them as it arrives. This is a foundational hire that will shape how millions of users discover products they love. Remote or Hybrid 3x a week NYC In-office Expectations: This position offers remote work flexibility; however, if you reside within a commutable distance our offices in New York, the expectation is to work from the office three days per week. About The Team: | _______________________________________________________________________________ Our next-generation product discovery platform connects shoppers with the things they love across thousands of retail partners. Users save, organize, and share products they're excited about — and our platform turns those signals into a deeply personalized shopping experience. We ingest live product feeds from thousands of retailers and use a rich understanding of each user's taste to surface the right product at the right moment. We're building the recommendation engine at the heart of this shopping experience — a system that understands not just what people save, but why they save it. This is a foundational hire that will shape how millions of users discover products they love. About The Positions Contributions: 35% Recommendation & Personalization Modeling Own the design and development of the core recommendation models that turn user-saved product data into a personalized feed. Develop multi-signal models spanning brand affinity, category, color/visual attributes, fit and sizing, price sensitivity, and trend. Select and justify approaches across collaborative filtering, matrix factorization, content-based, and hybrid/neural methods (e.g., two-tower and other embedding models), and know when each applies. Build product and user embeddings that capture semantic similarity across the catalog and power candidate generation and retrieval. Design cold-start strategies that produce high-quality recommendations for new users and newly ingested products with little or no behavioral history. 25% Experimentation & Measurement Define what “good” personalization means and how it is measured. Establish rigorous offline evaluation (ranking and relevance metrics, sound holdout design) and connect it to online outcomes. Design, run, and read out A/B and multivariate experiments, and translate results into clear product and business decisions. Bring statistical discipline — sound experiment design, awareness of bias and confounding, and honest interpretation — so the team can trust which changes actually move engagement. 20% Data, Signals & Feature Understanding Develop deep intuition for Picksy’s product catalog and user signals. Turn implicit behavior (saves, clicks, dwell, shares) and catalog attributes into meaningful model features, writing SQL against BigQuery to pull, join, and shape raw data into training/evaluation datasets. Apply NLP and computer-vision techniques — including modern embedding and LLM-based approaches — to extract structured attributes (category, color, material, fit) from unstructured product descriptions and imagery, and to enrich sparse catalog data. Partner with data engineering on data quality, freshness, and coverage as the catalog scales from hundreds of thousands toward tens of millions of products. 20% Full-Cycle Ownership & Productionization Take models from prototype to production yourself. Write clean, production-quality code and deploy into the existing MLOps pipeline (feature store, training, serving, monitoring) rather than building infrastructure from scratch. Own model performance in production: instrument it, watch for drift and degradation, and iterate as behavioral signals accumulate. Document models, features, and decisions clearly, and collaborate closely with the MLOps, engineering, and product teams to integrate the model layer into the live product. Education: Master's degree or higher in Computer Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field; or equivalent practical experience. Experience: You combine the modeling depth of an applied/data scientist with the pragmatism to ship end-to-end. You bring: Strong data science fundamentals: statistics, experimental design, and evaluation methodology, with the analytical ability to turn model results into clear product and business decisions. Demonstrated ownership of the full A/B testing lifecycle: designing experiments, running them, reading them out, and deciding; not just reporting offline metrics. Experience designing, training, and deploying embedding models and vector retrieval (e.g., Milvus, Pinecone, or Vertex AI Vector Search) for product or content similarity at catalog scale. Direct experience with cold-start / sparse-signal personalization: building useful recommendations from a new catalog, new users, or both. This is a core, day-one challenge of the role. Strong Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX) plus the standard scientific stack (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn). You write production-quality code, not just notebooks. Strong SQL: hands-on experience querying large datasets in a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery preferred) to pull, join, and assemble the training and evaluation datasets that feed your models. This is a daily part of the role. Experience deploying and serving models on a cloud ML platform: GCP Vertex AI strongly preferred (SageMaker or equivalent acceptable) and you are comfortable owning the full model lifecycle: training, deployment, versioning, and monitoring. Commerce intuition: you’ve worked with product catalogs and understand merchandising, category, and PM concerns. It shows up in how you talk about catalogs and taste, not just models. Curiosity and pragmatism about emerging AI, particularly LLMs and modern retrieval/ranking, with a track record of bringing new techniques into real production use. Strong written and verbal communication; able to explain technical tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Nice to have: Applied NLP and/or computer vision for extracting structured attributes from product text and imagery. Experience with adaptive recommendation and experimentation methods; multi-armed or contextual bandits. Public writing or conference talks on recommendation, personalization, or ranking work. Early-stage or commerce experience where you wore multiple hats and shipped against real business metrics (e.g., commerce SaaS or a vertical commerce startup). Partner with internal teams to identify new ways to monetize brand initiatives and equip sales teams with relevant materials for market activation. 100% III. job.title: Senior Product Manager, Privacy & Trust
job.description: Job Title Senior Product Manager, Privacy & Trust Job Description About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to take charge of our data privacy and platform strategy. You will be the point person for balancing our business needs, like audience growth and personalization, with the reality of global privacy regulations. This role is a mix of high-level roadmap planning and deep-in-the-weeds technical problem solving, specifically regarding our Data Subject Request (DSR) platform. Hybrid 3x a week- (New York, NY) In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week. About The Team: At People Inc., we treat reader trust as our most valuable asset. This role is not just building a platform; this role is building the infrastructure that allows our readers to trust us with their data. This team solves hard, "real-world" technical problems that have a tangible impact. About The Positions Contributions: Weight % | Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results 20% | Own the DSR Platform Our current DSR process needs work. You will lead the roadmap to evolve this from a compliance checkbox into a scalable, automated system that handles access, deletion, and portability requests across all our data silos. 20% | Balance Privacy & Product You’ll define how we manage data and identity. The goal is to stay fully compliant (GDPR, CCPA/CPRA) without sacrificing the user experience or our ability to deliver relevant content. 20% | Build the Foundation Partner with engineering to modernize our data architecture. You need to understand our data lineage, governance, and security well enough to guide architectural decisions across different business units. 20% | Make Privacy User-Friendly Stop treating privacy as a legal chore. You will design transparent, user-centric flows that actually help our readers understand their data, which in turn builds long-term brand trust. 20% | Cross-Functional Strategy You’ll be the bridge between Legal, AdTech, and Engineering. You need to be able to explain the technical risk to legal, and the regulatory requirements to our engineering leads. The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements Education: Bachelor’s degree is preferred and/or equivalent experience. Experience: 5+ years in product management owning backend platforms. A candidate who has worked in data-heavy environments or managed compliance-related products or identity systems is required. Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities: DSR Platform Expertise: Experience developing or expanding DSR systems. You understand the friction involved in verifying identities and synchronizing data across disconnected stacks and have a vision for automation. Technical Authority: Ability to lead technical discussions with engineers. You possess a strong grasp of APIs, data flow, and warehouse environments like BigQuery or Snowflake to guide fundamental architectural choices. Articulate Communication: Skill in distilling complex legal mandates or technical constraints into clear, actionable insights for leadership across Legal, Editorial, and Revenue teams. job.description: Job Title Senior Software Engineer 1, Picksy Services Job Description Picksy is our next-generation product discovery platform connecting shoppers with the things they love across thousands of retail partners. Users save, organize, and share products they're excited about — and our platform turns those signals into a deeply personalized shopping experience. This team owns the foundational product data, services, applications, and integrations that power the Picksy experience. Hybrid 3x per week In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week. About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements ____________________________________________________________________________________________ As a Senior Software Engineer on Picksy Services, you'll take ownership of solution design and implementation for scalable, highly available services, while mentoring other engineers and helping shape the team's technical direction. You'll work closely with product owners, designers, and fellow engineers to translate requirements into prototypes and world-class features, and you'll be a go-to voice on architecture decisions and best practices across the team. You will: Partner with engineers across data, web, and mobile experiences to build and evolve the foundational services powering Picksy. Design and implement new services, APIs, and operational monitoring functions. Own production services end-to-end — investigating issues, resolving bottlenecks, and proactively identifying opportunities to improve reliability and reduce cost. Lead code reviews and mentor other engineers, setting the bar for code quality and advocating for best practices across the team. Drive the identification and prioritization of technical debt. Provide thorough, readable documentation for the services you own. Partner with engineers across the org to establish and align on shared best practices. Bring strong technical judgment to ambiguous problems, and deliver high-quality, complex services under tight timelines. About The Positions Contributions: Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results 50% Feature implementation: Work closely with stakeholders, product owners, and tech leadership to plan and create new services, features, and enhancements. 15% Architecture: Lead technical design of new and expanding systems; drive identification and prioritization of technical debt; proactively identify opportunities to improve reliability and reduce cost. 15% Maintenance: Own production services end-to-end; investigate, troubleshoot, and implement fixes for bugs and operational issues. 10% Review, Mentorship & Testing: Lead code reviews and mentor other engineers, setting the bar for code quality; work closely with quality-assurance engineers to facilitate feature testing and contribute to automated test coverage. 10% Requirements Analysis: Consume non-technical user stories, providing feedback when necessary, translating into technical documentation, and/or using as a basis for implementation. The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements Education: Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or relevant industry experience. Experience: 6+ years of relevant professional technology experience. Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities: You have practical knowledge of modern development techniques and trends, and you are eager to continue learning. You have: Demonstrated deep understanding of REST, service architecture, monitoring, and the tenets of horizontal scalability. Experience developing complex and highly available services running in a production environment with SLAs. Extensive knowledge of object-oriented and functional software design patterns, including those commonly used within large web application platforms. Proven experience developing and owning production services and applications deployed in AWS or GCP, leveraging containers, continuous integration, and codified infrastructure. Extensive experience using Node.js, TypeScript, and the NestJS framework, with some knowledge of Java and GraphQL. Familiarity with HTML/CSS and frontend web frameworks such as Vue or Nuxt (strongly preferred). Knowledge of NoSQL data stores, graph databases, indexing, distributed locking, media transformation, and search engines such as Elasticsearch or Solr. Experience working in an Agile environment, translating user stories into technical tasks and estimating effort effectively. Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Experience leading architecture discussions, advocating for your approach, and mentoring team members. Motivation to learn new technologies and grow as a developer. job.description: KATZ Radio Group Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title. As the nation’s largest media representation firm, Katz Media Group delivers local relevance at scale. Whether you want one idea that sounds local in a hundred different markets or a hundred unique ideas, we have your solution. Over our long history, the Katz name has been synonymous with leadership in the media industry. Founded in 1888, Katz was the nation’s first media representation firm. Today, Katz Media Group is comprised of two divisions, Katz Radio Group and Katz Television Group. Collectively, the company represents both the on-air and online assets of more than 4,000 radio stations and 800 television stations, making Katz Media Group the largest media representation company in America. In addition to our deeply rooted media expertise, our unique regional sales structure is key to driving our clients’ success. Katz Media Group is based in New York City, with 15 regional offices across the country, providing advertisers and agencies with local expertise and insights across the nation. Be a part of the largest media representation company in America. At Katz Media Group, we have the best, brightest and boldest talent in the media industry — individuals who deliver unparalleled value for our business partners and clients. We are looking for people who can grow, think, dream and achieve. Every employee brings inspiration and imagination to our constantly evolving and expanding business. If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Katz Media we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do! What We Need: At Katz Media Group, we strive for success and support our teams that are dedicated to excellence in client service. You’ll play a vital role in helping our sales teams deliver on our mission to super-serve our clients and listeners. You’ll be the operational backbone that ensures our sales process runs smoothly, efficiently, and with heart. What You'll Do: Support Account Executives in the pre-sale and post-sale process, including proposal development, order entry, campaign tracking, and reporting. Coordinate with internal departments (traffic, production, digital, promotions) to ensure flawless execution of campaigns across radio, digital, podcast, social, and event platforms. Prepare sales materials such as presentations, recaps, and client-facing documents using tools like PowerPoint, Salesforce, and internal systems. Monitor campaign performance and assist in compiling data for client reporting and renewals. Manage deadlines and deliverables to ensure all client expectations are met or exceeded. Serve as a liaison between sales, programming, and operations to ensure alignment and communication. Assist with billing and reconciliation to ensure accuracy and timely processing. What You'll Need: Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel and PowerPoint); Salesforce experience is a plus. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. A collaborative mindset and a passion for delivering exceptional client service. What You'll Bring: Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return Ability to work within standardized procedures and an understanding of when to escalate Skills to solve straightforward problems using established procedures Close attention to detail, following up until issues are resolved Common courtesy when communicating with coworkers and outside contacts Compensation: Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and alignment with market data. $19.78 - $24.73 Location: New York, NY: 125 West 55th Street, 10019 Position Type: Regular Time Type: Full time Pay Type: Hourly Benefits: iHeartMedia’s benefits offering is flexible and offers a variety of choices to meet the diverse needs of our changing workforce, including the following: Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options Company provided and supplemental life insurance Paid vacation and sick time Paid company holidays A Spirit day to encourage and allow our employees to more easily volunteer in their community A 401K plan Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost – services include telephonic counseling sessions, consultation on legal and financial matters, emotional well-being, family and caregiving ​A range of additional voluntary programs, such as spending accounts, student loan refinancing, accident insurance and more!
