job.title: Chief Engineer/Broadcast, IT Operations
job.description: We value our talented employees, and whenever possible strive to help one of our associates grow professionally before recruiting new talent to our open positions. If you think the open position you see is right for you, we encourage you to apply! Our people make all the difference in our success. WTEN/WXXA-TV, in Albany, New York are seeking a skilled and motivated Chief Engineer/Broadcast IT Operations Manager to oversee the day-to-day operations and strategic planning of the Engineering and IT Departments. This hybrid leadership role bridges traditional broadcast engineering with modern IP-based workflows and cloud computing, ensuring the seamless delivery of live and recorded content across multiple platforms. The successful candidate will manage personnel, ensure strict regulatory compliance, execute capital projects, and maintain high-availability redundancy systems to support 24/7 broadcast and digital operations. Key Responsibilities & Duties Departmental Leadership & Management Unified Management: Manage all operational aspects of the Engineering and Broadcast IT Departments. Team Leadership: Lead, schedule, and mentor a combined team of IT professionals and broadcast engineers, ensuring adequate coverage for 24/7 operations. HR Functions: Make authoritative decisions regarding hiring, evaluations, promotions, and terminations. Staff Development: Identify developmental needs, set performance standards, and coach staff to improve their knowledge of both traditional RF and modern IP technologies. Workflow Supervision: Assign projects, manage schedules, and track milestones to guarantee deadlines are met. Broadcast IT & Cloud Operations System Management: Manage and maintain all broadcast IT systems, including playout, media asset management (MAM), video servers, routers, storage systems, and IP-based infrastructure. Cloud & Newsroom Tech: Oversee cloud-based newsroom and content systems, ensuring optimized studio, control room, and production workflows. Business Continuity: Develop, maintain, and test redundancy systems and business continuity plans to prevent downtime. Tech Migration: Plan and execute software upgrades, technology migrations (e.g., baseband to IP), and facility improvements. Traditional Broadcast & Infrastructure Equipment Maintenance: Direct the maintenance, troubleshooting, and servicing of all station broadcast technology and hardware. A/V & Production: Oversee fiber connectivity, production setups, A/V routing and patching, audio equipment, graphics systems, and editing platforms. Transmission Systems: Maintain and troubleshoot digital transmitters, microwave equipment, and other specialized broadcast RF gear. Communication Systems: Maintain and troubleshoot analog and digital phone and intercom systems. Compliance, Strategy & Collaboration Regulatory Compliance: Ensure total station adherence to FCC rules and regulations, as well as all applicable local, state, and federal laws. Capital Projects: Partner with corporate leadership to manage engineering and technology capital projects strictly within established budgets. Cross-Departmental Collaboration: Work closely with News, Production, and other departments to support live news broadcasts and post-production workflows. Other Duties: Perform additional operational and technical duties as assigned. Requirements & Qualifications Education & Experience Education: Bachelor’s degree or Technical degree in Digital Electronics, Broadcasting, Information Technology, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Industry Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in broadcast, IT, and/or television production environments. Leadership Experience: Minimum of 3 years in a management or supervisory role leading technical teams. Certifications: Cisco CCNA, SBE (Society of Broadcast Engineers), and/or SMPTE certifications are a strong plus. Technical & Functional Skills Networking Expertise: Solid grasp of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, UDP, Spanning Tree, and network performance optimization. Cloud Computing: Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and Content Delivery Networks (CDNs). IP & Streaming: Strong knowledge of IP video, video encoding/decoding, streaming protocols (HLS, DASH, RTMP), and automation/cloud-based playout systems. Should have strong working knowledge of Dante digital audio, certification preferred. Traditional Broadcast: Extensive experience evaluating, installing, and servicing traditional broadcasting equipment, digital transmitters, and A/V routing. Core Competencies & Other Requirements Crisis Management: Exceptional ability to remain calm under pressure and logically solve complex technical issues during live broadcasts. Communication: Excellent leadership, project management, and communication skills (written and oral) in English. Flexibility: Ability to work varied hours, including rotating shifts, weekends, and holidays, to accommodate live news broadcasts, special events, and remote productions. Licensing: Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record. Compensation Range: $80,000 - $98,000 annually, commensurate with experience. We offer a competitive salary as well as health, dental and vision plan, 401K and many other benefits. All employees must first contact their current manager before applying for an Internal position.

job.title: Director I, Production
job.description: The Newscast Director coordinates and executes all technical aspects of live and recorded productions, including daily newscasts, special programming, and remote broadcasts. This position is responsible for directing technical staff, operating production equipment, and ensuring broadcasts are executed accurately, efficiently, and to the station's quality standards. Essential Duties & Responsibilities Coordinate the efforts of all technical operators during live newscasts and other live or recorded productions. Direct and oversee technical execution of broadcasts, ensuring accurate timing and smooth transitions. Supervise and assign duties to production personnel engaged in technical control and program production. Collaborate with producers, anchors, reporters, and technical teams to deliver a clean, accurate, and engaging newscast. Serve as a liaison between the Engineering, Production, and News departments to ensure operational readiness and resolve technical issues. Operate production switchers and other control room equipment during live broadcasts. Direct multiple technical elements simultaneously, including cameras, graphics, audio, playback, and other production sources. Train and mentor camera operators, graphics operators, and other production staff on proper operational procedures and broadcast standards. Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Broadcasting, Communications, Television Production, or a related field preferred. Minimum of two years of television production or news operations experience, preferably in a live news environment. Prior experience directing live newscasts is preferred. Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Strong understanding of television production workflows and control room operations. Proficiency with broadcast production systems, video switchers, graphics systems, playback servers, and newsroom computer systems. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to multitask, prioritize assignments, and meet strict deadlines. Ability to remain calm and effective under pressure during live broadcasts and breaking news coverage. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Working knowledge of computers, office equipment, and production technology. Ability to work flexible hours, including mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours during breaking news or special events. Pay range for this position is $22 - $28 per hour.

job.title: Head of Ad Sales, The Hill
job.description: The Head of Ad Sales at The Hill will be responsible for leading the organization’s advertising sales strategy, revenue growth, and go-to-market approach across digital, video, events, branded content, and emerging platforms. This executive will serve as a highly visible commercial leader for The Hill, with a particular focus on strengthening its position and value proposition within the Washington, D.C. marketplace and expanding relationships with advertisers and agencies nationally. A critical component of the role will be serving as a strong external voice and ambassador for The Hill, evangelizing the strength of the brand, its highly influential audience, and its differentiated value to marketers seeking to reach policymakers, government decision-makers, business leaders, and other key constituencies. The ideal candidate will bring an established network of senior-level relationships with clients, agencies, associations, advocacy organizations, government affairs organizations, and other key stakeholders within Washington, D.C. and beyond. This leader will be expected to personally drive significant revenue opportunities while building and executing a broader sales strategy that accelerates growth, expands The Hill’s advertiser base, and creates new commercial opportunities across the portfolio. Key Responsibilities · Advertising Sales Strategy & Revenue Growth: Develop and execute a comprehensive advertising sales strategy designed to accelerate revenue growth, increase market share, diversify the client base, and maximize the value of The Hill’s audience and brand. · Marketplace Leadership & Brand Evangelism: Serve as a highly visible external representative of The Hill in Washington, D.C. and the broader advertising marketplace, clearly articulating and evangelizing The Hill’s value proposition, audience, influence, and differentiated capabilities. · Client & Agency Relationships: Leverage and expand an established network of senior relationships across clients, advertising agencies, government affairs firms, associations, advocacy organizations, political organizations, and other influential constituencies to generate new business and deepen existing partnerships. · Direct Revenue Generation: Actively participate in the sales process, personally developing and closing high-value strategic partnerships while supporting the broader sales organization in unlocking incremental opportunities. · Go-to-Market Strategy: Define and continually evolve The Hill’s commercial positioning, sales narratives, packaging, pricing strategies, and marketplace approach across digital, video, branded content, events, sponsorships, and emerging advertising products. · Strategic Partnerships: Identify and develop enterprise-level, integrated partnerships that leverage The Hill’s unique position at the intersection of politics, policy, business, and culture. Proactively create commercial opportunities around major policy, industry, and national moments, leveraging The Hill’s editorial authority, influential audience, and convening power. · Consultative Sales Leadership: Help evolve the sales organization toward a more strategic, consultative approach by translating marketplace trends, policy developments, audience insights, and client priorities into relevant, differentiated commercial opportunities. · New Business Development: Expand The Hill’s advertiser base beyond traditional categories by identifying high-growth sectors, emerging demand, and new opportunities to connect brands with influential audiences. · Events & Sponsorship Strategy: Lead the commercial strategy for The Hill’s events and experiential business, developing sponsorship models and integrated programs that strengthen both revenue and client engagement. · Product & Commercial Innovation: Partner with internal teams to identify and develop new advertising products, audience solutions, data capabilities, and revenue streams based on evolving advertiser needs and marketplace trends. · Sales Leadership: Lead, inspire, and develop a high-performing sales organization with a strong culture of accountability, collaboration, client service, and revenue growth. · Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with editorial, marketing, product, audience development, research, and other teams to translate The Hill’s content, audience, and brand strengths into compelling advertiser solutions while maintaining appropriate editorial independence. · Market Intelligence: Maintain a deep understanding of trends across media, advertising, politics, public affairs, advocacy, and Washington’s influence economy to ensure The Hill remains ahead of emerging marketplace opportunities. Requirements & Skills · Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. · Minimum of 7 years of progressive advertising sales & management experience, with a demonstrated track record of leading and growing a significant media, digital, publishing, political, public affairs, or related advertising business. · Established and deep relationships with senior clients, agencies, and key constituents throughout the Washington, D.C. marketplace, as well as relationships that extend into the broader national advertising ecosystem. · Proven ability to personally develop, negotiate, and close large-scale advertising and strategic partnership opportunities. · Demonstrated success developing and executing sales strategies that deliver meaningful revenue growth and expand market share. · Strong digital advertising expertise, including experience across video, branded content, sponsorships, events, audience targeting, data-driven advertising, and emerging media platforms. · Exceptional executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to serve as a credible and compelling marketplace spokesperson and evangelist for The Hill. · Strong understanding of Washington, D.C.’s political, policy, advocacy, association, corporate affairs, and government affairs ecosystem. · Experience leading, developing, and motivating high-performing sales teams. · Strategic, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to identify new revenue streams, develop differentiated solutions, and translate marketplace opportunities into scalable commercial strategies. · Ability to operate effectively across a highly collaborative organization and build strong relationships with senior internal and external stakeholders. · MBA or comparable advanced business experience is a plus. Compensation Range: $325k-$375k

Help us broadcast and program commercials from coast to coast in Traffic operations hubs located in Salt Lake City! Nexstar owns America’s largest local broadcasting group comprised of top network affiliates, with 200 owned or partner stations in 117 U.S. markets reaching 220 million people. In addition to delivering exceptional content and service to our communities, Nexstar provides premium multiplatform and video-on-demand advertising opportunities at scale for businesses and brands seeking to leverage the strong consumer engagement of our compelling content offering. We are extremely proud of our collection of outstanding television stations, digital businesses and talented employees nationwide. Within Nexstar, we are investing and building for the future while forging a culture that promotes our entrepreneurial spirit, embraces bold thinking and challenges the conventional way. If you have curiosity, passion, are inclusive and collaborative, work with us and let’s continue to make a difference for all our stakeholders ~ our colleagues, our customers, our owners, and the communities in which we operate. job.title: Administrative Assistant (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
Summary/Objective

This role will support the NFL’s departmental leads (three Senior Vice Presidents) with a focus on daily administrative and core operational support across these core functions of the League, in order to drive efficiency and optimize the productivity of these teams and leaders.

General Administrative Support:

  • Coordinate and schedule meetings and conference calls
  • Manager calendars across different time zones
  • Create and distribute agendas
  • Answer and route telephone calls and incoming mail
  • Arrange and manage travel schedules and travel expenses
  • Track and process P-Card transactions and expenses
  • Prepare meeting materials and presentations
  • Create templates for letters and memos
  • Track and maintain department inventory and materials

Operations Support:

  • Processing of invoices, setting up new vendors and other financial system operations on behalf of the department
  • Creating templated agreements and routing contracts through Docusign and other systems
  • Processing staffing and credential needs for events and meetings
  • Write and issue correspondence to key partners, NFL clubs, vendors, and fans.

Required Qualifications

  • Prior experience supporting one or more senior leaders, executives, or C-suite stakeholders in an administrative or executive assistant capacity.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex calendars, travel arrangements, meeting coordination, and expense reporting.
  • Must have exceptional prioritizing, organizational, communication, initiative, judgment and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to prioritize competing requests and maintain confidentiality in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Degree from a Four-Year College or University.
  • Experience supporting multiple executives simultaneously.
  • Experience coordinating across multiple departments and stakeholders.
  • Experience within sports, media, entertainment, or a similarly fast-paced corporate environment.

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

This job posting is for a position with one of the NFL’s third-party agency partners that provides services to the NFL. The individual selected for this role will be an employee of that third-party agency and not the NFL. All compensation, benefits, and other terms and conditions of employment

Salary / Pay Range

This job posting contains a pay range, which represents the range of salaries or hourly rates that the NFL believes, in good faith, at the time of this posting that it might be willing to pay for the posted job in the location(s) specified. The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. Only in truly rare and exceptional circumstances, where an external candidate has experience, credentials or expertise that far exceed those required or expected for the position, would the NFL consider paying a salary or rate near the higher end of the range.

Salary
$35—$35 USD

Benefits Information
To learn more about our comprehensive benefits offerings, please visit: NFL BENEFITS

At the NFL, in-person work at our offices is a top priority because it allows us to collaborate more effectively, build stronger connections, and maintain the culture that drives our success. This role requires onsite presence at an NFL office or stadium location, and remote and/or hybrid working options are not offered.

NO RELOCATION ASSISTANCE WILL BE PROVIDED.

job.title: Associate, Hotels & Meetings (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
The NFL Live Events team is responsible for the planning and execution of the league’s tentpole events and International Games. The Associate position plays an integral role in supporting the Events team with the execution of all tentpole events and executive meetings with a focus on hotel management, meeting planning and execution.

This is a long-term hourly contract opportunity based onsite at the NFL League Office in New York, NY.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage the execution of 100+ hotel contracts for future Super Bowl and Draft bids and assist with onboarding process through our supplier portal.
  • Assist with the RFP process and hotel sourcing strategy for NFL International Games, which includes identifying and securing staff, vendor, and headquarters hotel accommodations while managing contract negotiations, and working with Finance on budget considerations.
  • Support the Super Bowl hotel assignment process by working closely with departments and partners assigning 20,000 rooms.
  • Manage hotel reservations for 800+ attendees at all tentpole events which include Super Bowl, Pro Bowl, Combine, Draft, Flag Championships, Hall of Fame, Kickoff, International games and meetings.
  • Execute Super Bowl headquarter hotel operations that include contract management, hotel reservations, meeting space logistics, food & beverage, signage, and vendor coordination.
  • Coordinate planning meetings across all tentpole events for current year and future. This entails sourcing hotels through our RFP platform and tracking proposals.
  • Lead effort for on-site event management for Owners Meetings and department meetings including room block management, client check-in, credential distribution, and registration.
  • Attend all planning meetings, as needed for current and future tentpole events and outline goals and objectives for each trip.
  • Work cross functionally with various internal departments on meetings throughout the year.
  • Reconcile budgets and invoices with finance team on for all tentpole events and meetings.
  • Support the team in various capacities including contract management, updating the special events calendar and tracking budgets.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Minimum 2 years of hotel with a focus on room management and function room operations
  • Adept at contract negotiations and proven experience working with hotel contracts
  • Hotel and venue management with a focus on room block build/management, attrition mitigation, function room costing and management
  • Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment
  • Ability to lead others and collaborate with a variety of groups at different levels
  • Strong organizational and presentation skills
  • Strong writing and communications skills
  • Proactive self-starter who works well within a team, strong interpersonal skills

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with hotel contracts, negotiating, and meeting planning
  • Experience with Meeting Evolution, Cvent or other event registration sites
  • Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills
  • C level/VIP management and service
  • Knowledge in RFP creation and process

Other Key Attributes / Talent Characteristics:

  • Team player with positive attitude
  • High energy
  • Entrepreneurial spirit
  • Strong work ethic

Physical Demands:

This is a Special Events hotel and VIP management role, at times may require physicality. This could involve lifting, long hours of standing and physical movement during an event and extensive travel requirements.

Travel:

Significant domestic and international travel required, including some weekends, up to 50%. Several weeks on the road during event delivery.

Terms /Expected Hours of Work:

job.title: Associate, HR Operations
job.description:
Overview:

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented HR Operations Coordinator to join our Shared Services team. This role is helping to enhance the NFL employee experience and scale our HR capabilities. You will have an immediate impact on the overall NFL employee experience as the first point of contact for many employees, ensuring timely and accurate support throughout the employee lifecycle. You will manage HR tickets, process transactions in Oracle HCM. In this highly collaborative role, you will maintain strong working relationships with cross-functional teams, including HR, Payroll, Finance, Compliance, Security, and IT.

Responsibilities:

  • Case Management:
    Manage and resolve tier-1 HR inquiries through ServiceNow, ensuring timely, accurate, and professional responses all questions and issues regarding HR related policies, procedures, and systems, including but not limited to Onboarding, Benefits, Compensation, Learning, Performance, and Offboarding.
  • Process HR transactions including new hires, rehires, transfers, leaves of absence, terminations, personal data changes, and other complicated system transactions
  • Support the talent acquisition processes by posting job requisitions, managing the candidate experience, extending offers, and facilitating onboarding activities.
  • HR Systems Support:
    Enter and maintain employee data in Oracle HCM Cloud, ServiceNow, and UGK, supporting lifecycle transactions and identifying opportunities to streamline or automate recurring processes.
  • Maintain positive working relationships with cross-functional teams as necessary, including Payroll, Finance, Compliance, Security, and IT.

Required Qualifications:

  • Experience:
    2–4+ years in HR Operations, Shared Services, HRIS, or an HR support role. Experience with ServiceNow (or similar ticketing system), Oracle HCM Cloud and UGK preferred.
  • Soft Skills:
    • Positive attitude and strong work ethic.
    • Customer-first mindset with a pleasant, team-oriented demeanor.
    • Eagerness to learn and grow in both HR operations and analytics.
    • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
    • Clear and concise communication skills to collaborate across functions.

Other Key Attributes / Talent Characteristics:

You are driven to improve processes, deliver excellent employee support, and ensure data accuracy. You thrive in collaborative, cross-functional environments and are excited to shape the future of HR Shared Services.

Why Join Us?

You'll be part of a growing HR Operations team that's focused on efficiency, innovation, and elevating the employee experience. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their HR career who wants to grow in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

job.title: Coordinator, Accounting - Global Media
job.description:
The Coordinator, Accounting for Global Media supports accounting operations within the Global Media division, ensuring timely and accurate processing of financial transactions in accordance with accounting policies and procedures. This role assists with journal entries, reconciliations, and month-end close activities to maintain accurate financial records. The position collaborates with Finance and business partners to ensure consistency, compliance, and efficiency across media-related accounting activities.

Responsibilities:

  • Assist with the end-to-end accounting cycle for Global Media, including preparation of journal entries and reconciliations for Media Owned and Operated businesses including the Digital content businesses.
  • Support monthly close activities, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to established deadlines.
  • Provide timely close variance explanations to Finance team.
  • Maintain compliance with accounting policies, US GAAP standards, and internal control requirements.
  • Collect and validate financial data to support management reporting and analysis.
  • Coordinate with Finance and business partners to resolve accounting discrepancies and ensure consistent reporting.
  • Assist with audit requests by providing accurate schedules and supporting documentation.
  • Contribute to process improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency and accuracy within accounting operations.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university.
  • Minimum of 2-3+ years of relevant experience

job.title: Director, Communications - Flag Football
job.description:
The NFL is seeking a Director, Communications – Flag Football to lead strategic communications for one of the fastest growing areas of the sport. This role will help grow awareness, credibility, and participation in flag football in the U.S. and internationally, while supporting the NFL’s leadership through NFL FLAG and the broader flag football ecosystem.

The Director will shape the narrative for flag football by elevating stories around access, inclusion, athlete pathways, youth and scholastic participation, community impact, and elite competition. This leader will develop integrated media, content, executive visibility, and thought-leadership strategies tied to major growth moments, including NFL tentpole events, flag-specific events, international activations, and the LA28 Olympic Games.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute a multi-year communications strategy that advances flag football growth across youth, scholastic, community, elite, and international levels.
  • Lead storytelling, media relations, executive visibility, and issues preparedness tied to LA28, Brisbane 2032, and long-term Olympic inclusion.
  • Create communications and advocacy materials that support NFHS and state association sanctioning efforts, including stakeholder messaging, announcement plans, and media materials.
  • Drive proactive press strategy across national, local, youth/scholastic, community, lifestyle, sports business, and international media.
  • Partner with Football Operations, International, Marketing, Social, Player Engagement, Legends, Clubs, and external partners across the flag football ecosystem.
  • Lead communications planning and on-site media operations for flag-specific showcases, championships, clinics, activations, and relevant NFL tentpole events.
  • Develop message guides, press materials, briefing documents, FAQs, social/content inputs, and partner-facing assets aligned with league style and terminology.
  • Establish communications KPIs, track performance, report progress, and maintain talking points, holding statements, Q&As, and response plans for flag-related issues.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing, or a related field.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in communications, public relations, media relations, corporate communications, brand communications, or sports communications.
  • Proven success in developing communications strategies that drive awareness, engagement, participation, reputation, or business outcomes.
  • Strong media relationships and experience with narrative development, message development, executive communications, and spokesperson preparation.
  • Experience leading communications planning, press operations, and on-site media execution at major events.
  • Ability to translate research, participation trends, insights, and performance metrics into clear, compelling stories.
  • Sound judgment, discretion, and composure in fast-paced, high-visibility environments.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in sports, youth/scholastic programming, community impact, grassroots participation, international communications, or major events.
  • Familiarity with schools, state associations, community organizations, clubs, leagues, federations, or governing bodies.
  • Passion for growing youth sports participation and expanding access, inclusion, and pathways for athletes.

Other Key Attributes / Talent Characteristics:

  • Builds trusted relationships and collaborates effectively across teams, partners, and senior stakeholders.
  • Communicates with clarity, confidence, and composure in high-pressure situations.
  • Solves problems, removes barriers, and keeps workstreams moving.
  • Motivates teams and partners to innovate and deliver measurable impact.
  • Supports the growth and development of colleagues, agencies, and partners.

Travel:

  • On-site presence and travel as needed for NFL tentpole events, flag-specific events, and activations throughout the season.

Terms / Expected Hours of Work:

  • NFL employees are required to work a minimum of 40 hours per week onsite, five days per week in our League office in NYC.

Salary / Pay Range

The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. Only in truly rare and exceptional circumstances, where an external candidate has experience, credentials, or expertise that far exceed those required or expected for the position, would the NFL consider paying a salary or rate near the higher end of the range.

job.title: Director, Fan Engagement Marketing – International Club CRM & Performance Marketing
job.description:
The National Football League (NFL) is seeking an experienced international marketing leader to play a key role in operating and scaling its International 1:1 Club Managed Services function.

This role leads day-to-day execution and operational delivery of a centralized, internal agency model that enables all 32 Clubs to execute compliant, high-quality, localized 1:1 fan engagement across more than 20 international markets.

The Director ensures Clubs receive reliable, scalable support across email, SMS, mobile app, web, and emerging channels by operationalizing league data, platforms, and best practices. Success is measured by execution quality, operational reliability, campaign performance, regulatory adherence, and Club satisfaction, while enabling sustained international fan development.

Responsibilities:

  • International Club Managed Services Execution
    • Support the Senior Director in operating the International 1:1 Club Managed Services model as an internal agency serving all 32 Clubs.
    • Execute against the defined service offering, engagement model, SLAs, intake processes, and prioritization frameworks.
    • Ensure consistent, high-quality delivery across markets, time zones, and languages.
  • Global Operations & Workforce Enablement
    • Manage day-to-day operations of a distributed global workforce (including contingent associates across multiple regions).
    • Implement operating rhythms, workflows, training standards, and QA processes to support high-volume international execution.
    • Support capacity planning and workload balancing to meet Club demand while maintaining quality and compliance.
  • International 1:1 Marketing Delivery
    • Oversee execution of Club-led, league-enabled 1:1 campaigns across email, SMS, push, in-app, and web.
    • Ensure campaigns appropriately leverage behavioral, transactional, and engagement signals within market-specific constraints.
    • Apply testing frameworks and performance insights to drive continuous improvement at scale.
  • Data Privacy, Governance & Compliance Support
    • Execute established data governance and compliance standards for international fan data and PII usage.
    • Partner closely with Legal, Data & Analytics, and MarTech teams to ensure campaign execution aligns with GDPR and local market regulations.
    • Translate regulatory requirements into clear, executable guidelines for managed service teams and Clubs.
  • Club Enablement & Relationship Support
    • Act as a primary operational point of contact for Clubs on international 1:1 campaign execution and best practices.
    • Support Club adoption by delivering reliable service, clear communication, and timely issue resolution.
    • Escalate risks, constraints, and opportunities to the Senior Director with recommended solutions.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination & Reporting
    • Partner with International, Marketing, Data & Analytics, and MarTech teams to align execution with league priorities.
    • Support quarterly planning cycles by translating demand forecasts into execution plans.
    • Contribute to performance reporting, operational insights, and recommendations for scaling impact.

Required Qualifications:

  • 8-10+ years' of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, or performance-driven engagement, with international exposure
  • Experience operating within managed services, agency, or shared-services models, ideally in global environments
  • Working knowledge of international data privacy and marketing regulations and their executional implications
  • Demonstrated experience managing distributed teams or partners across regions and time zones
  • Strong executional fluency with MarTech platforms (CDPs, journey orchestration, messaging platforms)
  • Ability to manage high-volume, deadline-driven workflows with consistency and accuracy
  • Background in sports, entertainment, or global consumer brands

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting or scaling internal agency or managed services models in complex organizations
  • Strong operational instincts with the ability to translate strategy into repeatable execution
  • Comfortable working in matrixed environments with multiple stakeholders and dependencies
  • Experience partnering with Legal, Data, and Technology teams in regulated markets
  • Global mindset with sensitivity to cultural and regional differences in fan engagement

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics:

  • Execution-focused operator who takes pride in reliable delivery and operational excellence
  • Service-oriented mindset with a strong commitment to supporting Clubs as internal clients
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple concurrent workstreams
  • Clear, proactive communicator who escalates issues early and constructively
  • Comfortable operating under pressure in high-volume, time-sensitive environments

job.title: Director, Professional & Adult Competitive Flag Football
job.description:
The NFL is accelerating the growth of flag football as one of the world's fastest-growing sports and a cornerstone of the future of football. With flag football set to debut at the Los Angeles 2028 Olympic Games, expanding international competition through the International Federation of American Football (IFAF), and the launch of a new professional flag football league in partnership with TMRW Sports, the NFL is making unprecedented investments in the sport's competitive ecosystem worldwide.

The Director, Professional & Adult Competitive Flag Football will help lead the NFL's efforts to strengthen and expand the global competitive flag football landscape. This role will be responsible for managing strategic relationships, developing competition-focused initiatives, and supporting the growth of domestic and international flag football across professional, national team, club, tournament, and recreational environments.

The ideal candidate combines a deep understanding of the competitive flag football ecosystem with strong business acumen, stakeholder management capabilities, and experience operating within complex sports environments. This individual will serve as a key leader in building relationships and aligning stakeholders across leagues, federations, governing bodies, tournament operators, clubs, and other partners to support the long-term growth of flag football globally.

Responsibilities

Competitive Ecosystem Strategy

  • Support the development and execution of the NFL's strategy to strengthen and expand competitive flag football globally.
  • Maintain a comprehensive understanding of the flag football ecosystem, including professional leagues, clubs, tournaments, governing bodies, athletes, coaches, officials, and administrators.
  • Monitor industry trends, competitive structures, and emerging opportunities across domestic and international markets.
  • Develop and manage a national database and intelligence platform tracking participation trends, organizations, competitions, and key stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities to improve alignment, collaboration, and growth across key stakeholders within the sport.

Professional League & Competition Development

  • Serve as a primary NFL relationship manager with TMRW Sports, the Professional Flag League.
  • Support initiatives that strengthen the professional flag football ecosystem and elevate awareness, participation, and long-term sustainability.
  • Collaborate on strategic initiatives related to league operations, competition development, athlete engagement, and market growth.
  • Identify opportunities to connect professional flag football with broader participation and competition objectives.

International Federations & National Team Engagement

  • Serve as a key NFL liaison to IFAF, national federations, and national team stakeholders worldwide.
  • Support initiatives that strengthen the global national team ecosystem and advance international competition.
  • Support initiatives that advance competitive standards, governance best practices, and competition quality across the global flag football ecosystem.
  • Collaborate with federations and governing bodies to promote alignment on competition structures, calendars, officiating frameworks, and strategic growth initiatives.
  • Support the continued development and quality of IFAF-sanctioned competitions, including World Championships, Continental Championships, Olympic qualification events, and other international tournaments.

Olympic & International Competition Strategy

  • Support the NFL's strategic engagement with the Olympic flag football ecosystem, including LA28 stakeholders, IFAF, National Olympic Committees, and National Governing Bodies.
  • Monitor developments related to Olympic qualification, international competition structures, and future Olympic cycles.
  • Help align NFL priorities with the continued growth and success of flag football within the Olympic movement.

Competition & Event Development

  • Support the growth and visibility of competitive opportunities for both men's and women's flag football across domestic and international markets.
  • Support the growth and enhancement of competitive flag football opportunities across professional, amateur, and international levels.
  • Develop relationships with tournament operators, league operators, clubs, and event organizers.
  • Evaluate opportunities to expand competition offerings and improve the participant and fan experience.
  • Assist in the development of new events, competitions, and initiatives that support growth objectives.

Adult Participation & Recreational Growth

  • Support initiatives that drive participation and engagement in adult recreational flag football.
  • Collaborate with leagues, operators, and partners to identify opportunities to expand adult play opportunities.
  • Develop relationships with organizations that support recreational and amateur competition.
  • Help align adult participation strategies with broader NFL flag football growth objectives.

Strategic Partnerships & Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate across NFL departments to align competition priorities with broader participation, international, football operations, marketing, and commercial objectives.
  • Identify new business, competition, and partnership opportunities that accelerate the growth of flag football globally.
  • Identify partnership opportunities that advance the NFL's strategic goals in flag football.
  • Support cross-functional initiatives involving internal and external stakeholders.

Industry Leadership & Representation

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on the competitive flag football landscape and stakeholder ecosystem.
  • Deliver strategic recommendations and presentations to NFL leadership and external partners.
  • Support thought leadership initiatives that position the NFL as a leader in the growth of flag football globally.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • Minimum 10-12 years of experience in sports business, football operations, league operations, competition management, international sports, partnership management, or related fields.
  • Demonstrated experience managing strategic partnerships and stakeholder relationships across complex sports environments.
  • Strong understanding of the competitive flag football ecosystem, including leagues, tournaments, governing bodies, clubs, and national teams.
  • Experience working with professional sports leagues, national governing bodies, international federations, event operators, or comparable organizations preferred.
  • Proven ability to develop and execute strategic initiatives across multiple stakeholders.
  • Exceptional relationship-building, influencing, and communication skills.
  • Strong project management, organizational, and negotiation skills.
  • Experience managing cross-functional teams and external partners.
  • Public speaking and executive presentation experience required.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Experience working within international sports ecosystems, national team programs, or governing bodies.
  • Familiarity with IFAF, Olympic competition structures, and international sports governance.
  • Experience working with professional sports leagues and emerging sports properties.
  • Global sports experience and demonstrated ability to work across diverse cultural and geographic markets.
  • Knowledge of adult participation and recreational sports programming.

Salary / Pay Range

The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. Only in truly rare and exceptional circumstances, where an external candidate has experience, credentials or expertise that far exceed those required or expected for the position, would the NFL consider paying a salary or rate near the higher end of the range.

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • NFL employees are required to work 40 hours per week in office.
  • This position will frequently require evenings, weekends, and international travel to support competitions, events, and stakeholder engagements.

Travel

  • Requires significant domestic and international travel (40%).
  • Frequent attendance at international competitions, stakeholder meetings, and major events.
  • Flexibility to work nights, weekends, and non-traditional hours as business needs require.

job.title: Director, Stadium Network Architecture
job.description:
The National Football League (NFL) is looking for a Director, Stadium Network Architecture with a strong background in network design, engineering, architecture and operations as well as experience with Wireless Design & Spectrum Analysis to join an innovative team of solutions engineers and architects. The Senior Network Architect will be responsible for developing network architecture diagrams, defining technical requirements, and serving as the technical lead for football technology network infrastructure. We are looking for a candidate who can drive the implementation and maintenance of complex and specialized network services, ensuring the highest levels of reliability, performance, and uptime.

This hands-on senior stadium network architect will act as a leader of technical engineering for the Infrastructure Engineering Team across a wide range of areas including the production Football Technology Network, NFL temporary Fan Event Setups, sideline wireless technology and more.

This onsite role can be based out of our Manhattan or Mount Laurel, NJ offices, and requires 30% to 50% travel domestically and internationally.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and architecture of Football Technology network services considering performance, redundancy, scalability, and security.
    • Document standards and guidelines for best practice stadium network and wireless architecture as they align to industry standards and best practices.
    • Develop and present comprehensive network design proposals to stakeholders, addressing business requirements and technical specifications.
    • Assist in the research, design and documentation for upgrades and adoption of new network technologies.
    • Provide hands on configuration and escalation support for all stadium network technologies.
  • Responsible for the installation, operation, administration, and maintenance of wired and wireless networks at stadiums and corporate offices.
    • Provide dedicated support for on-site stadium network and Wi-Fi technicians during NFL game days throughout the NFL season.
    • Responsible for managing and maintaining network diagrams, configurations, support, and training documentation.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including operations, security, Events, and others to align network strategies with business goals.
    • Responds to technical escalations for wired and wireless service issues, working with product support teams, IT staff and business groups to ensure resolution.
    • Provide reports for network KPIs to show service levels, capacity analysis, performance, troubleshooting, and areas for improvement in network infrastructure.
    • Provide technical support to various activities and internal infrastructure within the Football Technology segment.
    • Responsible for effectively engaging with IT project management and reporting project status.
    • Establish and adhere to set project plans and release dates.
  • Mentor and provide guidance to junior network engineers, sharing expertise and knowledge.
  • Remain on the cutting edge by studying state-of-the-art network technologies, participating in educational opportunities; reading professional publications; maintaining personal networks; participating in professional organizations
  • Maintain and publish Football Stadium DAS and Wi-Fi Guidelines
    • Review and plan DAS and Wi-Fi updates for NFL Tentpole Events.
    • Lead audits of Cellular and DAS Performance around NFL stadiums to adhere to NFL guidelines.
    • Collaborate with Cellular Vendors on stadium enhancements, and testing.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or related field preferred, with 10+ years of experience or equivalent military service.
  • Extensive hands-on experience exceeding 10 years in network implementation, troubleshooting, and lifecycle maintenance.
  • Demonstrated leadership with over 5 years in network architecture roles.
  • 5+ years’ experience in wireless design, implementation, and support for large networks, including spectrum analysis and stadium DAS design.
  • Proficient in network administration, particularly Cisco products, with expertise in controllers, access points, routers, and switches.
  • Advanced knowledge of networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP, DHCP, DNS, STP, NAT, IPSEC, GRE, VPC/VSS, etc.)
  • Advanced understanding of networking concepts and principles, including but not limited to routing static/dynamic (RIP, EIGRP, OSPF, & BGP) and multi-layer switching (standard and private VLANs, VTP, Spanning Tree, etc.)

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Strong grasp of network best practices, security principles, design architecture, and analysis with use of tools such as Wireshark, etc.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze and troubleshoot complex network issues.
  • Experience in troubleshooting networking device drivers and client system issues.
  • Experience in troubleshooting video and voice performance over wired and wireless networks.
  • Capability to research and evaluate new network technologies.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Skilled in creating and updating detailed infrastructure topologies using MS Visio, Excel, and Word.
  • CCNP, CCIE, JNCIP, or equivalent
  • Familiarity with Cisco Identity Services Engine and DNA.

Travel

30% - 50%, domestic and international.

Salary
$185,000—$215,000 USD

To learn more about our comprehensive benefits offerings, please visit: NFL BENEFITS

job.description:
The NFL legal department supports all of the NFL's entities by providing legal counsel on a wide range of issues which include employment and labor relations matters and litigation management. The NFL Management Council is the division of the NFL legal department that negotiates and advises NFL clubs regarding the NFL Collective Bargaining Agreement and represents them in grievance arbitrations against the NFL Players Association.

Management Council Law Clerks are required to commit to approximately 20 hours/week assisting attorneys with various labor relations matters, which may include:

job.title: Manager, Corporate Partnerships
job.description:
Reporting to the Head of Commercial Corporate Partnerships for NFL Canada, the Manager, Corporate Partnerships is accountable to support and enable each of our corporate sponsors’ activations in a given season.

Towards our goal of being our sponsors most strategic partner in Canada, this role requires superior relationship management capabilities for both external and internal stakeholders, combined with a solid strategic foundation and functional understanding, of all elements of the marketing mix. Candidate will demonstrate a strong working knowledge of the Canadian sponsorship industry and strategic planning process.

This is a full-time, 18-month fixed-term contract position (40 hours per week), with the possibility of renewal.

Responsibilities:

  • Accountable, in collaboration with our partners, for the successful development, approval, activation and where appropriate, analysis, of each of our NFL Canada partner activations on and off season.
  • Through a deep understanding of each of our partner contracts, will ensure that their programs can and will be approved internally, consistent with their contractual rights.
  • Work with partners to develop NFL centric content that meets partner and league objectives
  • Work with player relations to identify and recommend players for partner executions (content, virtual, in-person)
  • Work with partners on measures of success and track throughout the season
  • Develop digital media campaigns for league partners to maximize partner investments
  • Work with our corporate partners, at a strategic business level, to identify key challenges and opportunities that the NFL can support on, to meet their business needs. This will be done in collaboration with other functional teams (marketing, fan centric marketing, consumer products, etc.)
  • Accountable for identifying incremental revenue opportunities across each partner, and working to provide them with new ideas, that will deliver net new revenue to NFL Canada. content, assets, media.
  • Work with legal and other relevant NFL stakeholders to develop and manage contracts for new partners
  • Work with NFL Canada marketing team to identify opportunities to collaborate with partners on initiatives that support business objectives in the market
  • Identify and lead, required research projects, to help deliver short and long term goals.
  • Accountable for evaluating our annual performance with our partners, using an agreed upon methodology and metrics.
  • Responsible for managing digital inventory across all NFL Canada corporate partners, including trafficking ads with our digital agency
  • Responsible for providing monthly reporting and analysis of our NFL owned and operated media executions
  • Responsible for leading our NFL Canada events including NFL Road Trips, annual Corporate Partner Summit and Partner Gifting program
  • Responsible for supporting our event calendar initiatives tied to our tentpole events: Kickoff, Super Bowl, Pro Bowl and Draft

Required Education and Experience:

  • University or equivalent college diploma – marketing or business administration degree an asset
  • Experience with Account Management an asset
  • Experience working in sponsorship, either on client, agency or property side
  • Working with a sports property and or sports betting operator an asset
  • A minimum of 5-7 years of progressively expanding experience in sponsorship/partnership activation or client account management in the marketing function is preferred

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics:

  • Digital media planning or buying experience an asset
  • Experience developing and executing digital content an asset
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage the needs of multiple partners simultaneously
  • Strong inter-personal and effective communication skills
  • Creative problem solver with an optimistic approach to business challenges
  • Consistently pushes for better results for the team and partners
  • Effective knowledge and use of Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel and research tools
  • Self-starter with the ability to network within NFL International and Domestic offices to conduct day to day business

Travel:

  • Position requires some flexibility of travel during the NFL season (approximately 10% of the year). Valid Passport for international travel required.

Requirements:

  • NFL Canada offers a hybrid work schedule consisting of a four day in office presence (Toronto) with one day work from home
  • This is a full-time, 18-month fixed-term contract position (40 hours per week), with the possibility of renewal.

job.title: Manager, Digital Strategy and Business Development
job.description:
The Manager, Digital Strategy and Business Development plays a critical role in the development of NFL Digital Media platforms short- and long-term strategic approach. The role will require a deep understanding of user data, competitive analysis, and the NFL ecosystem to create actionable strategic direction for the broader organization. The role will also directly support partnership strategy across sourcing, deal negotiation, and operational execution.

Responsibilities

  • Define near- and long-term strategy for the NFL’s digital media business, creating vision and prioritization framework to drive growth across NFL+, NFL App, and NFL.com experiences
  • Independently identify, evaluate, and recommend new growth opportunities across product features, promotional strategies, distribution models, and strategic partnerships through financial modeling, market analysis, and unlocking insights from unstructured data sets
  • Lead cross-functional strategic initiatives from concept through execution, partnering with Product, Marketing, Growth, Content, Finance, Legal, Sponsorship, and Ad Sales to align stakeholders and deliver business outcomes
  • Develops strategic evaluations and decision frameworks that enable leadership to assess, prioritize, and make informed decisions on business initiatives.
  • Source, negotiate, and manage strategic partnerships that expand audience reach, drive incremental revenue, and advance NFL’s digital media strategy
  • Create executive-level communications and strategic planning materials to support decision-making by NFL senior leadership
  • Presents data-driven findings and strategic recommendations to executive leadership, influencing key business decisions and organizational priorities.
  • Serve as a strategic thought partner to NFL Media leadership, providing analytical rigor and executive support on high-priority initiatives and business-critical decisions.

Required Qualifications

  • A four-year undergraduate degree from an accredited college or university is required.
  • 5-7+ years of work experience in strategy, consulting, business development, or related fields -- experience in sports, media, or digital products preferred
  • Strong understanding of digital media ecosystems, including streaming platforms, distribution models, and direct-to-consumer (DTC) business models
  • Advanced analytical and quantitative skills, including financial modeling, scenario analysis, and business case development
  • Demonstrated experience developing strategic frameworks and translating data and market insights into actionable business recommendations
  • Exercises a high degree of discretion, judgment, and professionalism in handling highly confidential, sensitive, and business-critical information. Experience working cross-functionally and influencing stakeholders across product, marketing, finance, and other business units
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with ability to distill complex concepts into clear, easy-to-understand presentations

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects with several deliverables under tight deadlines
  • High level of integrity, work ethic, and deep intellectual curiosity
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a collaborative DNA

job.title: Manager, Global Sponsorship New Business Development
job.description:
The Manager, Global Sponsorship New Business Development, is a key member of the Business Development team responsible for generating revenue by developing and selling integrated marketing partnerships for the NFL globally.

This position will work collaboratively across the NFL to identify partnerships that support key initiatives such as NFL FLAG, International growth, audience growth across youth, multicultural and women, and game innovation.

Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for developing global pipeline and executing partnerships with blue-chip brands to reach Sponsorship revenue goals
  • Cultivate global and local market category prospects through category analysis and market research, with a focus on international markets without a dedicated new business resource
  • Establish and build relationships with key external contacts (e.g., corporate decision makers at Fortune 500 companies and influencers in the sports marketing and agency world)
  • Pursue prospects through contact strategy, development, and delivery of sales presentations, negotiation, and contract execution
  • Actively contribute innovative thinking and fresh ideas that help lead to new revenue-generating sponsorship opportunities and contribute to cross-functional working groups consisting of key internal stakeholders (e.g., Media, IT, Football Operations, Social Responsibility, etc.) to develop customized marketing platforms that align with prospective partner objectives
  • Develop and write strategic, customized presentations and partnership proposals for prospects
  • Effectively maintain sales pipeline and reporting documents, as well as other duties as directed
  • Help manage Sponsorship Business Development Senior Coordinator contributions to the team in partnership with the Senior Director

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree
  • 5+ years of sponsorship sales and/or business development experience at league, team, agency and/or company

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Excellent written and verbal communicator; ability to build trusted relationships and influence across all levels both internally and externally
  • Proficient with MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint

Other Key Attributes / Talent Characteristics:

  • Energetic, self-starter with a passion for uncovering synergies between Fortune 500 brands and the NFL
  • Strong knowledge of sports marketing and/or sponsorship landscape
  • Proficient in conducting industry research, prospecting, outreach, pitch ideation, and proposal development
  • Excellent written and verbal communicator
  • Ability to build trusted relationships and influence across all levels, both internally and externally
  • Experienced in leveraging your network to initiate and develop relationships with senior-level marketing executives

job.title: Manager, Hospitality (UK-External Agency Position)
job.description:
The Manager, Hospitality (UK) will play a key role in the planning, delivery, and execution of NFL Premium and VIP Hospitality programs for the NFL's international games and events. This individual will oversee guest experiences, ensuring best-in-class service for NFL partners, clients, and fans while helping deliver exceptional hospitality experiences that reflect the NFL brand.

Working closely with internal stakeholders and external partners, the Hospitality Manager will lead and support hospitality initiatives before, during, and after international events throughout the year. The role requires strong organizational, project management, and communication skills, along with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

The successful candidate will be proactive, detail-oriented, and solutions-focused, with a passion for creating memorable experiences and a willingness to go above and beyond to deliver outstanding results.

This job posting is for a position with one of the NFL’s third-party agency partners that provides services to the NFL. The individual selected for this role will be an employee of that third-party agency and not the NFL. All compensation, benefits, and other terms and conditions of employment are handled by the agency. The assignment to provide services to the NFL will be limited in duration but may be extended for an additional period by agreement between the NFL and the agency.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and planning of all hospitality areas including suites, shared spaces, and NFL VIP for international games
  • Manage sales and event agencies to deliver a high-end hospitality program
  • Work collaboratively with participating teams in their hospitality delivery
  • Assist in the branding and design for all hospitality and customer facing areas
  • Conduit between contractors and NFL Creative
  • Day-to-day lead for stadium catering; assist in the creation of menus for GA/Hospitality areas
  • May include external events
  • Entertainment programming
  • Cross department guest list management alongside NFL Ticketing and Global Hospitality sales team
  • Working closely with the NFL’s Elite Service, management of internal clients, teams, NFL Executives and team ownership
  • Support in the execution of and delivery of the NFL international games
  • Lead or support in external partner events throughout the year

Technical Experience and Role Requirements:

  • Minimum of 5 years’ working within sports and event industry
  • Working within stadiums is highly desired
  • Experience in managing and executing multiple events
  • Outstanding stakeholder management
  • Excellent time management, problem solving and organisational skills
  • Proficiency in MD Office (PPT, Word, Excell etc.) and excellent email management skill required
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and conflict resolution skills
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and work well under pressure to meet deadlines
  • Proactive mindset and professional manner to align with business objectives, customer expectations and brand values
  • Proficiency in English required, other languages encouraged
  • Awareness of cultural differences and inclusion
  • Willingness and availability to travel to local and international games (primarily Europe)

Personal Attributes:

  • A genuine passion for delivering exceptional customer service and experiences
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Willingness to travel, work long hours and weekends when required
  • Interest in sports recommended

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Requires extensive travel to event locations across the UK and Europe.
  • Requires flexibility to work evenings, weekends and holidays, particularly during event and game weeks.

job.title: Manager, International Data and Strategy
job.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated Manager, International Data & Strategy, to lead and scale the NFL’s international managed model as part of a transformative enterprise initiative. In this role, you will partner closely with League and Club stakeholders to deliver high-quality, scalable data solutions and program operations that enable informed decision-making and drive business outcomes across global markets.

The ideal candidate brings 5+ years of experience with a demonstrated track record of delivering centralized, enterprise-scale initiatives. You will work hands-on across data strategy, technology, and program execution—owning delivery, driving cross-functional alignment, translating business needs into actionable requirements, and ensuring scalable, high-quality outputs.

This role is well-suited for a strategic yet hands-on leader who thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment, excels at stakeholder management, and is passionate about leveraging data to unlock value and build scalable enterprise capabilities.

Responsibilities

  • Leadership: Drive cross-functional alignment and champion adoption of the International managed model through clear communication, best practices, and continuous improvement.
  • Program Management: Oversee day-to-day program operations for the international managed model, tracking progress across data onboarding, curation, fulfillment, reporting and insights.
  • Customer Partnership: Partner closely with clubs to drive adoption of the international managed model by capturing requirements and translating them into prioritized program initiatives.
  • Data Product Architecture: Translate business needs into scalable data and platform requirements to support segmentation, data access, and performance measurement.
  • Operational Excellence: Ensure efficient and consistent execution by establishing standardized processes and continuously optimizing workflows.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 5+ years in data strategy, product ownership, or technical leadership roles.
  • Exposure to enterprise-scale data initiatives, including cloud data platforms, data lakes, and governance frameworks.
  • Experience with privacy and compliance standards, including GDPR/CCPA and consent data management, is preferred.
  • Knowledge of sports or fan-focused businesses, including an understanding of fan engagement and lifecycle marketing, is an advantage.
  • Proven experience working with AWS Redshift, Adobe Marketing Suite (AEP, AEM, AJO), BI Tools like Power BI, Tableau in a production environment is a plus.
  • Demonstrated track record of collaborating across cross-functional teams and influencing decisions in a matrixed organization without direct reporting authority.
  • Excellent communication skills with a demonstrated ability to engage senior leaders, work effectively with technical partners, and motivate teams to achieve high performance.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Master’s degree or higher in statistics, data science, computer science, or other data related fields

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Limited Travel

job.title: NFL Foundation Fellow
job.description:
The NFL Foundation Fellow will focus on administrative work to help support the operations and grant programs of the NFL Foundation charitable organization. This includes work within and outside of the NFL Foundation Grant Application Management System (GAMS) on issues including youth health and wellness, youth football, social issues and other Foundation priority areas. The position reports to the NFL Philanthropy Manager and works closely with the Vice President of Philanthropy and the rest of the NFL Foundation/Philanthropy team.

Responsibilities

  • Provide administrative support to the NFL Foundation team including but not limited to fielding phone calls and emails from current and potential grant recipients, including NFL clubs, NFL Legends and partner organizations.,
  • Assist with grant payment processing via the NFL Foundation’s Grant Management System (GAMS).
  • Schedule meetings, facilitate mailings and help prepare presentation materials.
  • Take meeting minutes.
  • Assist staff with administrative support in GAMS (e.g., grant agreement letters, GAMS messaging, etc.).
  • Assist staff on 2026 Annual Report build out.
  • Work with Accounts Payable on submitting grant and contribution check requests for both GAMS and non-GAMS payments. Work through entire process to ensure payments are made in a timely manner.
  • Respond to incoming NFL Foundation phone, email and letter inquiries/requests. Provide excellent customer service to grantees, NFL clubs, players and constituents, analyze and resolve issues and recommend process improvements.
  • Create, organize and maintain filing systems, both physical and electronic, for non-GAMS-related grants. Track required progress report submissions and follow-up with grantees on missing reports.
  • Provide abstracts of grant report progress (quarterly and annual)
  • Conduct programmatic research as needed.
  • Help NFL Foundation staff create various grant assets including grant application guides, media templates and grant overviews.
  • Assist with product uploads and postings on the NFL Auction website.
  • Assist with NFL Auction inventory management
  • Assist with NFL Auction promotion for My Cause My Cleats
  • Any other relevant duties assigned by supervisor.

Required Qualifications

  • In process of obtaining undergraduate or postgraduate degree
  • Excellent writer
  • Excellent customer service and communication skills
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Highly organized with the ability to work on multiple tasks simultaneously and meet deadlines
  • Proficiency in all Microsoft Office applications (PowerPoint, Word, Excel)
  • Knowledge of sports media and PR in general

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Interest and passion for philanthropic work
  • Must display good judgment at all times
  • Ability to work effectively and well in collaboration with diverse groups of people

job.title: Part-Time Game Day Photo Editor
job.description:
NFL Media is seeking a part-time Photo Editor to join our photo team in support of our game day operations. The NFL Photo department provides exclusive imagery in real-time for use across the League, including our editorial and social departments, players, and clubs.

During games, NFL photographers transmit images from the field to our editors, who then prepare and distribute the photos. Editors will identify top photos with high news, social, and visual value, apply metadata, crop, edit and tone images, and upload to our internal galleries. The ideal candidate has a sharp eye for sports photography, strong photo editing skills, and experience with news or live event editing.

This is a part-time role specific to Sundays, with some opportunities for other game days (i.e., MNF, TNF) and event coverage as needed.

Essential Functions

  • Provide photo editing support for game days. Edit game images in real time: toning, captioning, and transmitting to internal galleries to share across League departments.

Preferred Education and Experience

job.title: Part-Time Lead DAI Operator
job.description:
The NFL Digital Media Team is seeking an individual passionate about professional sports to lead the team responsible for Digital Ad Insertion for live football games. The Lead DAI Operator will be responsible for coordination and game day supervision of the team responsible for monitoring live game feeds from start to finish and inserting ad cues during commercial breaks. This is a hands-on lead position that will on occasion be responsible for performing DAI Operator responsibilities such as inserting ads into live games or other live video programing.

The role includes performing as a DAI Operator, inserting breaks and monitoring performance of ad delivery using a variety of visual and data reporting sources. The team’s focus is on continuous improvement in their ability to understand and measure the overall effectiveness of the ad delivery system, through evolving tools, processes and capabilities.

Responsibilities

As DAI Lead Operator:

  • Schedule DAI Operators for Live Game Coverage.
  • Distribute Game Format Sheets and other assignment information.
  • Address any Operator-specific equipment, logistics or access issues.
  • Supervise all aspects of ad delivery performance, including accuracy, analytics generation and performance metric reporting.
  • Lead Operator conference calls.
  • Supervise break assignments, schedule changes and other real-time events during game windows.
  • Communicate any issues to appropriate parties.
  • Direct and perform application and system testing of ad delivery as directed.

As DAI Operator:

  • Monitor Live Game Video for commercial breaks and compare broadcast feed to digital distribution.
  • Perform as a either a primary operator or as a backup.
  • Monitor listen-only lines for commercial break instructions.
  • Follow Ad Break program guides and calculate break durations and break insertion points.
  • Report any issues to appropriate NFL management via established procedures.
  • As directed, monitor and generate ad delivery performance metrics and provide immediate notification of any delivery anomalies detected.
  • Perform application and system testing of ad delivery as directed.
  • In a lead capacity, monitor and generate ad delivery performance metrics and provide immediate notification of any delivery anomalies detected.

Required Qualifications

  • Must have high school diploma; GED or equivalency (Some college, no degree required)
  • Proven experience working with computers in an office environment.
  • Experience working in a Lead role and/or supervisory capacity.
  • Basic working knowledge of Microsoft Windows Applications (Word, Excel, PP, Outlook) in PC or MAC.
  • Working knowledge of email, slack and web browsers in PC or MAC
  • Strong communication and analysis skills
  • Must be extremely organized and detail-oriented with the ability to follow through on multi-step instructions.
  • General availability for Sunday and other peak event Game Days during the NFL Football season – refer to nfl.com/schedule for specific dates.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelors, or Associate degree preferred
  • Prior experience working for the NFL.
  • Previous experience working in live TV/broadcast environments (production, stage, etc.) is preferred.
  • Management experience is a plus.
  • Familiarity with Ad insertion
  • Availability on non-Game Days a consideration.
  • Availability for occasional in-office work is a consideration.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Must possess a strong work ethic, positive workplace approach and work well with others.
  • Passionate sports-fan, knowledgeable about football (preferred not required).
  • Punctuality is must in this position.

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • This is a remote position
  • Up to 7 months of employment based on business needs
  • Part-time - Must be available for 4 hour (min) to 8 hour (max) shifts on NFL Gamedays (Monday, Thursday, Sunday) and holidays where schedule applies (Thanksgiving, etc.)
  • Occasional overtime as needed and approved.

job.title: Part-Time Production Manager
job.description:
The Production Manager is responsible for overseeing production-related planning, logistics, on-site execution and budgets for NFL Media. They collaborate with various departments to ensure strategic planning and decision-making regarding budgetary and operational execution. The Production Manager plays a crucial role in coordinating Digital Media and Studio productions, while maintaining effective communication and fostering collaboration across teams.

Responsible for researching and fulfilling requests submitted by producers to acquire third party materials to be used in programming produced by NFL Films.
