job.title: Finance & Royalties Intern
job.description:
The application window for this role has been extended: Please apply by September 3rd at 10:00

At Sony Music Entertainment, we’re not just part of the music industry - we’re leading it. By bringing together music, technology, and culture, we’re creating real impact for our artists, our people, and the world around us. Here, you’ll be part of a global, collaborative community that’s constantly evolving, innovating, and shaping what’s next.

This is your opportunity to contribute meaningfully, while gaining a unique, end-to-end understanding of how a major music company operates—from financial decision making, to artist payments and beyond.

The Royalties & Finance (R&F) department at Sony Music is split into two main operational areas – Central R&F, and Label R&F.

There are two roles on offer in each of the R&F teams meaning four roles in total across central and label R&F giving fantastic opportunities for individuals who are analytical, curious, and eager to understand the bigger picture behind the music.

Please note: This application form cannot be saved part-way through. We recommend preparing your answers in a separate document and then copying them into the form when you’re ready to submit. If you’d like to take additional time to complete your application, please ensure you gather your responses externally before submitting in one go. If you are encountering any issues in your application, please apply via our UK careers site

If you have any reasonable adjustment requests, please reach out to recruitment.support@sonymusic.com.

Role Overview:

Ways of Working

  • Office attendance: Monday to Thursday in the office, Friday is our work from home day
  • Offsite working: No offsite working opportunities

What you'll do:

Cross-Team Collaboration & Broader Exposure

  • Work closely with both the Finance and Royalties teams, supporting key day-to-day operations and long-term projects
  • Liaise with departments such as Marketing, Legal, Sales, and Global Finance to understand how financial and contractual data flows across the business
  • Gain exposure to artist contract administration, budgeting processes, third-party reporting, and performance analysis

Central Finance Responsibilities

  • Support the consolidation and timely submission of group financial results to our parent organisation
  • Collaborate with the Central, Label and “New Business” teams on month-end reporting, budget tracking, and forecasting activities
  • Responsible for Group Reporting Packs delivered to CFO. These detail and summarise financial performance in the month, YTD and full year (forecast) across the business
  • Help prepare reports and analysis for business partners, including executive stakeholders
  • Reconcile financial data and identify anomalies in balance sheets to ensure accurate financial statements
  • Work closely with cost center owners to manage purchase orders and ensure timely supplier payments
  • Raise invoices and respond to finance-related queries, developing a strong understanding of end-to-end financial operations

Central Royalty Responsibilities

  • Manage the Royalty Query Log, acting as a first point of contact for standard queries from artists, producers, and managers, while coordinating with Royalty Managers on more complex cases
  • Assist in setting up new artist, producer, and licensee contracts in our royalty system (EROS), learning how accurate contract entry ensures artists are paid correctly
  • Support the collection and validation of banking and identity information for artist payments
  • Track and invoice third-party royalties, monitor sales data, and process royalty VAT invoices
  • Prepare monthly royalty statements and help with month-end balance sheet processes
  • Generate and circulate reports such as the CARMA report, gaining insights into contract and usage tracking

Label Finance Responsibilities

  • Support the team in preparing and submitting accurate month end label results - includes preparing and posting journals as required
  • Create and update daily streaming reports to be sent this to senior executives
  • Assist the marketing, production, and department cost center owners with our purchase order system to ensure timely payments of suppliers. You’ll also train new starters on how to use this system
  • Maintain and distribute weekly sales trackers for active/major artists
  • Work closely with Marketing and A&R executives to conduct regular meetings and ensure forecasts are accurate and up to date
  • Support the team in running key financial reports and analysis using various systems
  • Raise invoices and respond to finance-related queries, developing a strong understanding of end-to-end financial operations

Who you are:

Essential

  • Highly numerate and detail-oriented, with a strong interest in finance, accounting and royalties
  • Comfortable working with data, spreadsheets, and financial systems
  • Keen to understand how different departments work together to support artists and the business

Nice to have

  • You’re curious, analytical, and passionate about understanding how a global music company works—especially the financial and contractual mechanisms behind it all. You’re ready to work with multiple teams, ask the right questions, and take ownership of your learning journey
  • Collaborative by nature, with excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Organised and methodical, with the ability to juggle multiple tasks and meet deadlines
  • Proactive and resourceful—you don’t wait to be told what to do

What we give you:

  • An annual salary of £28,480 (London Living Wage)
  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best
  • Investment in your professional growth and development such as focused workshops and a dedicated mentor, enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next
  • We give you the platform to champion positive change, with the opportunity to contribute to our social impact, diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives
  • We provide an excellent range of benefits like private medical cover, a generous pension scheme, life assurance, income protection, plus loads of music industry perks. There’s also time off over winter break

Process Overview

  • Candidates whose applications are selected will be invited to complete a video interview between September 28th and October 3rd.
  • Candidates who pass this stage will then be invited to the final stage of the process, an in-person assessment centre in early November. We will send further information on this stage before the date arrives.
  • Successful applicants will start in January 2027.

We are committed to providing an accessible recruitment process and encourage you to let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments throughout the process by contacting this email: recruitment.support@sonymusic.com.

job.title: Finance Accountant
job.description:
Sony Music Entertainment is currently looking for an experienced Financial Accountant to join our Finance team. You will be looking after our Malaysia and Singapore entities. Reporting to the Finance Director, you will be an integral member of the Sony Music Finance team and will be responsible for ensuring all reporting completed accurately and on time.

What you'll do

Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable

  • Manage end-to-end accounts payable processes, including purchase requests, purchase orders, supplier invoice verification, three-way matching, invoice processing, and payment workflows in accordance with company policies and approval requirements.
  • Review payment proposals prepared by shared services teams and ensure payment instructions are accurate and properly approved.
  • Manage accounts receivable activities including client invoicing, collections follow-up, cash application, receipting, and resolution of billing discrepancies.
  • Maintain accurate supplier and customer master data, supporting documentation, and respond to internal and external stakeholder enquiries in a timely manner.

General Ledger, Financial Close & Reporting

  • Prepare and post month-end journal entries, including accruals, prepayments, reclassifications, provisions, and other accounting adjustments.
  • Perform monthly balance sheet and general ledger reconciliations, including bank accounts, accounts payable, receivables, accruals, provisions, and other assigned accounts, ensuring timely investigation and resolution of outstanding items.
  • Prepare management accounts and support the interface between local statutory ledgers and corporate reporting ledgers, including US GAAP reporting requirements.
  • Manage monthly, quarterly, and year-end financial closing activities, ensuring all transactions are accurately recorded within reporting deadlines.
  • Maintain accurate accounting records and documentation to support financial integrity, audit readiness, and compliance with US GAAP, IFRS, and company accounting policies.

Financial Planning & Business Support

  • Support monthly forecasting and annual budgeting processes using global reporting and planning tools.
  • Assist in financial analysis and provide insights to support business decision-making and operational planning.
  • Monitor financial performance against budgets and forecasts, highlighting key variances and trends to stakeholders.

Tax Compliance & Reporting

  • Assist with tax compliance activities across Singapore and Malaysia, ensuring timely and accurate submission of required tax filings and reporting obligations.
  • Support periodic withholding tax filings, VAT/GST filings, annual corporate income tax returns, and other statutory tax submissions in accordance with local regulations.
  • Prepare and coordinate group tax reporting packages, including information required for corporate tax consolidation and global reporting requirements.
  • Assist with non-resident withholding tax (NRWT) compliance, including review of applicable requirements, supporting documentation, and timely submission of filings.
  • Maintain accurate tax records and supporting documentation while liaising with internal stakeholders, external tax advisors, and tax authorities to resolve queries and ensure compliance.

Audit, Governance & Internal Controls

  • Support year-end statutory audits by preparing audit schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documentation for external auditors.
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, accounting policies, tax requirements, and regulatory obligations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve finance processes, strengthen controls, and enhance operational efficiency.

Royalty & Special Projects

  • Prepare royalty statements and financial reporting for joint venture deals, licensing arrangements, and other commercial agreements.
  • Support finance transformation initiatives, process improvement projects, and other ad hoc assignments as required.

Who you are

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of accounts payable, general ledger, reconciliation processes, and financial close activities.
  • Detail-oriented and process-driven with strong analytical and problem-solving skills to investigate discrepancies and maintain financial accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple entities, currencies, and deadlines while working effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and finance teams.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing positively to a collaborative finance team environment.

Education and Qualifications

  • Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, Business, Economics, or a related discipline, with CA/CPA qualification or progress towards professional qualification preferred.
  • 5 years of experience in accounts payable, general ledger accounting, financial accounting, or a similar finance operations role within a multinational or fast-paced environment.
  • Hands-on experience in invoice processing, purchase order workflows, payment runs, journal entries, month-end closing, and balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Experience with SAP ERP, Business Warehouse (BW), or other financial systems is preferred, with strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial reporting tools.
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting processes, and internal controls, with experience managing multiple priorities and meeting tight deadlines.

What we give you

  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next
  • We give you the platform to champion positive change, with the opportunity to contribute to our social impact, diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives

Equal Opportunities:

As an active part of a culturally and socially diverse society, Sony Music’s aim is that our workforce is diverse and inclusive. Sony Music is an equal opportunity employer and supports workforce diversity.
We employ, retain, promote and otherwise treat all employees and job applicants according to their merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We apply this policy without regard to any individual’s sex, race, religion, origin, age, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition or disability.

job.title: Finance Director
job.description:
The Finance Director is the strategic finance business partner to the Country General Manager and regional leadership, providing commercial and financial leadership to drive sustainable business growth and value creation. The role is responsible for leading the country's financial planning and analysis, business partnering, commercial deal evaluation, financial reporting, governance, and compliance, while ensuring strong financial controls and operational excellence.

Working closely with commercial, marketing, A&R, business development, legal, and regional finance teams, the Finance Director provides financial insights to support strategic initiatives, artist investments, licensing and distribution agreements, and other commercial opportunities. The role leads budgeting, forecasting, business case development, and performance management to support informed decision-making and deliver business objectives.

In addition to its strategic focus, the role oversees all aspects of the country finance function, including accounting, treasury, cash flow management, financial reporting, tax, audit, internal controls, and statutory compliance, ensuring adherence to company policies, IFRS, and local regulatory requirements. The Finance Director also drives process improvements, cost optimisation, and effective risk management while partnering with regional finance and shared service teams to deliver a high-performing finance function.

What you'll do

Business Partnering, Commercial Finance & Strategic Planning

  • Partner with the Country General Manager (GM), Regional Managing Director, and cross-functional teams including Commercial, Marketing, A&R, Business Development, Legal, and Business Affairs to evaluate business opportunities and strategic initiatives.
  • Act as the trusted finance business partner, providing commercial and financial insights to support strategic decision-making and sustainable business growth.
  • Identify and evaluate new business opportunities, investments, partnerships, and commercial transactions by developing financial models, business cases, and scenario analyses.
  • Lead the annual budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes for the country, ensuring alignment with regional and global objectives.
  • Deliver insightful management reporting, financial analysis, and performance scorecards to country and regional leadership, providing recommendations to improve profitability and operational efficiency.

Commercial Transactions, Artist Deals & Strategic Investments

  • Provide financial leadership and commercial support for artist signings, licensing agreements, royalty arrangements, publishing, distribution, and other commercial transactions.
  • Evaluate deal economics, profitability, recoupment structures, investment returns, and financial risks associated with artist contracts and commercial agreements.
  • Partner with Legal and Business Affairs during contract negotiations and deal execution.
  • Support strategic investment initiatives and M&A activities by performing financial analysis, due diligence, valuation, and post-investment performance monitoring where applicable.

Financial Planning, Reporting & Performance Management

  • Drive budgeting, forecasting, cost management, and financial planning in accordance with global finance processes.
  • Ensure accurate revenue, cost, and cash flow forecasting while monitoring performance against financial targets and key business metrics.
  • Prepare monthly management reports, financial dashboards, variance analyses, and forecasts for country management and regional finance.
  • Manage affiliate performance reporting and maintain a single source of financial data for business decision-making.

Finance Operations & Financial Control

  • Lead the country finance function, overseeing accounting, accounts payable, accounts receivable, treasury, payroll, royalty processing, cash flow management, and month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities.
  • Ensure accurate preparation of financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow) in accordance with IFRS, company policies, and local statutory requirements.
  • Drive operational excellence, finance process improvements, and automation initiatives to enhance efficiency and strengthen financial controls.
  • Maintain effective governance frameworks, finance policies, and internal controls to safeguard company assets and ensure compliance.

Risk Management, Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with corporate policies, IFRS, local statutory requirements, tax regulations, and internal control standards.
  • Manage statutory audits and maintain relationships with external auditors, tax advisors, and regulatory authorities.
  • Oversee corporate income tax, GST/VAT, withholding tax, transfer pricing, and statutory reporting obligations.
  • Monitor cash flow, liquidity, and financial risks while safeguarding company assets and investments.
  • Drive cost control initiatives, manage operating expenses and headcount budgets, and ensure efficient use of financial resources.
  • Ensure timely royalty processing, financial reconciliations, and resolution of operational backlogs.

Who you are

Experience

  • 10–15 years of progressive finance experience spanning commercial finance, FP&A, financial control, and business partnering, with a proven track record in multinational organisations. Experience in the media, entertainment, consumer, or other fast-paced industries is an advantage.
  • Solid experience within a medium-sized to large international organisation, partnering closely with regional finance teams while serving as the finance lead for an in-country business.
  • Proven ability to act as a strategic finance business partner within a matrix organisation, influencing senior stakeholders and supporting commercial decision-making.
  • Demonstrated track record of combining strong financial and commercial acumen to identify business risks and opportunities, drive FP&A initiatives, and support sustainable business growth.

Capabilities

  • Strategic Finance & Business Partnering: Strong expertise in financial planning and analysis, budgeting, forecasting, financial modelling, business case development, performance reporting, and commercial decision support.
  • Finance Leadership & Operational Excellence: Proven ability to lead finance operations, strengthen governance and internal controls, optimise finance processes, and drive continuous improvement through automation and operational excellence.
  • People & Stakeholder Leadership: Effective leader with experience developing high-performing teams and building trusted relationships with business leaders, regional finance, artists and their ecosystem, and internal and external stakeholders across a matrix organisation.
  • Commercial & Analytical Acumen: Strong strategic, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate financial insights into actionable recommendations, balancing commercial objectives with financial discipline and risk management.

Education and Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, Business, or a related discipline; an MBA in Finance or Accounting is an advantage.
  • Professional accounting qualification such as CPA, CA, ACCA, or equivalent preferred, with strong knowledge of IFRS, financial reporting, tax, statutory compliance, ERP systems, and advanced financial analysis tools.
  • Fluent in both English and Bahasa Indonesia.

What we give you

  • An opportunity to influence the strategic direction of our Southeast Asia business
  • The ability to foster innovation and make a significant impact on the domestic music industry in Southeast Asia
  • You join an inclusive, collaborative, and global community that empowers you to drive the creative journey
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork
  • We are committed to investing in your personal growth and development.

Equal Opportunities:

As an active part of a culturally and socially diverse society, Sony Music’s aim is that our workforce is diverse and inclusive. Sony Music is an equal opportunity employer and supports workforce diversity.
We employ, retain, promote and otherwise treat all employees and job applicants according to their merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We apply this policy without regard to any individual’s sex, race, religion, origin, age, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition or disability.

job.title: Finance Director - Ceremony of Roses
job.description:
Ceremony of Roses is a global media, branding, design and events company with a full service music merchandise arm, covering every aspect of merchandise sales, production and distribution worldwide.

The Finance Director is responsible for the financial leadership, governance and operational finance management of Ceremony of Roses UK & Probity Merchandise. The role ensures the integrity of financial reporting, compliance, royalty accounting, tax obligations and audit requirements, whilst partnering with leadership to support commercial decision-making and business growth.

What you'll do:

  • Manage the monthly close process, including financial commentary and analysis of performance versus plan and forecast and performing balance sheet reviews. Review royalty statements based on contract terms as needed and reconciliation processes
  • Ensure accurate accounting treatment of inventory, stock movements and related intercompany activity
  • Ensure timely submission of corporate deliverables, including monthly forecasts and annual business plans for current ventures, new acquisitions, and business units
  • Lead the budgeting, forecasting and financial planning processes, providing performance analysis, financial insight and modelling to support business objectives and strategic decision-making
  • Develop and maintain reporting packages, including periodic artist and business unit P&Ls. Lead deal analysis for potential artist deals and evaluate financial performance against targets
  • Analyze, assess and then develop quantitative-based recommendations to support revenue growth and improve margin and profitability
  • Serve as the business lead for integration projects related to new and acquired entities, defining requirements around systems, data integration, workflow, processes, and reporting needs
  • Special projects; including partnership with other operational and shared services teams that drive effective communication, collaboration and coordination against strategic initiatives. Drive continuous improvement across finance processes, systems and intercompany operations to enhance efficiency, controls and reporting effectiveness
  • Oversee the accuracy and integrity of artist royalty reporting, ensuring timely calculations, reconciliations and payments in line with contractual obligations
  • Lead VAT reporting, compliance and indirect tax governance across the UK and European territories, ensuring accurate filings, regulatory compliance and effective management of tax risk
  • Own the statutory reporting process and serve as the primary point of contact for external auditors, coordinating audits, financial statement preparation and regulatory submissions

Who you are:

  • Experience and strong proficiency in financial planning, analysis, and reporting with strong knowledge of GAAP and accounting principles. Public accounting or financial reporting experience preferred
  • Qualified Accountant or similar professional qualification
  • Progressive experience in finance and accounting roles, with experience in a leadership position
  • High proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other financial modelling tools
  • Strong proficiency in financial budgeting, forecasting and deal analysis
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex financial information clearly and concisely
  • Experience in the merchandising, retail, or entertainment industry is a plus
  • Proficiency with financial software and ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Hyperion)
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines and business integration projects
  • A critical thinker with exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex financial data and provide actionable insights
  • Strong leadership and team development skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and senior management
  • Experience in risk management and implementing financial controls
  • Knowledge of tax compliance and royalty management
  • Excited to learn and make an impact

What we give you:

  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next
  • We give you the platform to champion positive change, with the opportunity to contribute to our social impact, diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives

job.title: Head of Data - GSA (m/w/d)
job.description:
Vollzeit, ab sofort, unbefristet, Standort Berlin

Die/Der Head of Data, GSA führt die Data-Intelligence-Unit für Deutschland, Österreich und die Schweiz und spielt eine zentrale Rolle bei der Förderung einer datengestützten Unternehmenskultur. In dieser Matrixfunktion agiert die/der Head of Data an der Schnittstelle zwischen lokalen Business Units und den regionalen sowie globalen Data-Intelligence-Teams. Die Position verbindet strategische Beratung der Business Units, analytische und technische Führung, die Entwicklung von Talenten sowie die Zusammenarbeit über Länder- und Funktionsgrenzen hinweg. Die/Der Head of Data stellt sicher, dass Daten und Insights einen messbaren Beitrag zu den regionalen Businessprioritäten leisten und gleichzeitig im Einklang mit den Data-Intelligence-Strategien auf regionaler und globaler Ebene stehen.

Was du machst

  • Du übersetzt komplexe Daten durch regelmäßige und Ad-hoc-Analysen in klare, umsetzbare Empfehlungen für unterschiedliche Stakeholder und entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis der geschäftlichen Prioritäten in den betreuten Märkten.
  • Du treibst die Weiterentwicklung von Analytics von deskriptiven hin zu diagnostischen und prädiktiven Ansätzen voran und bleibst dabei eng in analytische Fragestellungen eingebunden, indem du Methoden, Herangehensweisen und Best Practices aktiv mitgestaltest.
  • Du setzt die regionale Data-Intelligence-Strategie für Deutschland, Österreich und die Schweiz um und überführst strategische Prioritäten in konkrete Maßnahmen für Reporting, Tools, Datenprodukte und Capability Building.
  • Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit mit Datenteams über mehrere Märkte hinweg, förderst den Austausch von Best Practices und stellst Konsistenz bei KPI-Definitionen, Reporting-Standards und Governance sicher.
  • Du unterstützt die Entwicklung und Implementierung regionaler KPI-Frameworks, Dashboards und Reporting-Standards sowie die Migration auf moderne Datenplattformen und KI-gestützte Workflows.
  • Du befähigst Business-Teams durch Trainings zu Datentools, Dashboards und Self-Service-Analytics-Lösungen und fungierst als Schnittstelle zwischen Business-Stakeholdern und technischen Teams.
  • Du agierst als vertrauenswürdige:r Sparringspartner:in für Senior Stakeholder in der GSA-Region, vertrittst lokale Perspektiven und Geschäftsanforderungen in regionalen und globalen Data-Initiativen und sorgst für eine erfolgreiche Balance zwischen lokalen Bedürfnissen und übergeordneten strategischen Zielsetzungen.
  • Du schaffst die Balance zwischen regionalen Standards und lokalen Marktanforderungen, überzeugst Stakeholder durch klare Kommunikation und datenbasiertes Storytelling und förderst die Akzeptanz datengetriebener Entscheidungen auf allen Ebenen der Organisation.
  • Du förderst eine Kultur der Zusammenarbeit und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, unterstützt die fachliche Weiterentwicklung des Teams und stellst eine effektive Priorisierung sowie Ressourcenplanung sicher.

Wer du bist

  • Du verfügst über umfangreiche Erfahrung in Analytics, Data Science, Insights oder vergleichbaren Bereichen, idealerweise in einem regionalen oder Multi-Markt-Umfeld.
  • Du überzeugst durch starke Kommunikations-, Stakeholder-Management- und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten und bist in der Lage, komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich aufzubereiten sowie geschäftliche Herausforderungen in datenbasierte Lösungen zu übersetzen.
  • Du hast deine Führungsstärke sowohl durch die direkte Führung von Mitarbeitenden als auch durch die fachliche Leitung von Projekten und funktionsübergreifenden Teams unter Beweis gestellt.
  • Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung im Aufbau und in der Weiterentwicklung von Reporting-Lösungen, Dashboards, KPI-Frameworks sowie im Umgang mit Data-Governance-Prinzipien mit.
  • Du verfügst über eine ausgeprägte analytische und technische Expertise sowie sehr gute Kenntnisse in SQL (Snowflake), Python und Datenvisualisierungstools wie Streamlit, Tableau oder vergleichbaren Technologien.
  • Du arbeitest kollaborativ, proaktiv und möchtest Verantwortung in einem strategischen und internationalen Umfeld übernehmen und weiter ausbauen.
  • Erfahrung in der Musikindustrie ist von Vorteil, insbesondere ein gutes Verständnis von Streaming-Geschäftsmodellen, digitalem Musikkonsum und den wesentlichen Marktdynamiken.

Wir bieten dir

  • Raum für Vielfalt und für Innovation. Die Freiheit, Prozesse und Methoden zu challengen und zu revolutionieren.
  • Individuelle Benefits-Pakete kombinierbar aus ÖPNV-Zuschuss, Job-Rad und einem Sport-Abo.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice.
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge. Ein Streaming-Abo deiner Wahl.
  • Sowie Konzerte und Events in ganz Deutschland und in unserem schicken Headquarter mitten in Schöneberg.
  • Exklusive Trainings in der hauseigenen Academy.
  • Sowie das Vertrauen, deine Projekte in Eigenregie zum Erfolg zu führen.

Wie du dich bewirbst

Dein Foto, Alter, Familienstand, deine Herkunft, Zeugnisse, die Jobs deiner Eltern und andere Merkmale benötigen wir nicht.

Zeige uns in einem CV oder einer anderen kreativen Form, was dich ausmacht, was du kannst und warum Sony Music mit dir besser klingt!

Wir freuen uns auf dich.
Sony Music sounds better with you

Sony Music Entertainment GmbH

job.title: Head of Finance, Culture Creative
job.description:
Culture Creative - Be part of the team that makes work that people remember, and creates memories for a lifetime.

Culture Creative produce predominately site-specific work for arts, cultural, and outdoor events. We operate worldwide, and deliver a wide range of events from winter festival illuminated experiences with Sony Music, to music events, street theatre and many other things in between.

At CCL we have a big vision in one hand and manage the smallest detail in the other. We create and manage experiences all over the world and our whole team is part of its success, from creative to production, from event operations to business operations, everyone has their part to play in the company's success all over the globe.

We are looking for a highly motivated Head of Finance to work alongside the Directors and senior management team to oversee and manage our finance management processes. CCL underwent an acquisition with Sony in 2022, who now own 75% of the company - thus some reporting procedures are determined by this. For the right candidate this is a chance to be the senior finance person in a growing business, working with the Directors and having exposure to Sony as part of the wider group.

We are looking for a Head of Finance, who will play a vital role in supporting our day-to-day finance requirements including planning, forecasting, analytics, and producing financial reports.

This role is based in Belford, Northumberland.

What you'll do:

  • Lead the annual budget process.
  • Prepare monthly Management Accounts.
  • Manage quarterly VAT returns.
  • Manage quarterly Corporation Tax payments and annual returns.
  • Monthly reforecast process and present these to the CCL SMT and RG LIve / Sony Music.
  • Manage budgets in multiple currencies.
  • Manage all internal systems to facilitate accurate monthly reporting protocols to RG Live/Sony Music.

Who you are:

  • Able to be part of an organisation with a strong team culture
  • Work with people who operate in different time zones and from all parts of the business
  • An excellent communicator who can work with external and internal stakeholders
  • A natural motivator, who can manage multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Someone who thrives in a challenging, fast pace environment

Experience & Skills Required

  • Proven experience in management accounting, including budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, and month-end reporting.
  • Strong ability to interpret financial data and provide insights that support strategic decision-making.
  • Experience partnering with operational leaders and senior stakeholders to drive business performance.
  • Excellent analytical skills with strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and financial systems.
  • Recognised accounting qualification (ICAEW, CIMA, ACCA, or equivalent) preferred.
  • Experience working within a fast-paced commercial environment is highly desirable.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present financial information clearly to non-finance audiences.

job.title: International Marketing Director
job.description:
This exciting new role will develop and execute global campaign strategies for Sony Music Middle East business. This role has a huge focus on innovation – you’ll be responsible for architecting our international frontline and catalogue strategy, effectively and creatively managing how our catalogue and frontline are exploited across an eclectic roster of artists.

You’ll work closely with international markets on campaign development and execution, maximizing the opportunity for artists' catalogues alongside new releases, tracking trends, and identifying opportunities around key milestones. In addition, the role will be responsible for developing and nurturing a thriving fan community for international music artists, with a primary objective of engaging and connecting with fans across various platforms, fostering a sense of community, and driving fan loyalty.

What you'll do:

Drive revenue and optimize marketing spend
  • Increase the region’s market share in global consumption of international repertoire
  • Manage audience and consumption goals for international artists and songs in the region
  • Make strategic spend decisions based on audience insights and data from different platforms
  • Identify strategic opportunities for catalogue and frontline marketing activations in digital space – spanning content marketing, anniversary campaigns, re-heat campaigns and remixes
Fan Engagement and Community Development:
  • Develop and implement strategies to grow and engage a vibrant fan community for international artists.
  • Apply best practices and latest trends in international marketing, including but not limited to the use of digital assets, AI, gaming, social and music platforms and traditional media to create meaningful fan experiences and drive consumption.
Events and Fan Experiences:
  • Plan and coordinate fan-centric events, both online and offline, such as live streams, virtual meet-ups, fan contests, and exclusive fan experiences.
  • Collaborate with event organizers, partners, and stakeholders to execute successful fan-focused initiatives.
Collaborative Partnerships:
  • Build a creative network in the region with internal teams and external partners that can help deliver marketing campaigns for international repertoire.
  • To network, connect with and pitch creative and collaborative projects for international artists or songs e.g., collaboration/remix opportunities with local artists; touring/ concerts/ festival opportunities; televised/ media opportunities, e.g. award Shows, sports opening ceremonies, etc
  • Lead a dynamic, culturally aware, and forward-thinking team that experiments with new technologies and platforms and responds quickly to adapt to new trends and fan preferences
  • Close collaboration with the international markets to implement campaign rollout, localizing activations as needed, and ensuring good communication throughout regarding strategy, asset delivery, etc.

Who you are:

Demonstrable experience in leading, developing and executing successful multicultural marketing campaigns at a regional scale in a creative industry. You have a passion for music and an understanding of various genres and music cultures. Skills include:

  • Digital Marketing and engagement: Ability to deliver campaigns and experiences, drive consumption, and increase engagement through digital platforms
  • Fandom Management: Ability to build and grow a community of followers and monetize it through a variety of online and offline channels
  • Data Literacy: Ability to analyze the music market and relevant data and apply insights to make decisions to drive/improve results
  • Strategic planning: Ability to define a strategy and a set of priorities, develop an execution plan and allocate the resources to different projects to make it happen
  • Relationship management: Build trusting and long-lasting relationships with artists and their ecosystem, as well as with external and internal stakeholders; creating a network of connections and building credibility and rapport at all levels of the business
  • Cultural awareness: Understand popular culture and the underlying cultural patterns and factors that influence behaviors in different teams and countries

What we give you:

  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next
  • We give you the platform to champion positive change, with the opportunity to contribute to our social impact, diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives

job.title: Jr Manager | Business Insights
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment Brazil Group

Sony Music Entertainment Brazil Group is one of the country’s leading entertainment groups and part of the global Sony Music Entertainment network. Our mission is to drive music and culture forward by connecting artists and fans through innovation, creativity, and excellence in execution. We operate across all areas of the recorded music business, from developing new talent to enhancing an iconic catalog, always aiming to inspire and transform through music.

The Business Intelligence (BI) area is responsible for transforming market, streaming, consumption, and revenue data into strategic information that supports decision-making across Negotiation, Commercial, Marketing, A&R, Finance, and company leadership.

We are looking for a Jr Manager to lead the Forecasts & Performance function, directly contributing to the generation of strategic insights and business decision support.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead the Forecasts & Performance function within the Business Intelligence team;
  • Manage and develop a team of 1 to 3 analysts;
  • Lead forecasts for artist signings and contract renewals, as well as analyses related to label and catalog acquisitions;
  • Develop financial models, feasibility analyses, and scenarios to support investment decisions;
  • Structure, track, and communicate the company's key corporate KPIs and business performance indicators;
  • Produce executive reports and presentations for leadership and stakeholders;
  • Lead recurring performance and strategy forums with areas such as Commercial, Marketing, and A&R;
  • Identify business opportunities, risks, and trends through data analysis;
  • Translate complex analyses into clear, actionable recommendations for business areas;
  • Ensure quality, methodological consistency, and governance of the data used in analyses;
  • Identify opportunities to automate and evolve the team's analytical processes.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree completed in Engineering, Business Administration, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, or related fields;
  • Advanced Excel skills for financial modeling and investment analysis;
  • Strong ability to build executive reports and handle/analyze large volumes of data;
  • Strong analytical thinking, executive communication, and storytelling with data;
  • Ability to influence and build alignment across different areas, with strong stakeholder management;
  • Sense of priority, organization, and leadership/team development skills;
  • Advanced English (required); Spanish is a plus.

Expected experience:

  • Experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics, Strategic Planning, FP&A, or related areas;
  • Experience with financial modeling, forecasting, and scenario building;
  • Track record of monitoring business performance and indicators;
  • Experience leading presentations and discussions with senior stakeholders;
  • History of close partnership with business areas such as Commercial, Marketing, Finance, Strategy, or Product;
  • Prior experience with people management or leadership of multidisciplinary projects/squads;
  • Knowledge of Python, Tableau, Looker, or cloud data environments (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar) is a plus;
  • Knowledge of the music, streaming, and digital consumption market is a strong advantage;
  • Experience with M&A processes, valuation, or asset assessment is a plus;
  • Experience in media, music, entertainment, or digital industries is a strong advantage.

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative, and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day;
  • A modern environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork, empowering you to do your best work;
  • Investment in your growth and professional development, enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community;
  • Space to accelerate progress, innovate, and create what’s next;
  • A platform to lead positive change, with opportunities to contribute to our social impact, diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives;
  • A benefits package designed to support both you and your family, from wellness programs to paid time off that helps balance work and personal life;
  • Time off during the year-end holiday season.

job.title: Jr. Manager, Solutions, Bogotá - The Orchard
job.description:
ABOUT THE ORCHARD

The Orchard is a leading full-service music distribution company operating in 50+ markets worldwide. The Orchard empowers creators and businesses to grow and evolve in the dynamic, global music industry. We specialize in being Artist focused, blending industry expertise and technology, leveraging data to drive success, and providing streamlined digital and physical solutions. The Orchard’s comprehensive artist & label services offerings include marketing, sync licensing, premium video services, transparent data analysis, advertising, rights management, radio promotion, D2C, and more.

The Orchard focuses on providing a comfortable, social, and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity.

Our company is seeking a Manager, Solutions to join our dynamic team. As the Manager, Solutions, you will work closely with both Orchard clients and internal teams, overseeing key elements of the client experience, and synthesizing interactions across Orchard’s internal departments. You will be responsible for providing a centralized, solutions based voice in support of the Relationship Management team and supervising the comprehensive onboarding process, focusing on a positive first experience for clients. In addition, you will ensure a continued, positive client experience around all operational questions and concerns. This is a highly responsible role that requires proactive problem solving skills, a keen eye for detail, and a love for all types of music.

What you'll do:

  • Serve as the primary representative of Orchard’s administrative teams (including legal, finance, and operations) to Orchard clients, addressing issues, gathering feedback, and advocating for client needs within the organization
  • Main point of contact for questions pertaining to all operational functions across the organization, serving as a focal point of information and defining internal processes and procedures
  • Work closely with relationship management and rights management teams verifying release metadata compliance and changes to release statuses, including deletions and pricing adjustments
  • Advise on client product logistics and operations and manage complex digital release set-ups in accordance with label and campaign specified needs
  • Focus on clear, solution based responses to internal and external queries regarding client questions
  • Understand how to troubleshoot problems effectively and identify the right teams to interact with in order to get reliable solutions and answers
  • Ability to handle high volume inbound needs from labels and ensure they are being addressed in a timely manner

Who you are:

  • Patient and empathetic
  • Effective communicator on phone, email, and in person
  • Resourceful, problem solver, and takes initiative - an expert and motivated troubleshooter
  • Multi-tasker with supreme attention to detail, follow-through and effective prioritization
  • Multilingual skills preferred, but not required
  • Prior experience with CRMs preferred, but not required
  • Fluent English proficiency required

What we give you:

  • An opportunity to influence music on a global stage.
  • A modern, diverse and creative work environment.
  • An investment in your learning & development.
  • A comprehensive and attractive benefits package including healthcare coverage, voluntary benefits, and family resources.

The Orchard is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of age, disability, national origin, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, veteran or military status, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

job.title: Lead Software Engineer
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we're committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

Sony Music's Product, Design, Engineering & Global Operations (PDEGO) team is seeking a Lead Software Engineer to join our engineering team in our London office. Our PDEGO suite powers all of Sony Music's most critical business capabilities—ensuring monetization, data and analytics depth, marketing and music release at scale for artists across the globe.

As a technical lead, you'll help shape the architecture, engineering standards, and long-term technical direction of one of our product spaces at global scale. You'll work closely with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to modernize systems while mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence across the team.

What you'll do:

  • Lead the technical design and implementation of scalable software solutions supporting Sony Music's critical global B2B2C platforms.
  • Drive architecture decisions across distributed systems, APIs, data pipelines, and platform services.
  • Partner closely with Product, Operations, and teams of stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into elegant technical solutions.
  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code while establishing engineering best practices across the team
  • Lead technical design sessions, architecture reviews, and modernization initiatives
  • Design resilient services and integrations with internal and third-party platforms
  • Champion application reliability, performance, observability, and operational excellence
  • Mentor engineers through technical coaching, code reviews, and architectural guidance
  • Identify technical debt and lead initiatives to improve scalability, maintainability, and developer productivity
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues and drive root cause analysis across distributed systems
  • Collaborate with engineering leadership to define the long-term technical roadmap for the platform you are focused on

Who you are:

Seeking 10+ years of software engineering experience in the following areas:

  • Experience implementing distributed systems
  • Strong experience with Python and JavaScript
  • Experience building frontend applications using TypeScript and React
  • Experience with various database technologies and query languages (we use Snowflake, MySQL, Neo4j, Kafka, OpenSearch, and more)
  • Experience designing microservices and APIs using REST, HTTP, and OAuth
  • Comfortable with AWS cloud technologies
  • Experience using log analysis and monitoring tools to investigate production issues and improve reliability
  • Experience writing unit, integration, and automated tests
  • Experience working within Agile development teams
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence engineering and business stakeholders
  • Passion for solving complex technical problems and mentoring engineers

The ideal candidate

  • Deep understanding of software architecture, domain modeling, and scalable system design
  • Experience designing data models and optimizing schemas for complex business domains
  • Experience working with large datasets and high-volume systems
  • Can mobilize engineering teams around a technical vision and lead execution across multiple initiatives
  • Establishes engineering best practices, coding standards, and development processes that improve quality and delivery
  • Strong systems-thinking mindset with the ability to balance immediate business needs against long-term platform investments
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex technical initiatives without direct people management responsibility
  • Passionate about mentoring engineers and fostering a culture of technical excellence
  • Interest in music, technology, and building systems that directly support artists and creators

What we give you:

  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best
  • Hybrid work environment: Our London office is designed for collaboration, offering a balanced hybrid setup (3 days in office / 2 days remote)
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next
  • We give you the platform to champion positive change, with the opportunity to contribute to our social impact, diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives
  • We provide an excellent range of benefits like private medical cover, a generous pension scheme, life assurance, income protection, plus loads of music industry perks. There’s also time off over winter break

job.description:
This is an exciting opportunity for a self-motivated legal professional to make a meaningful impact in a fast-changing, creative, and collaborative environment within the global music and entertainment industry.

As Legal Counsel, you will lead and manage legal matters across Sony Music Middle East, while partnering with internal stakeholders to support a wide range of business activities.

You will ensure legal compliance and enable the business to navigate complex commercial, licensing, and intellectual property issues with clarity and confidence.

What you'll do:

  • Negotiate, draft, and review a wide range of commercial agreements, including third-party relationships, license-in and license-out deals and distribution agreements, artist contracts and other key commercial transactions.
  • Provide legal guidance and support to business teams during local artist signings and other contractual negotiations.

job.title: Manager - Sync & Licensing
job.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and commercially driven Sync & Licensing Manager to drive revenue opportunities through the licensing of music across film, television, streaming platforms, advertising, gaming, social media, brand partnerships, and other emerging media formats. The role will be responsible for identifying licensing opportunities, managing client relationships, negotiating commercial terms, and ensuring smooth execution of licensing agreements.

What you'll do:

  • Identify and develop synchronization licensing opportunities across advertising agencies, production houses, OTT platforms, broadcasters and brands. Achieve licensing revenue targets through proactive business development efforts.
  • Licensing & Deal Negotiation. Negotiate commercial terms for synchronization and master use licenses. Structure licensing deals in line with company policies and rights ownership requirements.
  • Pitch relevant repertoire for films, web series, advertisements, promotional campaigns, and digital content. Build and maintain strong relationships with music supervisors, production houses, advertising agencies, and brand marketing teams.
  • Work closely with legal and business affairs teams to execute agreements efficiently. Manage renewals, extensions, and amendments of existing licensing arrangements. The Manager, A&R with AWAL will be responsible for finding and acquiring recording artists, songs and producers as well as leading artist development efforts for artists in all genres. This role will report directly to the President and Head of A&R, AWAL North America.

What you'll do:

  • Attend live shows at clubs, showcases, concerts, and other venues.
  • Provide comprehensive feedback on new music to the Head of A&R and/or other requesting senior A&R executives.
  • Propose new artists for AWAL.

  • Coordinate pre-production and production, mixing, mastering

  • Maintain files/records on all shows attended.
  • Work closely with other label departments/employees including marketing, publicity, sales to determine follow up steps once the record has been completed.

Who you are:

  • Passionate about all things music.
  • Have three (3) + years of music or entertainment industry experience, with a demonstrated track record of finding new and emerging artists/talent.
  • Have knowledge of the different steps in the making of and release of a record required.
  • Must have prior experience working with artists from a variety of genres.
  • A proactive, self-starter who has strong problem solving, social, and interpersonal skills.
  • Exceptional communication and time management skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while still paying attention to detail and spotting potential issues is absolutely key.

job.title: Manager, Paid Media & Growth Strategy, LATAM - The Orchard
job.description:
The Orchard is a leading global music distributor and Artist & Label services company operating in 50+ markets worldwide. The Orchard empowers creators and businesses to grow and adapt in the dynamic global music industry. We specialize in being artist focused, blending industry expertise and technology, leveraging data to drive success, and providing streamlined digital and physical distribution solutions. The Orchard’s comprehensive artist & label services offerings include marketing, sync licensing, premium video services, transparent data analysis, advertising, rights management, radio promotion, D2C, and more.

The Orchard focuses on providing a comfortable, social, and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity.

The Orchard has an immediate opening for a Manager, Paid Media & Growth Strategy in our Chile office. We are looking for a motivated individual with a passion for music and relevant experience in paid media, growth marketing, digital advertising, media buying, or related fields. This role plays an integral part in the Paid Media & Growth Strategy team, helping to advance our industry-leading services for distributed artists, labels, and owned-and-operated properties. You'll work alongside label and artist teams, Relationship Managers, Marketing teams, and the Global Paid Media team to create bespoke paid media strategies that amplify releases, grow fanbases, and help achieve artist and label objectives.

Located in our Chile office, this position will be hyper-focused on supporting our Latin labels and artists and will be responsible for developing and executing paid media campaigns across LATAM. This position reports directly to The Orchard Chile’s Country Manager, and receives functional guidance from the Senior Director of Global Paid Media & Growth Strategy in the NYC office.

What You'll Do:

  • Develop and optimize bespoke paid media and audience growth strategies for The Orchard's Latin labels and artists, partnering closely with Relationship Managers, Marketing teams, and label stakeholders to align campaign plans with artist, audience, and business objectives.
  • Serve as a strategic partner to Relationship Managers, Marketing teams, and labels across our extensive LATAM roster, building trusted relationships with internal stakeholders, vendors, and platform partners.
  • Collaborate with media buyers and cross-functional teams to troubleshoot challenges, identify opportunities, and drive campaign performance with strong attention to detail.
  • Build thorough analyses, client-facing reports, and actionable insights using advertising, marketing, and The Orchard’s proprietary metrics, while partnering with global team members to share learnings and best practices.
  • Analyze campaign performance data to identify trends, benchmarks, opportunities, and recommendations that inform future strategy and ongoing optimization.
  • Participate in internal brainstorms, strategy sessions, and client-facing meetings to develop innovative approaches that drive meaningful audience growth and elevate artist campaigns, while collaborating closely with global Paid Media & Growth Strategy team members to share learnings, align on best practices, and contribute to the evolution of our services.
  • Identify opportunities to test and innovate across advertising platforms, evaluate emerging media channels, leverage new products and beta opportunities, and partner with regional and global leadership to identify opportunities to grow and evolve Paid Media & Growth Strategy services across LATAM.
  • Contribute to the development of best practices, strategic frameworks, and process improvements across the global Paid Media & Growth Strategy organization.
  • Assist with the monthly accounting and campaign reconciliation process.

Who You Are:

  • 3-5+ years of experience in paid media, digital advertising, music marketing, audience development, ad operations, or related fields.
  • Fluent in Spanish and English, with strong written and verbal communication skills. Deep understanding of Latin music, current music industry trends, and today’s digital marketing landscape.
  • Experience developing paid media strategies and managing campaigns across platforms such as Meta, TikTok, Google, YouTube, Spotify, and other relevant advertising channels.
  • Strong understanding of paid media fundamentals, platform best practices, audience targeting, measurement, optimization, and content-driven marketing strategies.
  • Ability to leverage internal and publicly available data sources (e.g., Chartmetric, Spotify for Artists, social platform insights, etc.) to identify audience opportunities, behaviors, and growth strategies.
  • Experience analyzing campaign performance data and translating insights into actionable recommendations using reporting and analytics tools (e.g., Datorama or similar platforms).
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.
  • Experience working with media partners, platform representatives, agencies, and external vendors; experience with OOH campaigns is a plus.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate fast-paced environments and support high-priority projects.
  • Passion for music, artist development, and audience growth.

What We Give You:

job.title: Merchandise Lead, Finance Supervisor - GFFS
job.description:
At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time. We ensure suppliers and artists are paid on time for the amazing work they create. We work closely with the local finance teams around the world, which means we have an excellent understanding of how the company operates and are kept up to date with key developments in this exciting and fast-paced industry. Our teams play a key role in ensuring Sony Music achieve their annual goals each year.

As our Global Finance Shared Service (GFSS), you will be overseeing the following USA merchandise business areas:

  • Accuracy of the accounting entries made by GFSS across tour, e-commerce, and licensing revenue streams
  • Accountability for the output of our Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) partner.
  • Be the primary GFSS contact for other GFSS departments, and the merchandise and label finance or sales teams.

This role requires a highly organized, confident, motivated team player who operates well under pressure.

It is a role for someone equally comfortable designing a process and executing one.

What You'll Do:

Accounting Integrity — Merchandise Business

  • Own the accuracy and integrity of financial reporting within GFSS’ scope across all merchandise revenue streams. Including revenue recognition, cost of sales, vendor obligations, and balance sheet positions
  • Act as the accounting lead to ensure proper accounting for unusual scenarios
  • Review and approve all reconciliations, reports, and financial summaries before they are sent to other departments and stakeholders
  • Maintain a thorough working knowledge of how each merchandise revenue stream flows through SAP so that accounting positions can be taken and explained or justified
  • Ensure the accounting is structured to withstand external, statutory, and artist audits at any point

Process Design and Problem Solving

job.description:
As a Product Manager, you'll play a central role in bringing Sony Music artists and releases to market. Working across a diverse roster of local and international talent, you'll lead the planning and execution of release campaigns, helping artists connect with fans and achieve commercial success across physical and digital channels.

Partnering closely with artists, managers and internal teams across Marketing, Digital, Sales, A&R and Operations, you'll develop innovative campaigns, oversee release strategy, manage budgets, and identify opportunities to grow audiences, engagement and revenue. This is a fast-paced, highly collaborative role for someone who combines creativity, commercial thinking and a passion for music.

job.description:

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

Sony Music's Product, Design, Engineering & Global Operations (PDEGO) team is looking for a Product Manager to join our RoyaltyShare product team in our London office. ● Excellent prioritization skills with the ability to balance customer needs, technical constraints, and business priorities

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. From being home to the world’s first music label to shaping the future of music, entertainment, and technology, we’ve played a pioneering role in music history. Today, we operate in more than 60 countries, supporting a diverse roster of global superstars, independent artists, and visionary creators. Our Global Finance Shared Services Centre plays a vital role in supporting Sony Music’s core business worldwide. In our Royalty Operations team, you will be a key contributor to the day-to-day operations within Royalties and will be involved in all aspects of artist royalties, managing and delivering accurate and timely royalty statements, performing reviews, analysis and reconciliations, managing and prioritizing clearing of suspense items, responding to internal and external inquiries, contract interpretation, coding and special projects. In Royalty Accounting, you will be responsible for all aspects of royalty accounting for designated affiliates, ensuring the accuracy and completeness of accounting closes, performing account analysis and reconciliation, and royalty reporting. You will work closely with all areas of the royalty department, corporate, global reporting and planning and external auditors.

The GFSS team is based in our modern workspace at the Elektrownia Powiśle centre in Warsaw.

If you’re looking to grow your career in finance within a global, creative, and fast‑paced organisation, we’d love to hear from you.

What you'll do as a Royalties Accountant:

  • Prepare, review and analyze capitalized balances, associated royalty payables, recoupable recording and marketing costs, for reasonableness and proper accounting treatment. Prepare label talent provision and marketing recovery journal entries
  • Review foreign royalty expense and prepare monthly accrual vs. actual analysis, intercompany reconciliations and associated journal entries
  • Perform various balance sheet account analysis related to artist, copyright, union and foreign royalties to substantiate balances and clear reconciling items. This includes any royalty system to general ledger reconciliations
  • Monitor, review and analyze artist/copyright/union expense for reasonableness and proper accounting treatment. Prepare manual journal entries to adjust royalty expense
  • Special projects/other duties as assigned by management
  • Review and improve internal controls where applicable

What you'll do as a Royalties Operations Analyst:

Royalty Contract Interpretation and Coding:

  • Read the artist, producer, and/or third-party contract to obtain relevant information.
  • Interpret contractual clauses related to the royalty obligation, including understanding the legal definitions of terms used within the contracts or related documents.
  • Coordinate with Label’s legal and business affairs staff to obtain missing information.
  • Set up and maintain accurate contractual information within the royalty system

Royalty Statement Review:

  • Prepare the appropriate accounting statements as contractually required,
  • Review sales and costs to ensure they are accurately stated.
  • Update and analyze unrecouped balance analysis at account level.
  • Prepare and research variance-reporting analysis to understand fluctuations with balances and payments.

Sales & Suspense Management:

  • Review the new release schedule and work with the affiliate personal to ensure new releases are coded within the appropriate timeframe.
  • Run sales query and reviewing results with Manager.
  • Prepare and review suspense reports and provide reports to affiliate on a weekly basis.

Inquiries & Special Projects:

  • Serve as Point of Contact for various internal and external inquiries related to assigned accounts.
  • Provide Manager with status reports regarding the assigned artist accounts.
  • Provide guidance to the entry-level staff members including providing an overview of tools available to assist in the completion of the assigned tasks.
  • Assist in process design improvements focused on enhancing quality while reducing resource requirements.

Who you are:

  • Bachelor’s Degree, preferably in Business Administration, Economics, Accounting or Finance
  • Relevant work experience
  • Strong proficiency in Word, Excel (Pivot tables & VLOOKUP) and Outlook; SAP, EROS, and JIRA experience a plus
  • Detail oriented individual with strong organizational and leadership skills that can handle multiple tasks simultaneously

job.title: Senior Business Solutions Specialist - PDEGO
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

About Business Solutions

Business Solutions partners with our label, marketing, and release planning teams to build the tools and workflows that help them run more effectively. We operate as a trusted internal partner, not an order-taking function. Our work is guided by three principles: Fail Fast: test ideas quickly, and don't let perfection get in the way of progress; Learn Quickly: treat every iteration as a chance to learn, document, and adapt; and Move Forward: keep the work, and the people we support, moving.

Role Summary

The Senior Business Solutions Specialist is the trusted day-to-day partner for a dedicated portfolio of business units spanning US and international markets, owning the full solution lifecycle from discovery through delivery, while mentoring the broader NYC Specialist team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for your assigned business units
  • Run discovery, scoping, and requirements-gathering sessions independently
  • Build and maintain business systems, automations, and workflows supporting label, marketing, and release operations
  • Write specs and requirements for integrations with internal Sony Music systems
  • Lead data migrations for assigned business units
  • Test solutions with end users and incorporate feedback quickly
  • Share best practices with the broader team, contributing repeatable patterns and playbook content to support other junior Specialists
  • Escalate architecture/platform-level questions to the Architect
  • Identify opportunities to centralize and standardize workflows across assigned BUs
  • Lead enablement and change-adoption efforts within your portfolio – training business users to use AI tools (e.g., Claude Cowork) to solve their own recurring problems, not just handing off finished solutions
  • Define success metrics for initiatives in your portfolio and use adoption/usage data to evaluate outcomes and guide iteration
  • Ensure initiatives align with governance, privacy, security, and compliance requirements, partnering with the Architect and relevant stakeholders (Legal, InfoSec) as needed


Required Qualifications

  • 5-8+ years in business/systems analysis, solutions consulting, or enterprise no-code/low-code platform administration, with the judgment to build solutions that are secure, scalable, and well-governed
  • Demonstrated ability to run point independently with senior business stakeholders
  • Strong requirements-gathering, process-mapping, and documentation skills
  • Experience with data migrations
  • Comfortable managing multiple concurrent projects and business units
  • Extensive A.I. experience using tools such as Claude Cowork, ChatGPT Work, Google Gemini
  • Basic scripting, SQL, or automation-logic familiarity
  • Tool-agnostic and adaptable to learning new platforms as workflows expand
  • Experience leading change adoption or user enablement efforts within a business function
  • Comfortable defining measures of success and using data to evaluate outcomes


Nice to Have (not required)

  • Music industry experience; media & entertainment adjacency (rights, royalties, metadata) a plus
  • Airtable certification or deep hands-on Airtable expertise (our current core platform)

A Note on Applying

  • We encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching
