Alamo Records, Santa Anna Label Group, Foundation Media, and OVO Sound operate across a fast-moving, rapidly growing portfolio of labels, joint ventures, distribution partners, and artist deals. We are looking for a strategic, commercially minded Senior Director of Finance & Accounting who understands the broader label business and can support decisions around artists, joint ventures, acquisitions, catalog, cash flow, and profitability with insightful analysis. The ideal candidate will bring deep accounting expertise, strong operational discipline, and exceptional analytical and financial modeling skills.

In the near term, this person, in coordination with SME central teams, will provide hands-on leadership to strengthen accounting practices, including intercompany accounting, financial operations, and metadata management, to ensure accurate and comprehensive reporting. The Senior Director of Finance & Accounting will also be responsible for the monthly close and forecast, as well as the annual budgeting process. As part of a small, flat team supported by the wider Sony Music Finance, Accounting, and IT infrastructure, this person will touch virtually every aspect of label finance and accounting. The role requires someone who navigate a complex organizational structure and bring the technical accounting expertise the group needs. This will require taking ownership of detailed project management and process design and execution. Through this work, the Senior Director of Finance will build the experience and perspective needed to grow into a future CFO-level leader for the organization.

What you'll do:

  • Lead accounting setup, cleanup, and ongoing financial control processes across Alamo, Santa Anna, Foundation, OVO, and related ventures, with particular focus on entity structure, intercompany accounting, eliminations, reconciliations, and balance sheet integrity.
  • Strengthen accounting controls, workflows, and ownership across recurring close, reporting, intercompany, and operational finance processes.
  • Oversee monthly close, management reporting, variance analysis, balance sheet reviews, and corporate deliverables, ensuring results are accurate, timely, and clearly explained to senior management and SME stakeholders.
  • Manage annual budgeting, monthly forecasting, and long-range planning across labels, joint ventures, acquisitions, and new business initiatives, connecting financial plans to operating priorities, deal terms, and profitability targets.
  • Partner with SME central teams, including Accounting, Global Finance, Tax, Royalties, JV Accounting, Metadata, and technology partners, to improve financial operations, data quality, metadata workflows, systems integration, and reporting consistency across a complex organizational structure.
  • Support deal analysis, artist and label investment decisions, catalog and acquisition opportunities, royalty and recoupment analysis, and new venture business plans, ensuring financial assumptions align with contractual terms and operational realities.
  • Act as a senior finance business partner to label leadership and department team members across business units to help drive revenue growth, profitability, cash discipline, and operating efficiency all the business.
  • Serve as a reliable #2 to the CFO, leading detailed project management, integration efforts, process improvement initiatives, and other high-priority finance projects as a hands-on operator and strategic finance leader.

job.description:
In this role you will be an integral member of the Reward function in our People Experience Team, managing three UK payrolls, in addition to smaller European payrolls. Reporting to Director, Global Total Rewards, with a dotted line to the VP, Payroll, you will be the subject matter expert for payroll, working closely with the wider generalist teams and finance teams to ensure data is accurately inputted, processed, approved and reported on a monthly and annual basis. This role requires a start date of 25th September 2026. Hybrid working options are available

What you'll do:

Payroll Strategy and Vendor Management

  • Responsible for leading and delivering payroll projects for the region, including but not limited to, the implementation of new payrolls

job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

Sony Music is seeking a VP, Fan Engagement to join the global Sony Music D2C organization. Reporting directly to the Head of Sony Music D2C, this role will lead the Fan Engagement function within The Greenhouse, Sony Music’s centralized D2C division.

The purpose of this team is to make D2C marketing a constant, evergreen discipline for labels that today focus their effort on the release cycle. It is a central, cross-label team that acts as an extension of label digital marketing and international market execution — providing D2C expertise, filling execution capacity gaps, and building the frameworks that let others work well — while leaving artist narrative and campaign strategy with the label.

This is deliberately a small centre rather than a large production function. Labels resource their own D2C people for their own repertoire; this team supplies the toolkit, standards and process that unlock the value those teams create. Where a label does not yet have that capability, the team carries more of the work early and steps back as the label staffs up. There is no embedded headcount — the team operates as a shared service across labels and territories.

The VP is accountable for the quality and commercial performance of D2C fan engagement across the roster, and for the relationships that make it work: with label marketing, creative and commerce teams, with the international marketing team, and with partners across The Greenhouse. Much of the work is proposing rather than deciding — the label approves throughout — which makes credibility, judgement and influence without authority central to the role.

The role leads a team of five to six spanning creative direction and design systems, design and production, D2C product management, and CRM and lifecycle marketing. The ideal candidate combines strong D2C product instincts, fan marketing expertise, creative sensibility and operational rigour, with a deep understanding of how fans engage with artists, music, merchandise and culture across global markets.

How This Team Operates

  • A small centre, not a production house. Labels resource their own D2C people; this team supplies the toolkit, standards and process that let them create value.
  • Proposes rather than decides. Recommendations are put to the label for approval. The team holds no authority independent of the label, and labels retain final say on every D2C decision.
  • Reuses and refines rather than originates. Artist narrative and campaign concept sit with the label. The team adapts existing creative for D2C — merchandise creative is the one area where it originates.
  • Depth varies by situation. On a frontline release the team is advisory. Between release cycles, on evergreen catalog, it is the primary owner of D2C activity with label approval. On superstar campaigns it is fully engaged alongside label and international teams.
  • Depth also tapers by label. Heavier engagement early where D2C capability is thin, lighter as the label staffs up — every label lands in the same place.
  • Always-on, not campaign-by-campaign. Label marketing works per release; international marketing works per market, per release. This team spans releases and keeps D2C running between them.

What you'll do:

Creative

  • Build the D2C design system — templates, asset taxonomies and scalable creative frameworks that let labels and territories execute high-quality D2C creative at volume across markets.
  • Establish D2C visual and email standards, including motion templates, content hierarchy, build quality and testing practice, with labels supplying artist voice and brand direction.
  • Produce merchandise and D2C product creative that labels do not produce in-house — pack shots, product mockups, banners and bundle imagery.
  • Produce D2C social assets and CRM builds when label teams lack the capacity, and refine or extend existing creative for D2C where core assets are limited.
  • Create pitch decks and D2C creative concepts that help label teams sell campaign ideas internally and to artist teams.
  • Resolve international asset adaptation, where D2C creative differs meaningfully by territory and is today handled late and inconsistently.
  • Supply campaign creative and merchandising direction to the Store Experience team, who build and run the storefronts.

Product

  • Establish the process linking D2C with marketing, sales and merchandising — the coordination gap labels consistently identify as their biggest constraint, where marketing learns of product and release decisions too late to build a proper campaign.
  • Develop D2C product insight across bundles, exclusives, premium formats and drops, proposed to the label for approval.
  • Own D2C pricing and promotional recommendations across markets, with label approval and international input from the commercial strategy team.
  • Run competitor scanning, launch retrospectives and evergreen product ideation, bringing trend and net-new format thinking to label and commerce teams.
  • Build lifecycle and scarcity frameworks — pre-order windows, limited editions, flash drops, live-show tie-ins, gated access and evergreen replenishment.
  • Ensure D2C approaches are globally consistent where scale matters and locally adapted where fan behaviour, language, pricing, territory, chart rules or fulfilment realities require it.
  • Partner with operations on launch readiness, product setup and localisation, and supply demand signals into the forecasting and insights team.

Marketing, CRM & Campaign Operations

  • Train label teams to think D2C natively — what assets are needed, at what cadence, and which products fit which moments.
  • Build the D2C campaign cadence, framework and schedule that keeps label campaigns on track — a named gap where no one currently owns the rhythm of D2C activity across a release.
  • Own domestic D2C CRM and lifecycle marketing across the full fan journey — email, SMS and owned channels — including automated journeys that keep fans engaged between release moments, not only campaign sends.
  • Develop a fan segmentation framework spanning casual fans, active fans and superfans, enabling more personalised communication and experiences across every channel.
  • Build the first-party data strategy that captures fan preferences and behaviours to create richer fan profiles, and own domestic fan acquisition.
  • Provide D2C budget deployment and retargeting guidance, developed with the label.
  • Create D2C paid media best-practice frameworks across Meta, TikTok and Google, with clear guidance on campaign structure, audience strategy and measurement. D2C performance marketing is a distinct discipline from awareness and engagement advertising and is not resourced consistently across labels today.
  • Define flywheel analytics, channel health standards and reporting — tracking acquisition, engagement, retention and monetisation, and how fans move from streaming, social and owned properties into D2C channels.
  • Establish best practice for loyalty and VIP programmes that reward engagement rather than purchase alone, social commerce integrations, and creator and affiliate partnerships — with labels executing against those standards.
  • Advise label teams on preorder strategy, launch timing, segmentation, local market messaging and campaign optimisation, and drive a test-and-learn culture across creative and messaging.
  • Over time, develop predictive audience modelling to identify high-value fans and churn risk, and prepare the design system and asset taxonomy for AI-assisted asset generation.

Partnership & Interlock

  • Serve as the central D2C fan engagement partner to labels, artist teams and territories — including Columbia, RCA, Epic and the UK — and to Ceremony of Roses, The Orchard and merchandise partners.
  • Define and operate the interlock with the international marketing team, who own market localisation and in-territory execution for US repertoire. This role owns the domestic equivalent and sets the global standard; the handoff between the two requires clear, agreed triggers.
  • Work across The Greenhouse with the Store Experience, Business Operations, Commercial Strategy and Customer Satisfaction functions, whose scope adjoins this team’s at multiple points.
  • Build the relationships and credibility to influence without authority across a highly matrixed global organisation.

Who you are:

  • 10+ years across fan engagement, D2C marketing, CRM, eCommerce, merchandising or digital marketing in a high-volume, multi-stakeholder environment; music or entertainment experience strongly preferred.
  • Deep understanding of music fan behaviour, artist marketing, D2C commerce and fan engagement ecosystems.
  • Track record of enabling distributed teams — building playbooks, standards and frameworks that others execute — rather than only running work centrally. Comfortable moving between doing the work and teaching it.
  • Able to operate through influence rather than authority, and to build the trust that makes label teams want to work with a central function.
  • Strong knowledge of lifecycle marketing, CRM platforms, email and SMS execution, segmentation and first-party data strategy. Familiarity with Shopify ecosystems and D2C storefront operations.
  • Practical experience with D2C performance marketing — paid media planning, audience targeting and return on ad spend — or the judgement to build that capability.
  • Strong creative instincts and experience collaborating across design, marketing, merchandising and product functions, with the credibility to work alongside label creative teams.
  • Experience building scalable campaign workflows, design systems and operational best practice in high-volume environments.
  • Global mindset and sensitivity to local market nuance — fan behaviour, pricing, language, cultural context, release priorities, chart rules and fulfilment realities.
  • Passion for music, fandom, culture and evolving consumer experiences.

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next
  • Time off for a winter recess

Sony Music is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of age, disability, national origin, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, veteran or military status, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

job.title: Assignment Editor and Producer
job.description: ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM: TelevisaUnivision is seeking a talented Assignment Editor/Producer with a dynamic and creative attitude. This position is responsible for sourcing great content and managing logistics for our live crews. They will also identify, develop and contribute story ideas and participate actively in coverage decisions of special news programs. Gather elements for coverage and managing the logistics for story shoots and execution. YOUR DAY-DAY: Assignment Editor/Producer will research and produce daily story ideas for air. Assign and provide necessary information to crews. Monitor for any potential breaking news Coordinate interviews and plan for future coverage and prioritized events. Maintain constant and clear communication with producers, field crews and or agencies, while obtaining and confirming information. Capture video feeds from the field and assist editors with any troubleshooting needs. Work with reporters to conceptualize, coordinate and approve story packages to conform to station policies, practices and procedures. Work with other Assignment Editors and newsroom managers to assign stories and monitor story coverage. YOU HAVE: Minimum 2 years of experience in the Assignment Desk Possess extensive experience in and proven strategies for sourcing and sharing content through social media. Fluent in Spanish (read and write) Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis Ability to stand, walk, bend, type, and sit for up to (8) hours TelevisaUnivision is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

job.title: Becario para el área de Ventas en Proyectos Especiales
job.description: ¡TelevisaUnivision está en búsqueda de un Becario para el área de Ventas en Proyectos Especiales! En TelevisaUnivision encontrarás un ambiente amigable y lleno de equidad para crecer personal y profesionalmente. Dirigido a estudiantes que desean cumplir con sus prácticas profesionales o servicio social en un entorno corporativo , esta experiencia representa una excelente oportunidad para aplicar tus conocimientos en la práctica. Esta experiencia formativa no contempla compensación económica, pero brinda acceso a procesos reales y acompañamiento profesional por parte de un equipo altamente capacitado. ¡Únete y sé parte de este gran equipo dinámico! Acerca del puesto y equipo Como parte de tus prácticas profesionales/servicio social podrás aprender de la mano de expertos en publicidad y ventas sobre el desarrollo estratégico y creativo de propuestas publicitarias innovadoras y multiplaforma en el equipo de ProyectosEspeciales, una divisón de la Dirección General de Ventas Sector Público en el que creamos experiencias que conectan a nuestros clientes (Gobierno) con nuestras audiencias en TV Abirta, TV de Paga, Streaming, Social Media, Apps & Sitios, TV Local, entre otros. La innovación y el crecimiento son parte fundamental de nuestra atmósfera y se ven reflajadas en cada una de las iniciativas cross-media en la omnicanalidad de TelevisaUnivision. El entorno dinámico, multidisciplinario, social, estratégico y creativo del área y de la empresa permiten el desarrollo de unambiente que privilegia el trabajo en equipo, la colaboración que genera valor, le eficiencia y la productividad. Sobre ti Si te encuentras estudiando carreras relacionadas a Comunicación, Publicidad, Administración, Mercadotecnia, Diseño, Arte Digital y/o eres una persona apasionada de la publicidad y de los medios que involucran proyectos gubernamentales relacionados a temas sociales o turísticos, esta es una oportunidad para aprender con prácticasobre el desarrollo de estrategias publicitarias de impacto cultural de la mano de un equipo de expertos. Tu día a día incluirá: Descarga y renombrado de testigos, elaboración de reportes de transmisión, validación de facturas de consumos. Recopilación de documentos para integración de carpeta Revisión de bitácoras contra ordenes Recabar firmas con apoderados legales y jurídico Solicitud de documentos legales Alimentación de archivos internos Requisitos Estar cursando últimos semestres de la universidad. Disponibilidad para asistir de manera presencial a la oficina Trabajo en equipo. Proactividad. Manejo de paquetería Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word). Lo que te ofrecemos: Este es un programa creado para fomentar el crecimiento profesional de las nuevas generaciones a través del intercambio de conocimiento y experiencia que otorgarán valor para el cumplimiento de las horas de Servicio Social y/o Prácticas Profesionales solicitadas por la institución educativa. job.title: Digital Account Manager
job.description: We are looking for a Digital Account manager to join our team! As an integral member of our team, you will partner with the Sales Account Executives from inception to execution of digital & cross platform ad campaigns that meet our clients’ objectives. Our team plays an essential role in driving ad sales revenue across our multimedia - digital, streaming, linear, social, experiential, and audio properties. You will collaborate with cross functional teams internally including planners, Operations, Marketing & Research. You will also work directly with clients to ensure the success of sponsorship programs and customized marketing initiatives. YOUR DAY-DAY: Main point of contact for key accounts for digital campaigns post sale Attend sales calls & internal brainstorming sessions. Coordinate all sponsorship executions across internal and external stakeholders. Develop strategic analysis and reporting during Upfront seasons and scatter markets Monitor all campaigns’ performance, and suggest improvements throughout the process Upsell clients on additional impressions and/or programs based on performance Partner with revenue management, inventory, research and analytics teams to create recap reports for key clients Collaborate with Ad Ops and trafficking teams to ensure flawless campaign launches and minimize setup issues. YOU HAVE: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience Minimum 2+ years of relevant experience with an agency, brand, and/or publisher Knowledge of advertising solutions across social, audio, display, streaming video, experiential and sports sponsorship platforms Must have knowledge and understanding of digital video and advanced audience targeting Proficiency in Excel and advanced data tools is a plus Must have knowledge and understanding of all client campaign strategies, brand messaging, and integration expectations Media math experience is preferred Strong problem-solving and reporting skills to address distribution, delivery, data and measurement needs Excellent presentation skills and ability to address both small and large groups. Deep understanding of media landscape, services, and technologies ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: Employment/education will be verified Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis Candidate must be willing to work from a TelevisaUnivision office Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location. Please note the national salary range listed in the job posting reflects the new hire salary range across levels and U.S. locations that would be applicable to the position. Base pay Range - $60,000 to $70,000 + benefits OUR BENEFITS: TelevisaUnivision believes that a happy, well-balanced employee is what makes our culture thrive. We offer a wide selection of perks and benefits including PTO; tuition reimbursement; wellness and employee support programs; 401K; and life and other insurance plans. This is all in addition to our comprehensive and competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental and vision coverage options TelevisaUnivision is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

job.title: Digital Client Partner - Programmatic Platforms
job.description: Digital Client Partner - Programmatic Platforms Location: Ciudad de México, Santa Fe Area: Ad Operations / Digital Sales Reports to: Director de Ad Operations About Role & Team El equipo de Ad Operations trabaja de manera transversal con las áreas de Ventas Digitales, Operaciones, Producto y partners tecnológicos para asegurar la correcta ejecución, optimización y crecimiento de las soluciones publicitarias digitales de TelevisaUnivision. Como Digital Client Partner - Programmatic Platforms , serás un socio estratégico para nuestros clientes y agencias, combinando conocimiento técnico de publicidad programática con una fuerte orientación comercial y de servicio. Tendrás un rol clave en la gestión de campañas, desarrollo de deals programáticos, optimización de resultados y construcción de relaciones de largo plazo con clientes y partners estratégicos. About Position Tu principal responsabilidad será gestionar de manera integral las cuentas y campañas programáticas, asegurando una ejecución eficiente, el cumplimiento de objetivos comerciales y la generación de valor para nuestros clientes. Serás responsable de conectar las necesidades comerciales de clientes y agencias con las capacidades tecnológicas y de inventario de TelevisaUnivision, utilizando plataformas como Amazon DSP y Google DV360 , así como otras soluciones del ecosistema programático. El rol requiere una combinación de visión comercial, conocimiento técnico, capacidad analítica y habilidades de relacionamiento , siendo un punto de conexión entre clientes, agencias, equipos internos y partners tecnológicos. About You Buscamos una persona con experiencia en el ecosistema de publicidad digital y programática , capaz de entender tanto las necesidades comerciales de un cliente como los aspectos técnicos necesarios para implementar y optimizar sus campañas. Deberás tener una mentalidad orientada a resultados, capacidad para trabajar con múltiples stakeholders y facilidad para convertir información técnica y datos de desempeño en recomendaciones claras para clientes y equipos comerciales. Tu día a día Gestionar de manera integral cuentas y campañas de clientes en plataformas programáticas como Amazon DSP y Google DV360 . Supervisar la correcta implementación, ejecución y optimización de campañas de acuerdo con los objetivos comerciales y contractuales establecidos. Monitorear KPIs, analizar resultados e identificar oportunidades de optimización para maximizar el rendimiento y ROI de las campañas. Diseñar, crear y gestionar Private Marketplace Deals (PMP) y otras soluciones programáticas personalizadas. Colaborar con equipos internos, agencias y partners tecnológicos para definir parámetros técnicos, audiencias, inventario y estrategias de compra programática. Brindar soporte técnico especializado a agencias y clientes, atendiendo configuraciones, troubleshooting y escalaciones relacionadas con campañas y plataformas. Generar insights y recomendaciones basadas en datos para mejorar el desempeño de las campañas y generar nuevas oportunidades comerciales. Mantener relaciones estratégicas con clientes y agencias de alto valor, participando en business reviews, presentaciones ejecutivas y seguimiento de oportunidades. Coordinar con partners tecnológicos como Amazon, Google y otros DSPs para implementar soluciones, resolver incidencias y mantenerse actualizado sobre nuevas capacidades y cambios de plataforma. Asegurar el cumplimiento de SLAs, estándares de calidad, medición, brand safety, viewability y demás requerimientos aplicables a las campañas digitales. Colaborar con las áreas de Ventas Digitales, Marketing, Producto, Operaciones y Administración para asegurar una ejecución integral de las soluciones programáticas. Identificar nuevas oportunidades de negocio y proponer soluciones que incrementen la inversión de clientes en el ecosistema programático de TelevisaUnivision. Tu deberás tener Licenciatura en Marketing, Publicidad, Administración, Comunicación, Ingeniería, Sistemas o carrera afín. +3 años de experiencia en publicidad digital, programática, Ad Operations, ventas digitales, account management o marketing digital. Experiencia en gestión de cuentas y relacionamiento con clientes y agencias de publicidad . Dominio de plataformas programáticas, idealmente Amazon DSP y Google DV360 . Experiencia en creación y gestión de Private Marketplace Deals (PMP) . Conocimiento de conceptos de compra programática como RTB, DSP, SSP, Header Bidding, audiencias e inventario digital . Experiencia en análisis y optimización de campañas digitales con base en KPIs. Conocimiento de métricas y estándares de publicidad digital como viewability, brand safety, conversiones y rendimiento de campañas . Capacidad para realizar troubleshooting y resolver problemas relacionados con la implementación de campañas digitales. Inglés B1-B2 . Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y relacionamiento con clientes y stakeholders internos. Pensamiento estratégico y orientación a resultados comerciales. Capacidad para explicar conceptos técnicos de manera clara a audiencias no técnicas. Proactividad, orientación al cliente y capacidad para trabajar con múltiples equipos. Habilidad para construir relaciones comerciales de largo plazo y detectar oportunidades de crecimiento. Capacidad de liderazgo e influencia sin autoridad formal. Será un plus si tienes Certificaciones de Google Ads / Google Ad Manager u otras plataformas digitales. Experiencia con Facebook/Meta Ads . Conocimiento de herramientas de analítica y visualización como Google Analytics, Looker, Looker Studio o Tableau . Conocimientos de SQL . Experiencia con DMP, CDP u otras tecnologías de gestión de datos. Conocimiento del ecosistema de medios digitales y streaming. Experiencia trabajando directamente con publishers, plataformas tecnológicas o empresas de medios. Benefits Ser parte de un equipo que está transformando el ecosistema de publicidad digital y programática. Exposición a clientes, agencias y partners tecnológicos estratégicos. Desarrollo profesional dentro de una compañía líder de medios y entretenimiento. Ambiente de trabajo colaborativo y multidisciplinario. Participación en proyectos de innovación y evolución de soluciones digitales. Univision es un empleador que ofrece equidad e igualdad de oportunidades. job.title: Editor & Photographer
job.description: Univision Television Group, Inc. in Miami, FL seeks a full-time Television Camera Operator to shoot video and audio of news and other events for TV productions, both live and recorded. Edit material to match scripts using non-linear, computer-based editing on our facilities, or via mobile equipment from remote locations. Shoot and edit assigned and breaking news stories using ENG camera and non-linear editing equipment, with or without reporter. Shoot and edit special assignments and series as needed. Provide pictures and short/snap videos from the field for our Social Media platforms. Set up and operate microwave ENG trucks, as well as Live U equipment. Assist video editor/acquisitions in editing and preparing video for newscasts as assigned, using server-based editing and playback system. Operate and maintain news vehicles and equipment in a safe and professional manner. Perform routine maintenance and light troubleshooting on assigned equipment. Might be required to upload video, digital pictures, and copy to the station’s website. Monitor scanners in vehicles from news stories. Must have at least 1 year of experience in the occupation or as a television cameraman. Must be fluent in written and spoken Spanish. Must know how to use P2 and XD cameras. Must be knowledgeable in AVID, Premier and Final Cut. Must know LiveU technology. Must have experience covering live developing news in the field. Must have experience with television news networks. Apply on-line at TelevisaUnivision’s career page: https://corporate.televisaunivision.com/careers/ TelevisaUnivision is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

job.title: Especialista de Gobierno, Riesgo y Cumplimiento de Seguridad de la Información
job.description: Especialista de Gobierno, Riesgo y Cumplimiento de Seguridad de la Información ( Jefe de Seguridad de la Informacion) Ubicación: Ciudad de México | Presencial Sobre el rol y el equipo Como Especialista de Gobierno, Riesgo y Cumplimiento (GRC) de Seguridad de la Información , serás responsable de apoyar la implementación, operación y mejora continua del modelo de Gobierno, Riesgo y Cumplimiento de Seguridad de la Información. Trabajarás de manera transversal con equipos de Tecnología, Seguridad de la Información y áreas de negocio para asegurar que los procesos, controles y prácticas de seguridad estén alineados con las políticas internas, requerimientos regulatorios, estándares y mejores prácticas de la organización. Sobre la posición En esta posición participarás en la definición y actualización de políticas, estándares y controles de seguridad, así como en la evaluación de nuevas tecnologías y proyectos desde una perspectiva de seguridad y cumplimiento. También darás seguimiento a auditorías, controles SOX y hallazgos de seguridad, coordinando con las diferentes áreas las acciones necesarias para mitigar riesgos y fortalecer la protección de la información. Sobre ti Buscamos una persona analítica, organizada y con capacidad para trabajar de manera transversal con diferentes equipos. Deberás tener interés por la seguridad de la información, gobierno, riesgo y cumplimiento , así como capacidad para analizar proyectos, identificar riesgos y proponer mejoras. Es importante que tengas facilidad para comunicarte con equipos técnicos y de negocio y que puedas dar seguimiento a múltiples iniciativas y compromisos de cumplimiento. Tu día a día Apoyar en la definición y actualización de políticas, estándares y mejores prácticas de seguridad de la información . Evaluar nuevas tecnologías y proyectos para identificar requerimientos y riesgos de seguridad desde las etapas de planeación, desarrollo e implementación. Trabajar con las áreas de negocio y Tecnología para establecer prácticas que protejan la confidencialidad, integridad y disponibilidad de la información . Coordinar y dar seguimiento a la generación de evidencias para el cumplimiento de controles SOX relacionados con Seguridad de la Información. Dar seguimiento al cumplimiento de controles y requerimientos regulatorios, asegurando que las actividades se realicen en tiempo y forma. Impulsar iniciativas de concientización y cultura de Seguridad de la Información dentro de la organización. Dar seguimiento a hallazgos derivados de auditorías internas y externas, coordinando con las áreas responsables las acciones correctivas o de mitigación. Trabajar con los diferentes equipos de Seguridad de la Información para identificar necesidades relacionadas con políticas, estándares y procedimientos. Participar en mesas de trabajo para evaluar los requerimientos de seguridad asociados con la adopción de nuevas tecnologías. Identificar oportunidades de mejora en los procesos de Gobierno, Riesgo y Cumplimiento (GRC) y contribuir a su implementación. Tú deberás tener Licenciatura en Ingeniería en Sistemas, Informática, Tecnologías de la Información, Ciberseguridad o carrera afín. Experiencia en Seguridad de la Información, Gobierno, Riesgo y Cumplimiento (GRC) . Conocimiento de políticas, estándares, controles y mejores prácticas de Seguridad de la Información . Experiencia en procesos de auditoría, cumplimiento y gestión de evidencias . Conocimiento de controles SOX y seguimiento de hallazgos de auditoría. Capacidad para identificar riesgos de seguridad asociados con proyectos y nuevas tecnologías. Experiencia trabajando de manera transversal con equipos de Tecnología y áreas de negocio. Excelentes habilidades de análisis, organización, seguimiento y comunicación. Capacidad para gestionar múltiples iniciativas y prioridades de manera simultánea. Lo que ofrecemos Ser parte de una organización líder en la industria de medios y entretenimiento. Participación en proyectos estratégicos de Tecnología y Seguridad de la Información . Oportunidades de aprendizaje y desarrollo profesional. Entorno de trabajo colaborativo y multidisciplinario. Exposición a diferentes áreas de negocio y equipos especializados. job.title: Especialista en Operaciones y Soporte RPA
job.description: Especialista en Operaciones y Soporte RPA (Jefe de Consultoría) Ubicación Ciudad de México | Modalidad presencial Sobre el rol y el equipo Como Especialista en Operaciones y Soporte RPA , formarás parte del equipo de Operaciones, brindando soporte especializado para garantizar la continuidad y estabilidad de las automatizaciones y soluciones tecnológicas utilizadas por la organización. Trabajarás de manera cercana con usuarios de negocio y equipos técnicos para asegurar el correcto funcionamiento de los procesos automatizados, principalmente aquellos desarrollados en plataformas de Automatización Robótica de Procesos (RPA) . Sobre la posición Buscamos un profesional con experiencia en soporte y operación de automatizaciones en ambientes productivos, capaz de diagnosticar y resolver incidentes, realizar análisis de causa raíz y contribuir a la mejora continua de las soluciones. En esta posición tendrás un papel importante en la continuidad operativa de los bots y procesos automatizados, dando seguimiento a incidentes, cambios, requerimientos y oportunidades de optimización. Sobre ti Eres una persona analítica, orientada a la resolución de problemas y con capacidad para gestionar prioridades en entornos operativos. Te sientes cómodo trabajando bajo presión y coordinándote con usuarios técnicos y de negocio. Cuentas con sentido de urgencia, atención al detalle y un enfoque orientado a la continuidad operativa y la mejora continua. Tu día a día Brindar soporte y mantenimiento a bots y automatizaciones en ambientes productivos, principalmente desarrollados en UiPath . Monitorear y validar la correcta ejecución de los procesos automatizados. Atender, diagnosticar y resolver incidentes operativos relacionados con automatizaciones. Realizar actividades de debugging y análisis de causa raíz para identificar y resolver problemas. Ejecutar ajustes y actualizaciones derivados de cambios en aplicaciones, sistemas o procesos de negocio. Dar seguimiento a requerimientos e incidencias con usuarios de negocio y equipos técnicos. Documentar soluciones, procedimientos y controles relacionados con las automatizaciones. Apoyar en la identificación e implementación de mejoras y optimizaciones en los procesos automatizados. Participar en actividades de control de cambios y monitoreo de ambientes productivos. Colaborar en la integración y operación de automatizaciones que interactúan con diferentes aplicaciones y sistemas. Tú deberás tener Licenciatura o Ingeniería en Sistemas, Informática, Tecnologías de la Información o carrera afín. Entre 2 y 4 años de experiencia en soporte, operación o mantenimiento de aplicaciones y automatizaciones. Experiencia práctica en UiPath , incluyendo soporte, debugging y manejo de UiPath Orchestrator . Experiencia en la atención y soporte de automatizaciones en ambientes productivos, preferentemente de alto volumen o criticidad. Conocimiento de monitoreo, manejo de incidentes y control de cambios. Experiencia o conocimiento en integración entre sistemas mediante APIs, archivos, Excel o bases de datos . Capacidad para analizar y resolver problemas técnicos y realizar análisis de causa raíz. Habilidades para gestionar prioridades y trabajar bajo presión. Comunicación efectiva con equipos técnicos y usuarios de negocio. Capacidad de documentación, seguimiento y trabajo colaborativo. Será un plus si cuentas con: Certificaciones o cursos en UiPath, RPA, Power Platform, ITIL o soporte de aplicaciones . Conocimiento de Power Automate y Power Apps . Conocimientos básicos de Salesforce u otros CRM . Conocimiento de lenguajes de programación como .NET, C#, Python o similares. Conocimientos de SQL y manejo estructurado de datos . Inglés técnico intermedio para consultar documentación y participar en sesiones técnicas. Beneficios En TelevisaUnivision creemos que nuestro talento es el motor que impulsa nuestro éxito. Por ello, ofrecemos un paquete integral de beneficios diseñado para apoyar tu bienestar, desarrollo profesional y crecimiento. Prestaciones superiores a las de ley. Seguro de gastos médicos mayores. Seguro de vida. Fondo de ahorro. Vales de despensa. Aguinaldo superior al de ley. Prima vacacional. Oportunidades de desarrollo y crecimiento profesional. Participación en proyectos de automatización y transformación tecnológica. Inclusión y diversidad En TelevisaUnivision estamos comprometidos con construir un ambiente de trabajo diverso, inclusivo y respetuoso, donde todas las personas tengan igualdad de oportunidades para desarrollarse y alcanzar su máximo potencial. Valoramos la diversidad de experiencias, perspectivas y talentos, y promovemos procesos de selección basados en las habilidades, experiencia y potencial de cada persona. job.title: Gerente Comercial Ventas Sector Público
job.description: Nombre de la Posición: Gerente Comercial Ventas Sector Público Ubicación: Ciudad de México (S anta Fe ), presencial Acerca del puesto y el equipo Forma parte del equipo de TelevisaUnivision , la empresa líder mundial en medios y contenido en español. Con la videoteca más extensa de contenido propio y una capacidad de producción sin igual en la industria, impulsamos nuestras plataformas de streaming, televisión tradicional y radio, creando experiencias que conectan con millones de personas. Somos una empresa vibrante con más de 10,000 colaboradores en México, Colombia y Estados Unidos, unidos por la pasión por el entretenimiento, la creatividad y la innovación. Serás responsable de supervisar el desempeño de la infraestructura, coordinar iniciativas de mejora y garantizar una operación eficiente, segura y orientada a la continuidad del negocio. job.title: HR Project Manager Co-Op-Temp
job.description: ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM: TelevisaUnivision is looking for a HR Project Manager to join our team. ABOUT YOU: You are a highly organized and strategic project manager who thrives on bringing structure, visibility, and accountability to complex HR initiatives. You excel at managing multiple projects simultaneously, balancing competing priorities, and partnering with stakeholders across Human Resources, Technology, Finance, and the business to deliver meaningful outcomes. You have a passion for continuous improvement and enjoy building governance, creating transparency, and helping leaders make informed prioritization decisions. You are proactive, detail-oriented, and capable of transforming ideas into well-executed projects while ensuring alignment with organizational strategy and available capacity. YOUR DAY-TO-DAY: (aka Responsibilities) · Establish and continuously enhance the HR Project Management Office (PMO) framework, governance, and project delivery methodology, including standardized processes for project intake, prioritization, planning, execution, implementation, and post-launch support. · Coordinate and administer the HR Portfolio Management process, including project intake, prioritization, roadmap management, governance, status reporting, and executive communications. · Partner with HR Centers of Excellence, HR Business Partners, IT, Finance, Legal, Payroll, and business stakeholders to define project scope, business requirements, timelines, dependencies, and success measures. · Facilitate portfolio governance meetings, maintain project documentation, and provide regular updates on project health, risks, issues, milestones, and resource capacity. · Monitor project progress, proactively identify risks and dependencies, and develop mitigation plans to ensure successful delivery. · Develop and maintain portfolio dashboards, project metrics, and executive reporting that provide visibility into delivery status, resource utilization, business value, and strategic alignment. · Support business case development by evaluating project requests for business impact, effort, complexity, risk, regulatory requirements, and organizational readiness. · Drive continuous improvement of HR project management methodologies, governance frameworks, templates, and operational processes. · Coordinate testing, change management, communications, training, and deployment activities as needed to support successful project implementation. · Foster strong relationships across HR and business functions, ensuring collaboration, accountability, and alignment throughout the project lifecycle. YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications) · Experience in project management, preferably supporting Human Resources, HRIS, People Operations, or enterprise transformation initiatives. · Experience managing multiple cross-functional projects within a structured project management or portfolio management environment. · Strong understanding of project management methodologies, including Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery approaches. · Demonstrated experience facilitating governance, prioritization, risk management, stakeholder communications, and executive reporting. · Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail. · Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess business needs and recommend practical solutions. · Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels of the organization. · Experience working with project management tools such as Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Jira, Asana, Monday.com, or similar platforms. · Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker is preferred. · Experience supporting HR technology implementations (such as Workday or other HCM platforms) is strongly preferred. · PMP, CAPM, Agile, or similar project management certification is a plus. · Bilingual English and Spanish skills are preferred. TelevisaUnivision is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

job.title: Jefe de Administración de Riesgos
job.description: Jefe de Administración de Riesgos Ubicación: Ciudad de México Modalidad: Presencial, San Angel Sobre el rol y el equipo En TelevisaUnivision buscamos incorporar a nuestro equipo a un/a Jefe de Administración de Riesgos , quien tendrá un rol clave en la identificación, evaluación, monitoreo y mitigación de riesgos que puedan impactar la operación y los objetivos del negocio. Formarás parte de un entorno dinámico y multidisciplinario, colaborando con diferentes áreas de la organización y con stakeholders nacionales e internacionales, así como con aseguradoras, brokers y especialistas en gestión de riesgos. Esta posición ofrece exposición a diferentes áreas del negocio y la oportunidad de contribuir al fortalecimiento de una cultura de prevención y gestión de riesgos. Sobre la posición Serás responsable de coordinar y dar seguimiento a la administración de riesgos corporativos , generando análisis e información que permitan identificar escenarios, evaluar posibles impactos y definir acciones de mitigación. Trabajarás de manera transversal con diferentes áreas para dar seguimiento a riesgos, incidentes, seguros y planes de mitigación, proporcionando información y recomendaciones que faciliten la toma de decisiones. Buscamos una persona con pensamiento analítico, sólidos conocimientos cuantitativos y capacidad para transformar información compleja en análisis y recomendaciones claras para el negocio. Sobre ti Buscamos una persona analítica, estructurada y orientada a resultados , con experiencia en Administración de Riesgos, seguros, análisis financiero, estadístico, actuarial o áreas relacionadas. Deberás tener capacidad para analizar información, identificar escenarios de riesgo, evaluar posibles impactos y desarrollar recomendaciones prácticas. También deberás contar con excelentes habilidades de comunicación y relacionamiento, ya que trabajarás de manera transversal con diferentes áreas y stakeholders nacionales e internacionales. Tu día a día Coordinar la identificación, evaluación y monitoreo de riesgos que puedan impactar la operación y los objetivos del negocio. Analizar información financiera, estadística, actuarial y operativa para identificar escenarios de riesgo. Evaluar posibles impactos y dar seguimiento a las estrategias y acciones de mitigación. Elaborar reportes ejecutivos, análisis y presentaciones para facilitar la toma de decisiones. Analizar incidentes y siniestros, identificando causas, impactos y oportunidades de prevención. Administrar y mantener actualizada la documentación relacionada con seguros, siniestros y gestión de riesgos. Coordinar y dar seguimiento a la relación con aseguradoras, brokers y proveedores especializados . Colaborar con áreas como Finanzas, Jurídico, Fiscal, Tesorería, Compras, Recursos Humanos y Operaciones en la identificación y mitigación de riesgos. Participar en la implementación y actualización de políticas, procesos y estrategias de Administración de Riesgos. Investigar tendencias, metodologías y mejores prácticas para fortalecer los procesos de gestión de riesgos. Preparar análisis e información para stakeholders nacionales e internacionales. Facilitar la comunicación y coordinación entre diferentes equipos y áreas. Participar en iniciativas de capacitación y comunicación para fortalecer la cultura de gestión de riesgos . Identificar oportunidades de mejora, automatización y uso de datos para hacer más eficientes los procesos del área. Tú deberás tener Licenciatura en Actuaría, Matemáticas Aplicadas, Economía, Finanzas, Estadística o carrera afín. +3 años de experiencia en Administración de Riesgos, seguros, análisis financiero, estadístico, actuarial o evaluación de riesgos. Experiencia en análisis e interpretación de información financiera y estadística. Conocimiento de modelos estadísticos, probabilísticos y financieros . Conocimiento de evaluación y cuantificación de riesgos. Experiencia en elaboración de reportes ejecutivos y análisis para la toma de decisiones. Inglés avanzado . Excelentes habilidades analíticas, numéricas y de síntesis. Capacidad de organización y planeación. Habilidades de negociación y manejo de stakeholders. Capacidad para identificar problemas, evaluar escenarios y proponer soluciones. Excelentes habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita. Orientación a resultados y atención al detalle. Capacidad para trabajar con equipos multidisciplinarios y multiculturales. Será un plus si tienes Estudios o certificaciones en Administración de Riesgos, Finanzas, Actuaría o Seguros . Experiencia trabajando con aseguradoras y brokers . Experiencia en administración de pólizas y gestión de siniestros. Conocimiento de Data Management y análisis de información. Experiencia con herramientas de análisis y visualización de datos. Conocimientos de Inteligencia Artificial aplicada al análisis de información o automatización de procesos. Experiencia en continuidad de negocio y planes de contingencia. Experiencia previa en empresas multinacionales. Experiencia en industrias de medios, entretenimiento, tecnología o servicios . Lo que encontrarás con nosotros Formar parte de TelevisaUnivision , una empresa global de medios y entretenimiento. Exposición a diferentes áreas del negocio y proyectos multidisciplinarios. Colaboración con equipos nacionales e internacionales. Interacción con especialistas y proveedores relacionados con Administración de Riesgos. Participación en iniciativas orientadas a la prevención, continuidad y protección del negocio. Desarrollo profesional en un entorno dinámico y multicultural. La oportunidad de contribuir a la evolución y fortalecimiento de las prácticas de gestión de riesgos. Univision es un empleador que ofrece equidad e igualdad de oportunidades. job.title: Line Producer
job.description: JOB TITLE: Line Producer LOCATION: Miami ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM: The Network News team at TelevisaUnivision is looking for a Line Producer to join our team! This is a chance to help shape one of our daily news programs for N+Univision, streaming 24/7 on our hit platform ViX . The Line Producer will be responsible for managing the production of daily shows, supporting the Executive Producer with preproduction and team management — and will also play a role in our special programs, beyond the daily news cycle. This role carries real editorial weight: you won't just be executing a rundown, you'll be shaping it — bringing sharp news judgment, sourcing strong stories, and making the split-second calls that define how our audience experiences the news. ABOUT YOU: If you have strong sharp instincts for breaking news, knowledge of TV production and a genuine passion for journalism, this role is for you. YOUR DAY-TO-DAY: Own the daily rundown — story selection, placement, and editorial direction, with a strong voice in what makes the show and why. job.description: The Manager, Multimedia Content, Live Video Streaming & Programming will lead TelevisaUnivision Local Media's live video strategy and programming across YouTube, Facebook, TikTok, and emerging platforms. This role will lead a team responsible for live production, digital video, and social content, while overseeing programming strategy, content execution, audience growth, and monetization. The Manager will combine strong editorial judgment, digital expertise, and operational leadership to develop engaging, culturally relevant content that connects with Latino audiences across the U.S. ABOUT YOU: You are a dynamic digital media leader with a passion for live content, audience growth, and innovative storytelling. Incorporate cross-promotion within live streams through slates, lower-thirds, and calls-to-action that drive audiences to other Local Media content, digital products, and platforms. Strong understanding of audience development, content optimization, SEO, algorithms, and social engagement strategies. Experience developing and managing a programming calendar or content grid across multiple platforms. Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven news or media environment, including rapid-response coverage. Strong editorial judgment with the ability to identify compelling, culturally relevant content for Latino audiences. Experience using audience analytics and performance data to make programming and content decisions, including KPIs such as watch time, concurrent viewers, engagement, and audience growth. job.title: Sales Operations Analyst
job.description: TelevisaUnivision is the leading Spanish-language media company in the world! We’re investing in our content, our people, and our properties, which span digital, streaming, social, audio, linear and live events. We’re growing our offerings, building on the recent launch of our successful streaming platform, ViX. We were the fastest growing major media company in the U.S. The Sales Operations Analyst supports the management, analysis, and optimization of linear advertising inventory across the portfolio. Working closely with Planning, Sales, Programming, Traffic, and other internal partners, the Analyst helps ensure inventory is accurately maintained, effectively utilized, and aligned with revenue and client-delivery objectives. The role combines day-to-day inventory management with analytical problem solving and will increasingly leverage AI, automation, and data-driven tools to identify inventory risks, recommend actions, and improve yield. ABOUT YOU The successful Sales Operations Analyst will move beyond simply reporting on inventory conditions to understanding why they exist and recommend what the business should do about them. Over time, as reporting and transactional work become increasingly automated, the role will place greater emphasis on analysis, exception management, validation of AI-generated recommendations, and improving inventory utilization and yield. You are an Excel rock star, who enjoys analyzing numbers and data to provide insights into our sales organization. For you, every challenge is an opportunity to find a solution. YOUR DAY TO DAY Monitor inventory availability, capacity, sellout levels, and utilization across networks, dayparts, programs, and high-profile events. Identify inventory risks and opportunities and recommend actions to improve utilization, protect revenue, and support client delivery. Partner closely with Planning teams to ensure proposals, allocations, stewardship decisions, and inventory changes reflect current availability and business priorities. Support management of oversold inventory, preemptions, underdelivery, liability, and other inventory exceptions. Analyze supply and demand trends and provide actionable recommendations to Planning and Sales leadership. Maintain and validate inventory-related data, including capacities, format grids, ratecards, program information, and other inputs used in planning and inventory systems. Support inventory requirements for tentpoles, live sports, and other high-profile programming. Partner with Programming, Traffic, Planning, and Sales Operations to resolve inventory issues and execute approved changes. Use WideOrbit and related systems to manage inventory and support transactional workflows. Leverage reporting, analytics, AI, and automation tools to improve inventory decision-making and reduce manual processes. Review and validate AI-generated inventory recommendations as new optimization capabilities are introduced. Help define business rules and identify exceptions that should inform future automated inventory workflows. Develop a strong understanding of inventory economics and the relationship between pricing, demand, capacity, client commitments, and yield. Document processes and contribute to consistent inventory operating procedures and team knowledge. Support ad hoc analyses and special projects as needed. YOU HAVE Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience. 2+ years of experience in media, advertising, sales operations, inventory, planning, analytics, or a related field preferred. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable recommendations. Strong Excel skills; experience with reporting or data-visualization tools is preferred. Experience with WideOrbit or other advertising sales/traffic systems is a plus. Comfort working with data, emerging technology, AI, and automated workflows. Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to collaborate effectively across Planning, Sales, Programming, Traffic, Finance, and other functions. Intellectual curiosity and willingness to learn both the commercial and technical aspects of inventory management. ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS Must be willing to work onsite from the NY office location Employment/education will be verified Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a fulltime basis Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location: Base annual salary: 64,000 – 70,000 OUR BENEFITS TelevisaUnivision believes that a happy, well-balanced employee is what makes our culture thrive. We offer a wide selection of perks and benefits including PTO; tuition reimbursement; wellness and employee support programs; 401K; and life and other insurance plans. This is all in addition to our comprehensive and competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental and vision coverage options. TelevisaUnivision is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend
job.description: TelevisaUnivision is the leading Spanish-language media company in the world! We're investing in our content, our people, and our platforms across digital, streaming, social, audio, linear, and live events. We continue to expand our global footprint through our flagship streaming platform, ViX. The Senior Software Engineer, Backend will join our Core Digital Engineering team responsible for designing, building, and evolving the backend services that power products used by millions of users across the U.S., Mexico, Spain, and Latin America. The Senior Software Engineer will design and develop highly scalable distributed systems, resilient microservices, and cloud-native applications that support one of the largest Spanish-language streaming platforms in the world. Working closely with Product, Architecture, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), QA, Security, and fellow engineering teams, this role will help deliver reliable, high-performance backend systems while contributing to the evolution of our engineering standards and platform architecture. This is a hands-on senior engineering role for someone who enjoys solving complex distributed systems challenges, building software at internet scale, and continuously improving platform performance, reliability, scalability, and maintainability. ABOUT YOU: You are passionate about building software the right way. You believe maintainable code, scalable architectures, automation, and engineering excellence are essential to delivering world-class digital products. You enjoy diving deep into technical challenges, understanding systems end-to-end, and designing backend services that remain reliable as traffic, complexity, and business demands continue to grow. You naturally raise the engineering bar through thoughtful technical design, high-quality code reviews, mentorship, and continuous learning. You thrive in collaborative environments where ownership, innovation, and engineering excellence are highly valued. YOUR DAY-TO-DAY: (Responsibilities) Design, build, and maintain highly scalable backend services and microservices supporting TelevisaUnivision's digital products. Develop secure, resilient, and high-performance RESTful APIs and/or gRPC services consumed by millions of users. Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code using modern software engineering practices, including unit, integration, and performance testing. Design distributed systems capable of supporting high traffic, low latency, and high availability. Optimize application performance across services, databases, caching layers, messaging systems, and cloud infrastructure. Participate in architecture reviews and influence technical decisions for new products, platform enhancements, and modernization initiatives. Take ownership of backend services throughout their lifecycle, including design, implementation, deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and continuous improvement. Serve as a technical leader on complex engineering initiatives by helping guide architectural decisions, establishing engineering best practices, and influencing technical direction across the team. Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Architects, DevOps, QA, Security, and cross-functional engineering teams throughout the software development lifecycle. Perform thoughtful code reviews while mentoring engineers and promoting engineering best practices across the organization. Improve platform observability through centralized logging, monitoring, distributed tracing, and performance metrics. Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and continuous delivery initiatives that improve software quality and release velocity. Drive technical debt reduction, platform modernization, and adoption of modern backend engineering practices. Participate in production support, incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous reliability improvements. Influence engineering decisions through data-driven problem solving, technical expertise, and collaborative partnership across teams. YOU HAVE: (Qualifications, Experience) 6+ years of professional experience building backend applications in production environments. Strong experience designing distributed systems and scalable service-oriented architectures. Expert-level proficiency in at least one modern backend programming language such as Go, Java, Python, C#, or a comparable language. Extensive experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and/or gRPC services. Strong understanding of software architecture principles, including SOLID, Clean Architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and common design patterns. Experience working with relational and NoSQL databases, including schema design, query optimization, indexing, and performance tuning. Hands-on experience with caching technologies such as Redis or Memcached. Experience with asynchronous messaging and event-driven architectures using Kafka, RabbitMQ, Google Pub/Sub, or similar technologies. Experience deploying and operating services within cloud environments, preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or AWS. Strong knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, container orchestration, and cloud-native application development. Experience implementing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes. Familiarity with observability tools including centralized logging, monitoring, metrics, and distributed tracing. Strong understanding of backend security best practices, including authentication, authorization, API security, and secrets management. Experience working within Agile software development environments. Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex technical initiatives from design through production while balancing scalability, reliability, and maintainability. Excellent analytical, debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Advanced English proficiency. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience supporting products serving millions of daily active users. Experience building highly available, low-latency backend platforms operating at internet scale. Experience with event-driven architectures and streaming technologies. Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar). Experience optimizing cloud infrastructure for scalability, resiliency, and cost efficiency. Experience contributing to backend platform modernization, cloud migration, or large-scale architectural transformation initiatives. Experience mentoring engineers and providing technical leadership across multiple engineering initiatives. Familiarity with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles, production operations, and operational excellence. Experience working with AI-assisted software development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude Code, or similar) to improve engineering productivity and software quality. Experience working within globally distributed engineering organizations across multiple time zones. Experience within streaming, media, entertainment, or large-scale consumer technology organizations. Eligibility Requirements Employment and education verification required Must be authorized to work full-time in Mexico Univision es un empleador que ofrece equidad e igualdad de oportunidades. Todos los solicitantes calificados recibirán consideración para el empleo sin distinción de sexo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, raza, color, religión, origen nacional, discapacidad, estado de veterano protegido, edad o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley.

job.title: 3D Motion Specialist
job.description: We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world. Fame House, a division of UMG, is the preeminent leader in D2C solutions in music, defining & delivering the industry’s best-in-class service to connect artists with their fans. Established & headquartered in Philly, Fame House powers eCommerce for UMG’s labels, artists, and Bravado, along with a select roster of 3rd party clients. Our success & culture is fueled by collaboration, both within FH and with our partners. We are passionate about the impact of eCommerce for artists, providing a full service solution to grow an artist’s owned business including strategy, creative, storefront merchandising, fulfillment, customer service, technology, and more. How we LEAD: Merchandise and e-commerce is part of the fabric of music culture. For artists, it’s a way to develop and further articulate their brand. For fans, it’s another pathway to connecting with an artist and the culture they represent. At Digital Creative & Experience, we create experiences that connect artists and fans through storytelling, design, content, commerce, and culture. Across artist storefronts, ecommerce experiences, campaigns, content initiatives, and fan engagement platforms, the Design & Direction team is responsible for bringing artist brands to life through compelling and innovative creative experiences. As digital experiences continue to evolve, motion, animation, and immersive visual storytelling play an increasingly important role in how audiences discover, engage with, and connect to artists and brands. The 3D Motion Specialist helps shape these experiences by transforming creative concepts into dynamic visual content that elevates storytelling, enhances engagement, and pushes creative boundaries. How You’ll CREATE The 3D Motion Specialist is responsible for designing and creating high-quality motion graphics, 3D visualizations, animations, and digital content experiences across artist campaigns, e-commerce initiatives, content productions, and branded experiences. Working closely with Creative Directors, Designers, Content Production teams, and Developers, this role translates creative vision into visually compelling motion-based experiences that support artist storytelling, product presentation, fan engagement, and brand expression. Combining technical expertise with strong creative instincts, the 3D Motion Specialist contributes throughout the creative process, from concept development and visual exploration through final execution and delivery. This role plays a key part in evolving the visual capabilities of the Design & Direction team and exploring new ways to engage audiences through motion and interactive storytelling. job.title: Account Lead
job.description: We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world. How we LEAD: Virgin Music is looking for a superstar Account Lead/Manager to join our industry-leading Commercial Marketing team. This role will build go-to-market commercial release plans, identify and execute innovative commercial opportunities, and develop creative release strategies while nurturing key relationships with our commercial accounts, artists, and label partners. The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience building, optimizing, and managing YouTube channels on behalf of artists , with a deep understanding of the platform’s underlying mechanics. They are fluent in YouTube’s ecosystem—from content strategy and audience development to monetization and discovery levers—and know how to leverage the full suite of YouTube tools to grow artist presence, engagement, and global reach. This individual will also possess exceptional relationship management skills, be proactive and results-oriented, and demonstrate strong strategic and analytical thinking. They must thrive in a fast-paced environment and serve as a passionate advocate for Virgin’s artists and label partners. How you'll CREATE: Relationship Management: Develop and maintain strong relationships with DSPs and streaming partners while also serving as a key YouTube platform expert—driving storytelling, content strategy, and audience growth initiatives. Collaborate with playlist/genre leads and platform representatives by utilizing cultural insight, marketing strategy, and data to deliver against targets. Support asset collection, optimize content delivery, and manage pitch administration. Attend regular meetings and maintain in-person relationships with partners. Partner Account Manager: Represent Virgin Music Group repertoire as the Account Lead across various commercial accounts, including YouTube as a core strategic platform . Maintain a deep, working knowledge of best practices, tools (e.g., YouTube Studio, Content ID, Official Artist Channels), and opportunities across accounts. Lead release strategies, long-lead planning, and campaigns while pitching and securing opportunities that drive visibility and discovery for artists. Label Relations: Work directly with Virgin Music Group labels to identify opportunities across release schedules, including YouTube-first or YouTube-enhanced strategies (premieres, Shorts, live content, catalog optimization). Educate teams on platform best practices and ensure alignment on KPIs, reporting, and performance tracking. Streaming and Commercial Marketing Strategy: Create dynamic release plans that integrate YouTube as a central discovery and fan engagement engine , leveraging content formats, release timing, and platform features to maximize impact. YouTube Channel Strategy & Optimization: Lead the development and ongoing management of artist YouTube channels, including channel optimization, content programming, metadata strategy, release cadence, audience segmentation, and growth tactics . Utilize YouTube analytics and insights to inform strategy, improve performance, and drive subscriber and viewership growth. Data Analysis: Provide daily and in-depth analysis across platforms, with a strong emphasis on YouTube performance metrics (audience retention, CTR, watch time, traffic sources, etc.), translating insights into actionable recommendations. Label Meetings: Communicate release performance and strategic recommendations, including YouTube-specific insights and optimization opportunities , while building forward-looking plans. Digital Marketing Strategy: Partner with label digital teams to ensure campaigns are innovative and platform-native, with a strong emphasis on video strategy, fan engagement, and discovery through YouTube and emerging formats (e.g., Shorts) . Experience working with modern application architectures, REST APIs, microservices, and cloud-native technologies. Experience integrating security into CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps workflows. Experience working within AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform environments. Knowledge of modern authentication and authorization technologies including OAuth, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML, and JWT. In this role, you’ll serve as the strategic lead across a portfolio of artists, owning the long-term direction of their merchandise and D2C businesses. You’ll shape merch & D2C strategies that align with the artist’s creative vision to deliver strong commercial results across both merch and music , developing long-term (rolling 12mo+) calendar plans across all revenue channels and guiding the strategy behind every campaign, product launch, and fan experience. This role requires a strong ability to sell ideas and inspire confidence with artist and label teams, bringing clarity & thoughtful storytelling to every campaign discussion to help artists understand D2C & merch’s impact in building fandom. It requires exceptional taste, deep cultural fluency, and an intuitive understanding of artist brand, aesthetic direction, and creative identity. Success in this role also requires exceptional collaborative leadership , working closely with many teams and disciplines, both internally and with partners. Candidates must lead with positivity, respect, and a team-first mindset, ensuring strong partnerships across the organization and consistently delivering great outcomes for artists. How You’ll Create: Serve as the relationship lead for Capitol Music Group and their artists, building trusted relationships with artist managers, label teams, and creative partners. Lead holistic, cross-channel merchandise strategy across D2C, tour, retail, and licensing, including for physical music on d2c, exclusives, and fan engagement moments. Develop rolling 12-month calendar plans across all channels, including D2C, tour & VIP, retail, and licensing initiatives, working closely with the artist team, label marketing and creative. Bring infectious energy, enthusiasm, and storytelling to all pitch, proposal, and planning conversations — inspiring clients to adopt innovative D2C and merch ideas that drive growth. Lead development and presentation of artist proposals, calendar plans, and go-to-market initiatives , ensuring buy-in from clients and stakeholders. Partner closely with Campaign Managers to ensure all campaigns and initiatives remain on track to achieve artist and label goals, proactively identifying opportunities to optimize performance. Lead Artist & Label Business Reviews , presenting insights, growth opportunities, and long-term strategic recommendations.
